AS-cb6131f4ed8c.t: ARRANGED ACCORDING TO THE APPOINTMENT OF EACH DAY, WITH SELECTED ABBREVIATIONS FOR THE EASE OF THE SINGERS. SECOND PRINTING. VAGHARSHAPAT, AT THE PRESS OF THE HOLY CATHOLICOSATE OF ETCHMIADZIN, 1888, BY COMMAND OF LORD MAKAR, OF BLESSED MEMORY [?], HOLY-FULFILLING CATHOLICOS OF ALL ARMENIANS. THOSE WHO DRANK FROM THE STREAMS OF THE SPIRIT AND AT SUCCESSIVE TIMES SANG THE MANY-TOONED SONGS OF THE SHARAGANS: And St Mesrop, the order of Repentance. St Movses the poet: the Lamplighting 'Rejoice', the order of the Nativity and 'Unfading'; the Lord's Presentation, the Verses (Harts) of the Resurrection, and the first images of the Coming of the Spirit, of Vartavar and of the Dormition, and the 'Let Us Magnify'. But those of St Anthony, of the Kings, of the Apostles, of John, of St Gregory, of the Prophets, and of the Vartanank: all of these some attribute to the house of Ananias, and some to Khorenatsi. Lord Komitas: the 'Souls' of the Hripsimeans, and the Verses. St Sahag of Dzor, who went against the Turks: those of the Cross, of the Church, of the 'Spotless Living Image', and 'Lord of Heaven' ('Who adorned'). Gregory the Magistros: the 'Four according to the image', which others assign to the house of Sahag of Dzor. St Nerses Shnorhali: the 'Voice' of the Great Blessing, those of the Seventy, of the Ninevites, of the Sundays' Alleluia [?], of the Verses of Palm Sunday; the four images of the Coming of the Spirit; the two images of Vartavar, and the two images of the Dormition; the four-mode [?] Verses of John; the four-mode [?] Verses of the Prophets; those of the Archangels, the 'Newly Wondrous' of the Vartanank, those of the Ghevontyank, and 'Today the Ineffable', 'The Renewer', 'God Uncreated', the 'Creator' one, the Sharagans of the Sunrise, 'We Bless You', 'Look with Love', and 'From You We Ask'; and according to some, the one of St James is also said to be his. Nerses of Lambron: 'Today He Rose', 'The Renewed Islands', that of the Ascension, and 'of the Grandsons' [?]. Gregory of Skevra: 'The Sun of Righteousness', of St John the Baptist. Vardan the Great Vardapet: 'Who Foreknew', 'From the Boundless Sea', the Blessing of the Translators 'Who Adorned', and the Blessing of St Sarkis 'Of the All-Holy Trinity'. Hovhannes Vardapet Plouz: of St Nerses 'Who the Ineffable Light', 'Today the Rejoicing', and the 'All the Mountains' of the holy Illuminator; and 'The Last Days'. Kirakos Vardapet of Yerznka: 'The Surpassingly Radiant East', which some assign to Kirakos the Translator, who was a disciple of Gregory the Great, lover of witnesses. 'New Zion' [cut off]. 'With Blood' [cut off]. The fourth mode of the selection is completed.

AS-efe178915339.t: Bless the Lord, you children, and bless the name of the Lord. Radiant with light.

AS-3b0fa90cb5af.t: You who dissolved the darkness of ignorance of us Armenians, who caused the light of wisdom to dawn through these sons of Torgom.

AS-e49799e166cc.t: Sing, children of Zion, a new song at the birth of the Mother of the Lord; for he who is timeless, begotten of the Father, was born today of a barren womb. Give blessing to him who gave us the Mother of light.

AS-5db73d69f3b3.t: Rejoice, children of men, today at the birth of the holy Virgin; for she who bore the Inexpressible in her womb without seed has today sprung forth from the root of Jesse. Give blessing to him who gave us the Mother of Light.

AS-6a795a33c323.t: Barren Anna bore Mary, the joy of the world, by the glad tidings of the angel; she bore in the flesh the giver of the old Law, the bestower of this new covenant. Give blessing to him who gave us the Mother of Light.

AS-b674f203aefa.t: Rejoice, Mother of the Word, begotten of the Father before the day-star; you who made the heavenly light dawn for mankind, the dispeller of the darkness of sin: entreat the Word to save us from our sins.

AS-a64e25b74745.t: Today the promise of God to the patriarchs was fulfilled, that in their seed all nations would be blessed; for from their root sprang the holy Virgin, who bore the Word, the remover of the sin of the forefather. Let us give glory to him who gave us the one blessed among women.

AS-95c1b3d49b03.t: Today Mary, the bush, has sprung up from Anna, in whom the divine fire was kindled, which Moses saw on Sinai as a type of the Virgin, filled with unapproachable light. Let us give glory to him who gave us her who is blessed among women.

AS-d895523585b0.t: Of one essence with the Father and the Spirit, beginningless Son, motherless in the first [?], firstborn; and with the Father forever.

AS-3dc3905f1253.t: Sent from the bosom of the Father, laid in a manger of unreasoning beasts, you, Word, God, revealed.

AS-a972c998051c.t: Christ born in the city of David; the shepherds proclaim with the angels, and the Magi with the stars.

AS-a856cb98f96e.t: Your wondrously glorious birth from the holy Virgin was shown today to the race of men, you, the Word coexisting without beginning, of one essence with the Father.

AS-01c8c640643c.t: At your manifestation, Lord, the earth rejoiced and Adam was renewed from the first transgressions, from his sins.

AS-17ba562f16b4.t: The ranks of the shepherds on earth glorified your all-life-giving coming, you who appeared to your creatures.

AS-49092805d5b9.t: You who bore in your womb, as Lord, the one made flesh: rejoice, unwedded Mother.

AS-7ecff66f447b.t: You who bore in your womb, without corruption, the One who contains all things [cut off]

AS-3a3ca1e4fc3b.t: You who truly bore in substance the Word, co-eternal with the Creator, to the world: rejoice [cut off]

AS-308c17c8ef77.t: Today the Most High has been revealed to us, the Word enthroned: in a manger, a lamb [?] from the Unreasoning [?], and heavenly bread.

AS-d8045005fdf8.t: Today the heavenly angels rejoice, beholding the awesome and fearsome and wondrous birth, which was shown as light to the world.

AS-f47aeaa85ebe.t: As the watchers descended to give glory, they saw a cloud

AS-f0e7e4941361.t: of light made into a pillar upon the rock full of fire; the blessed ranks of the shepherds [cut off]

AS-8cc8fd6497a0.t: Mother of God, tabernacle of light, unconfined dwelling of the Sun of life, who became the east of the Sun of righteousness and caused light to dawn for us who sit in darkness, therefore we all ever magnify you.

AS-7c1ea982eb2e.t: Incorrupt temple and unburnt bush, who bore within you the unquenchable fire of the Godhead, by which the flame of the passions that burned our nature was quenched: wherefore [cut off]

AS-70ad891fdbd1.t: Living ark of the testaments of this new covenant, through which the departure to the land of promise is poured out by the Spirit, the Word imprinted in you; for which [cut off]

AS-24b599906e48.t: Mother of God, pillar of light, overshadowing cloud and dwelling of the Word, who by the Word shepherded Israel, intercede for him on behalf of our souls.

AS-a467dfe4bd87.t: The holy Church confesses the incorrupt Virgin Mary as Mother of God, from whom was given the bread of immortality and the cup that brings joy; give blessing to her in spiritual song.

AS-c777e6e611d8.t: The ranks of the spiritual beings bless the incorrupt temple of the Word of the Father; we also praise, joining our voices with the heavenly ones.

AS-0b3189f4bc75.t: Today the choirs of the apostles rejoice at the coming of the Spirit of God, whom he sent as comforter in place of the incarnate Word, being among them; let us give glory to him with a holy-singing voice.

AS-419dc2dfe97d.t: This day living water gushed forth in Jerusalem, from which rivers were filled,

AS-89af2f95814f.t: divine ones; and, running, they gave the universe to drink of the four-streamed fountain of Eden: glory [cut off at the colon].

AS-c38769f88a8f.t: Today, by the spiritual dew of the clouds of the Spirit, the plants of the Church flourished, the fields grew rich with righteousness, and the deserts became beautiful with pure virginity; glory [cut off].

AS-808e0772153a.t: Mountain hewn from rock, abundant spring, flowering branch, fair vine, earthly seraph, [dwelling] of the Rabbi, the Word, house of the dispensation, tabernacle of the Spirit, intercede continually with him who was born of you, with unceasing petition, to grant forgiveness to us and to those who have fallen asleep.

AS-9d3ff645dfb0.t: Key that opens the paradise of delight, bearer of Christ, likeness of heaven, golden urn full of manna, rod blossoming from the root of Jesse, temple of light, mother to the one born [cut off]

AS-910fd0aa1b19.t: Sweetly-spreading dew, desired of the heavenly ones, material seraph, pearl-radiant beauty, foundation of the Church, pure dove, overshadowing cloud, holy Virgin Mary [cut off]

AS-9dd1a6608612.t: Today the righteous lambs, Joachim and Anna, gave us the fleece that receives the heavenly dew, from which the rain of life poured forth and the fountain of wisdom gushed out for the world. Let us give glory to him who gave us her who is blessed among women.

AS-07a38a2c4503.t: Today the barren mother bore you, tree of life, blossoming from the root of Jesse, Lady, who gave to mankind in due time the fruit, the bread of li [cut off]

AS-15d191e6e52f.t: [cut off] who came down from heaven; intercede, holy one, for our souls.

AS-1c49931737e6.t: Who [?] fulfilled what was foretold long before by the prophecy of the prophets, heavenly Father, giving the Virgin from Anna; we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-ec6a1776d767.t: You who, at the fulfilment of the ineffable birth from the Virgin according to your Isaiah, this day with wonders, only-begotten of the Father, bestowed your mother from a barren mother: we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-94a7603a2ebd.t: You who showed the Spirit to the prophet as the type of Mary, this day gave to Joachim a child, the rock-born mountain: we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-4e33b9b50aa0.t: Bless the Lord, exalt him forever.

AS-f0777653221e.t: Rejoice, ancient Zion, assembly-place of the seers, who in many forms foretold the Begetter of the Word, the Lord God: exalt him forever.

AS-1384660d83fc.t: Rejoice, O Church, daughter of Zion on high, for the pure mother of your bridegroom has been born of Anna: exalt him forever.

AS-7a6fbe12807f.t: Priests and people celebrating the birth of the Virgin from Joachim and Anna, the parents of the holy Parent of the Word, exalt him forever.

AS-d9a887a8f1a7.t: To the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac and Jacob you were granted by God, Virgin Mary, their daughter; peoples and nations today call blessed her who was born of Anna.

AS-29d450482fc2.t: Handmaid and mother of life, bearer of the Father's Only-begotten of the right hand, who in the flesh from you cast down the proud one from the throne: today the race and the nations call blessed her who was born of Anna.

AS-3e33049d2f7b.t: He who raised our fallen nature to heaven, the Son born of you; who filled the hungry with bread and sent the rich away empty: today the race and the nations call blessed her who was born of Anna.

AS-99053607a0e8.t: You who had mercy on humankind born in sin, heavenly Father, according to the prophet, and gave to our nature today as a gift the holy Virgin, the mother of Your only-begotten Son: by her prayers, Lord, have mercy on us.

AS-538a3e1c3595.t: You, Son, who today dropped dew upon us from the cloud of the Law, the virgin Mary, from whom you were born in the flesh and by whom you took away the sin of Adam the first-formed: through her intercession [cut off]

AS-3fbee90b36fc.t: You who, as the Holy Spirit, purified the heart and womb of your co-glorious mother: today you gave to her barren parents the mother of the Word, the one who blesses Eve; by [her] interc[essions] [cut off]

AS-aa9435aa4753.t: Today the heavenly ones rejoice, and the choir on high sing spiritual songs on the day of the birth of the holy one.

AS-3f00ad56c544.t: Today the heavenly Zion cries out the song of the Seraphim, saying the Thrice-Holy on the day of the birth of the holy one.

AS-80be438e3c9b.t: Today the stars and the moon with the sun, rejoicing, praise the light from the Father on the day of the birth of the mother of light.

AS-4b5e53d4ff0b.t: Today the elders of the Law, with the children of the new Zion, the young men and virgins, rejoice at the birth of the Lady.

AS-edd4486336a6.t: Today the ranks of the apostles and the choirs of the prophets sing glory on high on the day of the birth of the mother of the Word.

AS-2939c1ec26ce.t: Tree of life planted in Eden, holy Virgin, who caused to sprout the flower born of the Father, and in due time gave the Son as fruit to mankind: partaking of his body we have become immortal in hope; therefore we bless you on the day of your birth.

AS-ca9bbe045575.t: Rational earth, lady, and field pure of the thorns of sin, who without seed bore the heavenly plant, through whom you gave the bread of life to our famished nature: for this reason we bless you on the day of your birth.

AS-97fbb75bc6f3.t: Cloud light of earthly desires, holy Virgin, and furnace of the divine flame, who rained the dew that wells from the Father upon the rational earth, through which holy plants of righteousness sprang up for our nature: for this reason we bless you on the day of your birth.

AS-3fdc169446d1.t: Children born of the new Zion, adorned with grace by the holy font and the Spirit of God, bless the heavenly Father on the day of the birth of the holy Virgin, in whom you were blessed from the curse of the forefather.

AS-227f11872cd6.t: O peoples redeemed by the blood of the spotless Lamb, on the day of the birth of the Mother of the Incomprehensible One, praise the Only-begotten, who was pleased to take flesh without seed from her, in whom you were blessed, freed from the curse of the forefather.

AS-4ae50bfb1833.t: O nations of the Gentiles, made radiant by the abundant grace of the Spirit, on the day of the birth of the Mother of the Word, bless with a spiritual song the Spirit, co-glorious with the Son who was born, who purified the bodily dwelling of the Son.

AS-698fe12b0e91.t: You who in foreknowing wisdom ordained the mystery of the holy Church, laying deepest foundations of firmness, the ranks of the righteous: by their entreaties spare us.

AS-7da43bc1676b.t: You who this day made the blessing of the first-created, the God-paired male and female, blossom resplendently and fittingly in Joachim and in Anna; by their entreaties, spare us.

AS-8427d250249d.t: You who this day showed, from Anna, the promise to Abraham our patriarch according to the Spirit, with the priestly and royal scepters united; by their entreaties, spare us.

AS-cb798f903ef4.t: Beginningless God, ineffable, of boundless power, who from the beginning of the ages cared for the sons of Adam, today, shining supremely in grace, you showed through her birth the mother of your chosen Only-begotten; by her entreaties, spare us.

AS-0a7462022e1d.t: The King of all, enveloped in the Virgin's womb, whom you, faithful servant, beheld by the Holy Spirit and blessed with your mother's mouth: interce [cut off]

AS-b49d578c9ec2.t: You who made known your divine power, true Spirit, distributing your gifts sovereignly to the prophets who saw from the beginning: by their intercession spare us.

AS-b41c031e6845.t: The Word, God, and the hidden mystery of the ages, came down from heaven, was incarnate of the Virgin, crucified on earth and buried in a new tomb, and rose on the third day, that he might fulfill the words of the prophets.

AS-3d222b1638e5.t: You who by your word brought the whole world into being out of nothing, this day, in your love for mankind, in your providence you laid the foundations of a new world from Anna; by her entreaties, spare us.

AS-e789d7bbebf1.t: She who is praised in song by the spiritual hosts, the holy one born today according to the laws of nature, the Mother of God the Word, above all natures: exalt the one born today, the pure Mother of the Word, the ever-virgin.

AS-5e23d6e92e62.t: The lady blessed by the ranks of the prophets and the blessed apostles, the loosener of the curses of Eve, the Mother of life, born today of Anna: exalt the one born today, the pure Mother of the Word, the ever-virgin.

AS-5bc78b4d8f26.t: Morning of peace and joy-bringing morning star, today the holy Mary, to your glory, Christ, has dawned on us as light from the children of the law; with unceasing song we ever magnify you with these.

AS-185b756be0ff.t: Gathering place of the prophets and pledge of life for mankind, Mary, Mother of God, receptacle of the sevenfold graces; anchor of the steadfastness of hope, equal in number to the days of these passing ages [?], with a blessing.

AS-445f8aae0375.t: The ineffable mystery, hidden from the generations and the ages, was revealed this day by the descent of the archangel to the virgin Mary, whom we hold as intercessor before the Lord for our souls.

AS-ab69ddd7d401.t: Today you, the Word, who are ever glorified and worshiped by the fiery hosts of heaven, prayed to the Father in the flesh, receiving with the Father my entreaties on my behalf [?]; whence, willingly bearing fear, you were strengthened by angels [?], you who strengthen the heavenly and the earthly; therefore spare us, Christ, by your voluntary sufferings.

AS-0b24ab2ac0de.t: Today your command, appointed beforehand, was fulfilled by the company of the disciples; for the shepherd was struck and the flock was scattered, according to the prophet. You, the unbound, were bound, condemned by Annas and by Caiaphas; you were slapped by a servant, and you, the image of the Father, received the spittle of insults; therefore spare us, Christ, by your voluntary sufferings.

AS-bc03d5c734e0.t: ... phas, condemned, you were struck by a servant and received the spittle of insults, you who are the image of the Father; wherefore ...

AS-a7144c07997f.t: Today the rock of faith, shaken by the deceit of the tempter, was released by You from the battle, as You rebuked human weakness and, for the hope of repentance of sinners, accepted from Him who wept bitterly, by a threefold questioning of love, the healing of the three denials. With him heal us also, Christ, and grant us tears of repentance.

AS-8736eacaeb08.t: Today you, the Word, God, honored with awe by the heavenly luminaries, were come against by the darkened ranks of the Hebrews, who came by night with torches and swords to seize you, the intelligible Light, the unseizable One; therefore we worship your ineffable humility.

AS-656c6cf07398.t: Today you whose face the seraphim covered in fear of the glory of your divinity, while Judas, the son of perdition, drew near with a kiss of treachery, a sign and occasion of death for you, the Immortal; therefore we worship your ineffable humility.

AS-1bed10362ca1.t: Today, at your supreme dispensation, Son of God, the hosts of the bodiless ones, of fiery-natured race, were struck with amazement and wonder, seeing the Invisible One willingly betrayed into the hands of sinners; therefore we worship your ineffable humility.

AS-122519cffda8.t: Today your friends and neighbors became distant from you, Christ

AS-d24799a28406.t: Today your friends and neighbors became distant from you, Christ; your brothers too became estranged, and fat bulls, those of the scribes and Pharisees, besieged you, and many dogs, the soldiers of Pilate and of Herod, surrounded you; therefore we worship your ineffable humility.

AS-ef82ed867b97.t: Mad with love of silver, Judas betrayed his own great Teacher to the Jews for thirty pieces of silver.

AS-99e6f1abeaa3.t: "The one whom I shall kiss," he says, "seize him." O kiss of treachery, sign and occasion of death!

AS-280dc605347f.t: He stripped himself of the divine Holy Spirit and put on Satan, wrapping him around himself like a garment.

AS-8ff6d62f77c2.t: On the night in which our Savior was betrayed to the death of the Cross, He went up the Mount of Olives to pray and said this: Father, let this cup pass from Me.

AS-58e53ef04717.t: You who sit upon the Cherubim, God the Word, today for our sake in humility You sat on the Mount of Olives; we bless You with unceasing song.

AS-6663e9fc3959.t: You who are of one essence with the Father's counsels, you made known to your disciples the mystery of your coming; we bless you with unceasing song.

AS-e0f068a7525c.t: You who are Maker of all and Creator of life, today You revealed the hidden mystery of Your Trinity to Your holy Church; we bless You with unceasing song.

AS-ee55d2429cf5.t: We bless you, who are the giver of good things, and we ask, as of one who loves humankind, together with your Mother, for the chosen ones, the spiritual world.

AS-df5100783279.t: For you are the Lord of whom the Mother asked in faith, together with her sanctified sons, glory at your right hand and at your left among those with whom we also beseech that you will number us with your saints.

AS-3778538d4839.t: But you, the exalted Saviour, who humbled yourself for our sake, make us worthy to drink the cup of the commandment of your life, Lord, so that we may stand at your right hand at your coming in the age to come.

AS-2101ddeee24b.t: Like a fearful wind, with a dreadful, mighty sound, you appeared in the upper room, O Spirit, to the company of the twelve, who were baptized by you and were purified like gold: cleanse from us the mist of our sins and clothe us with the light of glory.

AS-3361b98ef216.t: You came to earth divinely to judge the world with authority, concerning righteousness and sin and the judgment of the evil one; you opened your immaterial treasure, you gave gifts to the sons of men: we [cut off]

AS-bb246b8b40cd.t: Love, out of love, sent forth your Love into himself; through you he joined his members together, his Church which he built; with seven pillars [?] you established it; in it he set the apostles, a sevenfold company, adorned with your graces; purify from us the [cut off]

AS-01febc69c9d1.t: By the prayers of your worthy ones remember our departed when you come in ineffable glory to repay people according to their works, and grant that our departed be numbered with your saints.

AS-3f5b33c68166.t: You, Virgin and Mother and dwelling of the divine Incarnation, we thank and bless exceedingly, you who have poured out [?] saving life for the human race; therefore we bless you, Theotokos and Virgin, mother and handmaid of our Savior.

AS-43264f23a8e4.t: The Offspring of the Father and of the Ancient of Days, the timeless one, dwelt in your womb in the time of the ages and was not parted from the Father; for [cut off]

AS-aa23052aa74d.t: Exalted King, who for our sake went up on the cross and took away through it.

AS-d9efc25ae445.t: the transgression of the first-created Adam: we entreat.

AS-15023d782046.t: Heaven rejoiced and the earth was glad, for the holy Cross was shown to be the Savior and the light-giver of the universe: we entreat.

AS-be4275e927bc.t: But the lawless disciple, abandoning the tenderness of his love, hastened to the priests. He said: What will you give me, that I may betray the Teacher?

AS-b9d49f58c170.t: The Jews gathered and weighed out much silver; they took him and led him to Pilate, saying: Crucify, crucify, for he is a blasphemer of the law.

AS-a6f40b9a1efa.t: You came down from heaven, beginningless Son, to the earthly nature of men; you took upon yourself the sufferings; we bless you, who existed before all ages.

AS-3b301731528b.t: You who said by the word that all the earth should come to be: the creatures stood in the court on earth and saw; we bless you who were before all ages.

AS-1ac296152f8f.t: Before whom the watchers of heaven tremble, today you came willingly to the cross and were pierced by the spear; we bless you who were before all ages.

AS-83991a39087d.t: Bless the Lord, exalt Him forever.

AS-4113727856ab.t: And the soldier, rushing with the spear, pierced the side of the Life-giver: exalt him forever.

AS-b9f9f0d2745e.t: From there a life-giving fountain gushed forth and washed the universe of sins; exalt [him].

AS-6aabef049788.t: Mother of the Light of light and dwelling of the life-giving Word, all races and peoples will call you blessed.

AS-c02508cf735e.t: Mother of the Creator and of the renewer of the ancient form: you [cut off]

AS-c059d6a16121.t: You who are King of kings, Christ, condemned by a servant, enduring for our sake, long-suffering Lord, glory to You.

AS-83571b3d0529.t: by the pouring out, you willed to give us life, long-suffering one.

AS-954b251bb1be.t: Him whom the heavens could not bear, carrying the wood of punishment on his shoulder and coming to the place of execution to ascend the cross: the immortal King.

AS-11d6d4b25093.t: The powers of heaven were amazed at the burial of the Lord in a new tomb; for he who is immortal in essence tasted death for the salvation of creation: the immortal King.

AS-53987ef2f053.t: Today the ineffable Light dawns, the fulfilment of our salvation; He descends to the upper room, the completion of the shadowy feasts. First He spread the supper of the mystery, and He who wraps the light in a cloth took water and, as a servant, washed the feet of the disciples.

AS-8ba41fe03dbc.t: The Word, Father of the glory of light: Peter would not allow [him] to draw near to his feet; of that hand whose works are the heaven of heavens and the earthly things, by which the blind [?]

AS-b818db23585c.t: To the ranks of his disciples, whom he had first taught by the word of teachers, today by deed he showed in himself the utmost humility: he served the earthen ones, he who is invisible to the fiery ones; he carried out the service of his servants, he who is worshiped by the seraphim.

AS-9f67cb5fad78.t: "If I," He says, "who am Lord and Teacher of all, washed the feet of you disciples and servants from the old filth of one another, show also, you who are of one nature, the same humility, the raising of the one who has fallen to ruin, and the restoration of your fallen nature."

AS-c37e9df6f7aa.t: You whom You cleansed with pure hands in the font, whose feet You washed, and taught by humility to be victorious over the evil proud one; wash also my [?] from the mire of sins by the supplications of the holy company, and straighten my steps with humility, with ascents to the heavens.

AS-62a9082a68e1.t: You fulfilled the law of Moses which he spoke on Sinai: you ate the lamb of the type and the unleavened bread with the reed, changing the old into the new, turning the shadow into light by making it true; in place of the lamb you yourself, being the Lamb of God, offered yourself.

AS-d4ecbb0482d7.t: In place of the unleavened bread you gave your body, heavenly, born of a virgin, without seed, incorruptible and spiritual; in place of the blood of the sheep of the covenant you gave us your blood, a second covenant, and in place of the bitter reed, the divine wine [?].

AS-83ef1299f56a.t: The King of creatures gave the bread of life to the hungry, and the cup that gladdens to those who were grieved by Adam: This is the new covenant in my blood, in place of the old covenant of blood; do this in remembrance of me until I come again.

AS-4b59503249b5.t: Gathered together, we ask you, with the eleven who were gathered, to whom you gave your life-giving body, distributed with the cup: grant us also, Lord, to partake with them of your table of the bread of life, which we long for, and of the drink, for which we thirst.

AS-0aff5739c7fe.t: From among the chosen disciples Judas, separated from the holy flock, was betraying to death for silver the Lamb of God who takes away sin; at the spiritual supper the shameless and deceitful one drew near, eating with the Teacher, and multiplied his deceit.

AS-9ec2b833ee77.t: The Light spoke imploringly to the darkened one, for his return: One of you, brothers, will betray me to death. Peter, hearing this, was alarmed and signaled to John to ask who the betrayer of the Teacher might be.

AS-74a6efd35d70.t: With the care of love for His beloved ones He dispelled their sorrow; He gives a dipped morsel to Judas, marking the thief and betrayer, who took it, was stripped of the grace of the divine Spirit, and was handed over to the Primal Evil One for the betrayal of the Teacher.

AS-020a9cbe7dec.t: When the darkness-lover was deprived of the supreme Light and went out, the Lord revealed the light of what was to come: that they would be scandalized in the night. He spoke encouragingly to Peter and rebuked him for the cock's crow; He spoke of His own departure from the world and told of the coming of the Spirit.

AS-55533121d74d.t: Beyond the valley of Kidron He went up to the upper room of the mystery and entered a garden; by a garden He brought Adam into the Eden of Paradise. Lord, bring us in also with him, from where You first brought out the first one, that we may again be worthy to inherit our homeland.

AS-500e9da1bcc9.t: He was anxious over the sufferings, sorrowful, having taken the three apart, to save the world; the spirit is willing, but the nature of my flesh is weak; not one strong and powerful, and another

AS-250cc8281f8c.t: powerless, endangered, yet one and the same, being united, he bore the form willingly.

AS-5ec986f71437.t: With a voice of prayer he entreated his Father, of one essence with him, on my behalf; he bent the knee in humility, he before whom every knee is bent: if the salvation of men is possible without my death, as it is written, let the cup of death pass from me; not by my will but by yours.

AS-0b2d9350cc30.t: Shaken in fear, with the flow of sweat, like drops of blood falling, as an angel drew near to strengthen Him, the scripture of the law being fulfilled: for the God the Word, having taken a perfect human nature, had to bear fear and sorrow in Himself as part of the dispensation.

AS-813e4a87dd3b.t: You who are the radiance of glory were distressed in Your human nature; in the night You prayed to the Father in heaven. Cause the heavenly light to dawn in us and dispel the fear of the evil one; may the parts of our souls and our body be nailed in Your holy fear.

AS-efa31d3d2f76.t: Judas drew near, he who was to betray, together with the company of the Pharisees; they fell like those cast down who will never rise. Judas, treacherously kissing, giving a sign and occasion of death, betrayed Him in return for love, repaying evil for good.

AS-6be0f3a42723.t: Then, out of the kindness of love, Peter cut off with a sword the right ear of the servant named Malchus, who did not listen to his Lord; but our Lord quickly drew near to the ear, healed it as a physician, divinely, a sight the blind did not see.

AS-7480a096c4f6.t: The little new flock scattered, for the brave Shepherd was struck; Peter alone went after him, shaken by the maid of the rock; the cock, as signed, spoke; the Lord looked at Peter; he remembered the word and wept bitterly, and from his fall was raised again.

AS-04264dc77371.t: To Peter, the grace-endowed rock of the Church, whom you kept from being scattered and raised from his fall for the sake of his heartfelt weeping, raise me also, Lord, with him, from the stumbling fall, giving my eyes abundant tears and water like the sea for my head.

AS-0d51f32a9469.t: O, him who was willingly bound, the unbindable, the loosener of hands: they led him to the courts of Caiaphas and Annas. A servant struck that face before which the seraph veils himself with wings, and with his defiled mouth spat upon him who gave light to the blind with spittle.

AS-3784075f3f92.t: Loosener of the bonds of men, who were bound with the one who binds: release me from the self-made bonds of sin, the chains of hell. You who stood innocent in the court condemned together with sinners, when You come in the Father's glory, do not judge me with them.

AS-1eb2acd7c5c8.t: With the shame of the old Adam, You who were mocked on his account, wipe away the shame of the shameless sin with which they covered my face. You who allowed the evil servant to bring his hand to strike You, strike forcefully the face of the evil one, as he struck me violently.

AS-16813e01905d.t: The Lamp of light, at dawn on the Friday of the old Passover, stood before the judge; the Servant sat in the court. When Pilate questioned Him the Lord gave no answer, for the scripture foretold it would be fulfilled: I have become like a man who does not speak.

AS-c2c49c404752.t: The rabble ranks of the soldiers put on Him a garment of mockery, Him whose garment is the light of glory, wrapped about Himself like a cloak; kneeling down they jested, struck His head with a reed, and wove a crown of thorns for Him who bears the thorn of sins.

AS-ea0382572646.t: The One dreaded by the Cherubim carried the wood of the Cross Himself to the place of Golgotha, where, having set Him down, they gave Him wine mixed with myrrh to drink and food mixed with gall, by which He changed for us the bitter taste of the fruit into sweetness and delight.

AS-f81189725a66.t: The heavenly ones, struck with awe, saw the Lord stripped, and the

AS-c87bb1b017e0.t: Hands stretched out against hands, feet against the feet that had walked, wood against wood of the bitter fruit, exchanging life for death; between two lawless men stood stripped the Giver of the law, whom the nation of the blind did not see, except one of the robbers.

AS-b7a7f9b57cd6.t: Your whole body, divided, after the judge's sentence took a severe blow of scourging, on account of the scourging of the first-created. Heal me again, who from foot to head am afflicted with unbearable pain, as by the grace of the font.

AS-ee187bd22384.t: They gave You gall to drink and vinegar in Your thirst, which You drank willingly that the taste of the bitter fruit might be sweetened. AS-5560d6f835dd.t: Today the Spirit, co-essential with the Father and the Son, descending in fire-radiant dawning into the upper room, baptized the ranks of the apostles in unconsuming fire: bless the Lord, exalt him forever.

AS-d1f172fa6990.t: Today the Spirit, co-creator with the Father and the Son, gushing forth as immaterial living water in Jerusalem, for wisdom and the cleansing of sins: bless the Lord and exalt him forever.

AS-e0d260c50464.t: Rejoice, Mother of God, blessed from on high by the seraphim; since light has dawned from you for us, you became mother of the one who raises up the race; we, the people and the nations, magnify you.

AS-dda53683af1c.t: You became the foundation of the Church, you became the sanctuary of the Holy Spirit; served by the angels, Gabriel brought you the good news; we peoples and nations magnify you.

AS-bd5a7e88b621.t: We behold the awesome, wondrous mystery revealed: having conceived by the Holy Spirit, you bore the Word, God, in the flesh; we peoples and nations magnify you.

AS-04abfc30f8b6.t: You who rested with sevenfold graces upon the sprouting rod of Jesse: Spirit of God and of counsel, Spirit of meekness and power, Spirit of wisdom and knowledge, Spirit of the fear of godliness: we beseech you, grant us also, in mercy, of your gifts.

AS-9a4fe57423e2.t: You who foretold through Isaiah the one anointed by you in the flesh, who says: 'The Spirit of the Lord is upon me', which, in the dispensation, in humility, he read as concerning himself, the word of the prophet: we beseech you, grant us also, in mercy, of your gifts.

AS-83166c3716a2.t: You who made known through the prophets the sending of the Word into the world from the Father and from your Spirit, which he proclaimed in the person of the one made man to humanity: 'The Lord, the Lord has sent me, and his Spirit'; we beseech you, grant us also, in mercy, of your gifts.

AS-8ebc55ef320e.t: With the heavenly, spirit-born ranks we sing to the Creator of spirits: glorified is the coming of the Holy Spirit.

AS-002f3507da68.t: With the company of the apostles we today rejoice and cry out in spirit: glorified is the coming of the Holy Spirit.

AS-483c1f15087f.t: Here, in the upper room of Zion, new sons, sing with the voice of those on high: glorified is the coming of the Holy Spirit.

AS-ffedcc2d8455.t: Today the sorrowful and nocturnal birth-pangs of the first mother are loosed; for those born in the flesh to death and corruption, the Spirit gives birth anew as children of light to the heavenly Father; there[fore] [?]

AS-28439f0f9d6d.t: In the tabernacle of those who love you give rest to your servants, and number their souls among your saints, that they may not return [cut off]

AS-958427df5e23.t: We magnify the holy Mother of God with blessing. The angel of good tidings proclaimed the newborn Saviour from the holy Virgin. He says: Rejoice, you who are full of gladness, for the Lord of lords is with you.

AS-242d83c012ea.t: The choirs of angels, having come down from heaven, sing, saying in a wonderful voice, chanting songs of blessing with a threefold holy voice.

AS-893958e40292.t: Rejoice, be glad, betrothed holy Church; make your children shine in praise of the one who made the ray of light dawn in you, Mother Church.

AS-aed786086302.t: Rejoice today, holy Church, and celebrate your feast, daughter of Zion, for the Lord God was pleased to dwell in you, [God] of our fathers.

AS-31fb1e42a4fb.t: Rejoice, queen, daughter of Zion, and exult, upper Jerusalem, for Christ, the King of heaven, comes to you. Lord God of the fathers [cut off].

AS-a22a1557f776.t: Rejoice, Zion, mother Church, for in you the divine ray has dawned from the Father of light: Lord, [God of our fathers] ... (abbreviated).

AS-97220e4ee105.t: Bless the Lord, and exalt him forever. He who today crowned the holy Church with the sign of his Cross: bless the Lord [cut off]

AS-c565c27e9b5a.t: Who by a second birth of the holy font enlightened the race of the sons of men: with song, the Lord [cut off]

AS-5ea1fb141ed1.t: Rejoice, Mother of God, blessed above the seraphim; the light that dawned from you made you mother of him who lifts up; nations and peoples, we magnify you.

AS-e6a9da0d7bb3.t: You were made the foundation of the Church, a tabernacle and [?] of the Holy Spirit; Gabriel, served by the angels, announced good tidings to you; the race and [cut off]

AS-0c4fc312b00e.t: We behold the awesome, wondrous mystery revealed: having conceived by the Holy Spirit, you bore the Word, God, in the flesh; we peoples and nations magnify you.

AS-e79257ecef14.t: You who established your Church by the word, Christ, upon the apostolic rock, to sing in it spiritual songs.

AS-62b660b8d8cd.t: Established in it is a table of holiness; he distributes his body and blood, and gives us from it renewal for the forgiveness of our sins.

AS-523952cc392a.t: The Holy Spirit having descended in the appearance of a dove upon the body and blood of the Lord, for the healing of our souls.

AS-a0f705e75d19.t: Be illumined, Jerusalem, adorn your strongholds, for the heavenly Bridegroom has drawn near to you; granting you salvation, he crowned you with his marvellous glory.

AS-b7cc05016a7c.t: Today there has dawned for you, O queen, daughter of Zion, the Sun of righteousness, Christ; and the graces of the Holy Spirit were spread over you with great gifts.

AS-6f8bfaf9d169.t: Today rejoice, holy Zion, mother Church; make your children shine like the sun, for Christ the King has filled you with ineffable joy.

AS-6b30c8a6f8b2.t: He came down from the Father, and the light of glory with him; voices resounded, the underworld [?] of the abyss.

AS-3409d6c1c642.t: Having seen the great light, the patriarch Gregory told it with rejoicing to the believing king.

AS-60d9873661c2.t: Come, let us build the holy tabernacle of light, for in it light dawned on us in the land of Armenia.

AS-902f6b2bc66c.t: Blessing. Today the holy ones gathered together, the blessed apostles and the holy virgins, made radiant in torch-bright garments, lit their lamps and said with one voice: Blessed are you, all-blessed among women.

AS-1a3e42af1fac.t: Today, having laid the holy Virgin at the door of the tomb, they waited and looked for the Lord himself, and above them they saw the Creator coming with many angels; and with one voice they said: Blessed are you, all-blessed, among women.

AS-2552e703f4dc.t: Today, seeing the holy Virgin borne aloft through the air and lifted up to heaven in chariots of cloud, entering the heavenly tabernacles with the wise virgins; and with one voice they said: Blessed are you, all-blessed, among women.

AS-b80903a1502c.t: Today, entering with the many-eyed cherubim and the six-winged seraphim into the seven-starred tabernacles, and seeing the various thrones prepared for you, the Lord's own: we too sing, saying: Blessed are you, all-blessed, among women.

AS-b22eee863d0b.t: Today the Word, God, translated to the heavenly ones the mother of virginity, deliverer of the foremother from transgressions, placing her in the God-made tabernacles and in ineffable life; therefore with a voice of exultation the holy Church sings to you the new praise.

AS-09c4e8a6886a.t: Today the Lady-Mother, the holy Virgin, having delivered her sanctified spirit into the hands of the angelic ranks, shining forth most radiant, was made like the awesome fiery ranks; wherefore the holy Church sings to you with a voice of rejoicing a new doxology.

AS-67b7b6f3a603.t: Today, at the wondrous calling of the Spirit, the holy apostles gathered, and the wise holy virgins, made radiant with wisdom at the heavenly translation of the Mother of God, and in harmony with the incorporeal ones, were blessing the all-blessed holy one.

AS-2d066285ae43.t: Today the fiery-formed ranks, seeing the Only-begotten Son come down from heaven in sun-bright, wondrous glory, at the giving up of the most radiant, purified spirit of his all-holy parent; and, in concord, the bodiless ones blessed the all-blessed holy one.

AS-82a4e4c936e9.t: Today the dwelling of the Holy Spirit is translated from the supernal fire-born kinds into heaven, entering the Jerusalem above, the incorruptible bridal chamber, unapproachable to us created beings, with the Trinity; and, in concord, the bodiless ones blessed the all-blessed holy one.

AS-8e900f46a9e6.t: Today she who took away the birth-pangs of the first mother by her virginal childbearing

AS-44ee2defe1d1.t: Today the Only-begotten, descending in glory, translated the unwedded mother, who by virgin birth took away the sentence of our first parents, into the noetic and ineffable supreme nature; wherefore with seraphic voice we sing to you, holy of holies, an ever-present glorification.

AS-f7e771028e7c.t: Today the awestruck ranks of the fiery ones, seeing this earthen nature, a body borne up from the bodiless by chariots of fiery substance into the heavenly and unapproachable luminous tabernacles; wherefore with seraphic voice we sing to you, holy of holies, an ever-present glorification.

AS-fdddcce19f4d.t: Today the holy Church, the betrothed, being a fellow-celebrant with the spiritual ones, celebrates with joy the memory of the incorrupt, immaculate Virgin, the Mother of God; wherefore with seraphic voice we sing to you, holy of holies, an ever-present glorification.

AS-dbad56f31594.t: You who are blessed in the heights of heaven by lofty words, holy one coming from Lebanon, bride clothed today with the sun, the moon under your feet, in light-filled blessing and song the churches of the world celebrate today the memory of your birth from your mother.

AS-41dcbb0d81af.t: Loftier than the seraphim and the many-eyed cherubim, Lady Mother of God: ark of the covenant, golden urn, mystical tabernacle of the Word of the Most High Father; with blessing and song the churches of the world today celebrate the memory of your birth from your mother.

AS-d91646223e1b.t: Meeting-place of the prophets and pledge of life for mankind, Mary, Mother of God, receptacle of the sevenfold graces, anchor of the firmness of hope, equal in number to the days of this passing age; with blessing and song the churches of the world today celebrate the memory of your birth from your mother.

AS-596cc2016274.t: Rejoice, Mary, holy Mother of God, for the Lord suddenly came into your purified temple; with blessing we magnify you.

AS-23f9dce2c921.t: Rejoice, closed door through which no one entered but the Lord God of Israel; we magnify you with blessing.

AS-9a94845f08a8.t: Rejoice, sealed fountain of the water of life, which you gave to our thirsting nature to drink; we magnify you with blessing.

AS-0ae1de2d3dfc.t: Mother of light, Mary, holy Virgin, who in the flesh bore the Light from the Father and became the dawn of the Sun of Righteousness, with a spiritual song we magnify you, holy one.

AS-a62f6590ee6b.t: You were a throne higher than the cherubim, and the tree of life of immortal fruit; the ark of the covenant of the Word and the golden jar of heavenly manna: with spiritual song we magnify you, holy one.

AS-ed2f8c4a2392.t: Through you the seraph-closed door of paradise was opened, and through you the tree of immortality was given to us; on it the immortal one slain today shone from the heavens: with spiritual song we magnify you, holy one.

AS-9435c9e51de3.t: Spotless Virgin, Mother of God, Mary, holy one and Mother of Christ, you carried in your womb the One who is beyond all comprehension; with blessing we magnify you, Mother of God.

AS-060b6d9c59cf.t: You, the heavenly gate that Ezekiel saw, and the fleece that Gideon knew; earthly seraph, more exalted than the cherubim: we bl[ess] [cut off]

AS-a92d9287800d.t: Three fearful mysteries are seen in you, Mother of God: [continues in the next fragment].

AS-003cf584ab07.t: Pregnancy without seed, birth without blemish, virginity remaining incorrupt after the birth: bless [cut off]

AS-96d0d57d01e5.t: The Dove sent forth, descending with a great resounding sound from on high, in the likeness of a flash of light, the unconsuming fiery tongues, upon the disciples

AS-4bf2744c9e4b.t: Immaterial dove, unsearchable, who searches the depths of God, who, receiving from the Father, tells of the awesome thing and of the second coming, which they preached as of one essence.

AS-81680254a76e.t: Blessing to the Holy Spirit who ascended on high from the Father, by whom the apostles were made drunk with the immortal cup and invited the earth into the heavens.

AS-56a0dc23476c.t: Father without beginning, Creator of the ages, we call upon You and entreat: give rest to our departed in Your holy name.

AS-47947d8b27aa.t: Only-begotten Son, consubstantial with the Father and the Spirit, at your second coming raise up our departed [cut off]

AS-c9ab4ba13f0b.t: True Spirit, co-glorious with the Father and the Son, through the entreaties of the Mother of God give rest [cut off]

AS-b08dd768e0db.t: Today the bodiless watchers raised up the pure body of the Virgin Mother of God and gathered it into the place of the exalted, to make it a sharer of the ineffable things beyond the visible senses; wherefore: Today the holy Church sings to you a new hymn of praise [cut off]

AS-3b79b4d26998.t: the holy Church, a new hymn of praise.

AS-56c2fb076332.t: With joy that gives cause for hope and with unceasing sound we of the earth sing to you, together with the fiery [?] orders, celebrating the memory of the Virgin, your handmaid and mother: wherefore joyful [cut off]

AS-7991fa23ef37.t: You who took away the transgressions of our first mother and father, and were born in the flesh as your only-begotten Son, today you have transferred the Nativity of the first-created from us to the heights above, whom we always have as an intercessor before you, Lord, God of our fathers.

AS-59fa2919a75f.t: You who are of one being with the Father and the Holy Spirit, you consented to take flesh of the holy Virgin; today you translated her who bore you and set her among the heavenly tabernacles; whom we ever have as intercessor with you, Lord God of our fathers.

AS-3bc6bdec1813.t: You who fill all things, providential Holy Spirit, today with gifts you gave rest, in ineffable life, to the mother of virginity; whom we ever have as intercessor with you, Lord God of our fathers.

AS-04362d19b655.t: Bless the Lord, exalt the one who bore the unbearable Word, the ever-virgin.

AS-9fea240fee67.t: You who are glorified by the virgin choirs and by the holy ascetics, holy one: therefore we the faithful also honour your translation into heaven, you who are exalted higher forever.

AS-ea67ecd7515c.t: You who are ceaselessly blessed by the powers above, and who were translated to the ranks of the apostles and mar [cut off]

AS-f4e764c6539a.t: You who are blessed unceasingly always by the powers on high, and who were translated to the ranks of the apostles and prophets; with them we the faithful also honour the feast of your God-bearing repose; you who are exalted yet more forever.

AS-005927a2bed6.t: You were fashioned as a vaulted tabernacle, holy Virgin Mother of God; you bore the incomprehensible Word, God, naturally and without seed in your womb; with unceasing song we always magnify you.

AS-7df30b8b3162.t: Gate of heaven, you bore in your arms the ineffable, incorrupt Dawning who was sent from the Father, nursing with your holy virginal milk him who was made flesh from you; with unceasing song we always magnify you.

AS-c3d186cfa84d.t: Mother of God, you were translated on high into the cherubic chariots, served by the seraphim and worshipped by the bodiless hosts; with unceasing song we always magnify you.

AS-76c8c8bdb174.t: You who hold authority over death and life, Christ, King of glory: have mercy on us, O God.

AS-3da297f538bf.t: Celebrating the memory of the Virgin, Mother of the Son of God, the angels rejoice in heaven and the ranks of apostles and prophets exult in the virginal feast: have mer[cut off]

AS-af7cba1d55f0.t: To you alone, Mother and Virgin, we pray, asking of you: intercede unceasingly with your Son and our God to save us from temptation and from all our dangers.

AS-55616afa5ff1.t: Beginningless God, inaccessible nature, resting upon a fiery chariot; for which [cut off]

AS-b443a10729ca.t: [cut off] praising, we say: blessed are you, Father, beginningless God.

AS-724acbad9dea.t: Pearl-like and purple-clad, most wondrously glorious Virgin, whom the Son took and, translating her, placed in ineffable life; therefore, praising, we say: blessed are You, only-begotten Son, God.

AS-d60103bc8151.t: Unapproachable power of the Spirit, by which the all-encompassing light embraced her, translating the virgin person into the ineffable, unapproachable and unending light; therefore, blessing, we say: blessed are You, Spirit, true God.

AS-80128c39ff25.t: Unfading flower, blameless shoot that sprang up again from the root of Jesse, Isaiah foretold you beforehand as the receptacle of the sevenfold grace of the Spirit, Mother of God and Virgin; we magnify you.

AS-145b24fc1e24.t: Sweet-tasting fruit of the rational vine, from which was cultivated for us the inexhaustible cluster, a joy to those saddened by the tasting of the tree of knowledge; spotless holy one, all of us magnify you.

AS-612ef7b2072c.t: Having lived in the flesh with a blameless way of life, today you were gathered among the apostles and, by a gaze from above, were translated into the kingdom of your Son and our God; intercede for us who confess you; we magnify you.

AS-2bdd4a11137b.t: Blessing. Today, Lord, you transferred the servant of your ineffable birth-mystery from the earthly substance of dust into the heavens.

AS-fbc9b9dfb3a8.t: Today You raised up from the lowest places to the supreme abodes the bearer of Your unbearable Word, the earthly Cherub [?].

AS-831fe4947eaf.t: Today the incorrupt Virgin, who nourished You with pure milk, was transferred from perceptible natures to the intelligible tabernacles.

AS-069748b8e405.t: The unsearchable light hidden in the bosom of the Father, who dawned from you, Mother and Virgin, today descended; the bodiless ranks of the fiery ones carried you in luminous clouds into the shadowless light.

AS-0ac08761451e.t: Most radiant East and light-bearing dwelling, you bore, motherless, the First-born, and without a father you were born of the Second; intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, Mother of the Word.

AS-0b2de49e3fc4.t: Body-dwelling of the Word of the Father and bridal chamber of his habitation, you who nourished with virginal milk the existing Word: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-7f2d70d430bf.t: With supreme holiness and virginal purity you bore in your embrace, with nourishment, him who is by nature unattainable: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-0c2ea40bf2a6.t: You are the unfading flower of the lineage of the human race, and the shoot of blessing of the first parent of our nature: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-9939254d4c47.t: You became a temple for the heavenly King, according to the singer; and suddenly seated in the bridal chamber of your Bridegroom [?]: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-23cad76819ac.t: The hosts of heaven, the bodiless, intelligible watchers, came down from heaven to earth to serve the great King: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-2f4747c8bdc8.t: The Word of the Father, ever-existing, was circumscribed in the flesh; the Light, womb-born, took the nature of the first-formed: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-a770d1869d5a.t: Chosen beforehand, before the foundations, from the beginning of the world, an ineffable, unsearchable scroll [?] and a light, light-bearing cloud: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-087101adc132.t: A heavenly crown, woven and set with gems by the eyes of the bodiless, was brought as a wreath for the holy Virgin when she was translated to the world above: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-8aedfc19d81e.t: The holy company gathered, the band of the twelve ranks, swooping like eagles to Jerusalem, the great city: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-b20e7d31a2c9.t: And there came the multitude of the disciples of the new testament to the translation of the Mother of God, the pearl-radiant holy Virgin: intercede with the Only-begotten, Mother of God, mother of the Word.

AS-74f36dc0926f.t: Light from the light of the Father, born of his bosom, you came down from heaven to the lower world; the ranks of the bodiless came down with you in honor of your Mother and Virgin, and praising her they said: You are the temple of the uncreated Word.

AS-37b6d2a9619c.t: A profound, unsearchable mystery, hidden from the generations of the ages, was mani-

AS-87fd865077cf.t: A profound, unsearchable mystery, hidden from the generations of the ages, was revealed in the last years for the salvation of the human race; which the seers made known: that the Virgin would be the mother of the Word.

AS-b43f2b6c9938.t: The hidden mystery of the Eternal One, silent and ineffable, was granted to the human race when the time came: the essential nature of the Word, joined without confusion to our nature.

AS-9218aaef8f12.t: Through your perfect dispensation on earth in the incarnation, which you accomplished at the end of the ages for the sake of humankind, today you, the Word of the Father, came down from heaven to the falling asleep of your Virgin Mother.

AS-9c1cdd30d1a9.t: The hosts of the heavenly powers came down and circled around the Virgin; taking up songs of blessing, they chanted with sweet voice, gathered in an assembly, singing together the one Lordship, praising.

AS-cb12025b83fc.t: Having joined their voice, the ranks of the blessed chosen leaders, borne aloft by the Spirit, in harmony with the bodiless ones praised the holy virgin in hymn.

AS-031253bb5f94.t: Lit with lamp-bright torches, gathered with the holy virgins, taking up songs of blessing they sang in honor of the all-blessed Mother: You are blessed, Virgin, praised, from whom God the Word was born.

AS-730279a8944c.t: Radiance of the Father, born of his bosom, when you went up to the Father in heaven you promised by your word, for the fulfillment of the Mother of God, that you alone would come with your hosts to the translation of the ever-Virgin.

AS-1201cec9e974.t: Radiant pearl, house and temple of the Holy Spirit, the foretold words of the prophets were today fulfilled in you altogether; Moses with his ranks hastened there completely in your honor.

AS-ff2c8d971911.t: A voice of praise attuned in joy, the day of your feast with a new praise of the company of the apostles; you handed over your holy spirit into the hands of your only-begotten Son.

AS-26d55a6887aa.t: A new wonder of marvels was wrought there on earth, for the spirit of the holy Virgin shone more brightly than the sun; Peter, astonished, asked the Lord openly about the mystery.

AS-02bc5af618d1.t: Adorned with grace and shining in glory, as your mother, ever praised by people, who [?], with a radiant spirit like the sun, kindled like lightning, borne up from the heavenly ones.

AS-497ce1bb3964.t: O Peter, hear the voice, the answer to what you ask: the first light is called Father, and after it, in order, the bright one; the souls of people are created as my own mother, whom I have shown.

AS-ec9bef984bfd.t: Mingled in a nature of four elements, with breath placed in the middle as a bond; those whom I adorned with glory in paradise and gave to enjoy, and now have granted the same to you, brightly cleansed with my blood.

AS-05f58f671521.t: The company of the bodiless, grace-adorned angels, swooping from the heavenly ones, lifted the Virgin from the earth; and the apostles, looking up to them, sounded the songs of blessing of hymns.

AS-8c8987b85e32.t: -[?] the hymns of blessing they sound with songs.

AS-37020dfe06ee.t: Clothed in torches, the holy virgins with the pure companies of the ranks, the twelve holy bands and their disciples, in harmony with one another, chant songs of blessing.

AS-2c5bd2d1a8a7.t: The path of the light of holiness poured out for the bodiless powers, and the fiery hosts of angels, advancing to the world above, praise you, O holy one of the holy, with a voice of joyful songs.

AS-e437606bf62a.t: The hosts of the Seraphim were amazed when they saw the Lord come down at the translation of the incorrupt and ever-Virgin Mother of God; astonished, they said: You are blessed, holy Mother of God.

AS-defe14f3e8a1.t: More exalted than the seraphim and higher than the cherubim, you were lifted up on high above the changeable, the untouchable one, glorified together with the Only-begotten with a rejoicing voice of songs.

AS-283d714865a7.t: Dominions and Powers, Authorities and Principalities, archangels and angels chant songs of blessing: You are blessed, Virgin, purified temple in which the Creator of beings dwelt.

AS-75d6ddc663f0.t: The company of rabbis, the ranks of the disciples, lifting the pure, God-bearing body in their holy arms, laid it in the place of rest, singing with psalms.

AS-44ede2ea8c3e.t: With joyful rejoicing and flowing tears they chanted with sweet songs for three days in gathered choirs; Bartholomew came afterwards and did not see the one he longed for.

AS-ac0d8107a660.t: The holy ranks, having fulfilled the wish of their brother [?], opened the all-blessed tomb and did not find the one he desired, for she had been translated into ineffable glory, prepared beforehand.

AS-06f037941ff6.t: Glory to the Father who is of one essence, honor to his consubstantial Son, together with the Spirit of equal rank, who adorned the Virgin on earth to inherit the ineffable good that his Only-begotten prepared.

AS-b84f0beed39e.t: For the mystery of the Virgin's glory among the bodiless is ineffable, which in these last ages he poured out on lowly people, whom now, rejoicing in hope, he will favor then, when they hope.

AS-d1f577852645.t: Maker of all that exists, of things intelligible and lowly, good teacher of the bodiless, you received honor from earthly beings with the Virgin's feast of the translation; may we be made worthy of adoption.

AS-ceb1ea9a3fd1.t: Therefore intercede, Mother of God, Mother of the Word, that, with soul and body returned again to love of the Bridegroom, we may be made worthy of the fruit of paradise, of the plant of blessed life.

AS-d445e5bb1540.t: At the ascending of the Word into heaven and his sitting at the right hand of the Father, the apostles, rejoicing, worshiped, blessing the Father who sent the Word.

AS-b03ddc11e057.t: The gathered company of the saints in the upper room of the mystery, with eyes lifted up, awaited the Spirit; bles[sing] [cut off]

AS-1cc6899f7414.t: By a sudden sound poured out, the life-giving spring of light, adorned with the light of immortal life, those who blessed the Father who sent the Spirit.

AS-8a7cdabb8e4d.t: We beseech You, King of glory, glorified by the angels: receive our departed, O loving Lord, and give them rest with Your saints.

AS-39bb55ee2024.t: When you come in the glory of the Father to judge the earth, O Sun of righteousness, the departed [cut off]

AS-21b8f9b403b9.t: When you sit in judgment, awesome Judge, Christ our Savior and hope, the departed [cut off]

AS-2889ac11b75e.t: The incorporeal Word, who was made flesh from you and was borne in your arms, Mary, today came with a multitude of angelic hosts and lifted you up in fiery-formed chariots into the shadowless light.

AS-511b16815433.t: At the sight of the wonders of the glory of the Only-begotten, the choirs of the apostles rejoiced, and, in harmony with the heavenly angels, they sang a new blessing to you: blessed are you among women.

AS-1854b8eb4265.t: You who took away the dwelling of the first mother and father, today you restored your only-begotten Son's dwelling to its first glory; we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-9298ec6ef81b.t: You who are the radiance of the light from the Father's bosom: her who bore you in the flesh you translated today into ineffable life; we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-f73d3bb29148.t: You who are the Spirit co-glorified with the Father: the temple overshadowed by you, you gave rest today in the unapproachable light; we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-b2ffdedd01f6.t: Praise the Lord; together with the only-begotten Son, praise Mary, the all-blessed mother, and exalt her forever.

AS-21e9f07de348.t: Today with the heavenly watchers on high, who came down with the Only-begotten at the translation of the Mother of God and sang: bless the heavenly Father, exalt him forever.

AS-3e61b69fe772.t: Today with the ranks of the seraphim, who, circling around the tomb of the holy Virgin, sang melodies: praise the Only-begotten Son, exalt him forever.

AS-12496402d49a.t: Today with the fiery cherubim, who lift up the earthly cherub with the sound of the trumpet to the heavens: bless the true Spirit, exalt him forever.

AS-d058f4a0822d.t: Mother of God, luminous cloud, who poured the dew of life upon the earth, rational one, and quenched the fire of the first mother's debts; with unceasing voice we bless you and with spiritual song we magnify you.

AS-0ad79807b98b.t: Unbearable place of the Word and enclosed field in which the Light was clothed, and east of the Sun of righteousness, with [unceasing] voice we bles-

AS-78989a5a7d67.t: You, fulfilment of the prophets, by your virginal birth, through which the laws of our nature

AS-1b8db1df95b8.t: from the fiery-born kinds, transferred into the luminous tabernacle without ceasing [cut off].

AS-14f74d024616.t: You who, Lord, in Your incorporeal divine nature united Yourself in body in the womb of the Virgin, remaining unchanged, today You have transferred the joy of heaven and earth to the life without sorrow; by the entreaties of Your mother, have mercy on us, Son of God.

AS-b2bf30edac89.t: You who were born of the holy Virgin in an incorrupt body, and were wrapped in swaddling clothes, you who cast forth light, and rested in a manger: today you gave rest to the Mother of virgins in the light-filled tabernacles. By the intercessions of your Mother, have mercy on us, Son of God.

AS-66f97d7a6a16.t: You who sit upon the cherubic throne with the Father and the Holy Spirit, were pleased to be carried in the flesh in the Virgin's arms and became a nursling: today the cherubim lifted up to the throne of glory the earthly cherub. By the intercessions of your Mother, have mercy on us, Son of God.

AS-8b48da15eb3e.t: You who revealed the rays of your divinity, Savior, and terrified the guards: have mercy.

AS-ae898f80aa14.t: You who were touched by the hands of Thomas, Savior, and entered among the disciples through closed doors: have mer[cy] [cut off]

AS-bd4d621ead8b.t: You who by the death of your Cross gave life to the dead, and by the nailing of your body loosed the bonds of death: let us all sing, for he is glorified [cut off]

AS-b402703e5ec9.t: With the flame of your wrath, Christ, on the Cross you burned up the tyranny of the devil, and by your life-giving Resurrection you saved your Church; you taught us to raise glory to you.

AS-157ecffab1cc.t: You who in place of the bitterness of the tree of Eden gave us your Cross, Christ, and gave us to drink from your pierced side, as from a fountain, unfailing and endless joy.

AS-52d0beb4c89a.t: Life-giving God, loving Spirit, you enlightened those gathered in unity of love with fiery tongues; therefore today we too celebrate your holy coming.

AS-5d3d1ae3d286.t: The holy apostles rejoiced at your coming, calling together in many tongues those scattered from one another, for the sake of [?]: [cut off].

AS-536ca1ef39d3.t: With spiritual holy baptism you adorned the universe through them in shining and newly feathered [?] garments, for the sake of [?]: [cut off].

AS-d6c10bb5b371.t: Glory to you, Father, who are the life-giver of bodies and the creator of souls; receive the souls that bless you into your immortal rest.

AS-75a8f1543086.t: Son of the loving Father, who became a sharer of the image with us creatures of earth, and were crucified: receive my blessing soul into your immortal rest.

AS-2c5bfda17048.t: Almighty Holy Spirit, who give calm to the afflicted and are comforter of souls: receive my blessing soul into your immortal rest.

AS-39fa531f12ca.t: Mother of light, Mary, holy Virgin, who in the flesh bore the Light from the Father and became the dawn of the Sun of Righteousness, with a spiritual song we magnify you, holy one.

AS-1279c393203e.t: You were a throne higher than the cherubim, and the tree of life of immortal fruit, the ark of the covenant of the Word, and the golden jar of the heavenly manna: spir- [cut off]

AS-0fea18630e75.t: By you the seraphic door of paradise was opened, and by you was given to us the tree of immortality, on which the one slain, the immortal, today illumined us from the heavens: spir- [cut off]

AS-9e0412aad486.t: The East, in paradise, presented the wood of the cross, and coming, it was fulfilled at the place of the skull; the wooden structure was raised on the lookout, everlasting, the holy four-armed one, guardian of our souls.

AS-2f1256327467.t: The uncreated Word, consubstantial with the Father and the Holy Spirit, appeared on earth; creation shone with the might of the Powerful One, and he enrolled us again in the grace of adoption.

AS-061d6f7674cb.t: Today, appearing amid bright clouds, the sign of the Lord's cross with a flaming radiance, those who saw it ran to the city and told of your sign, Lord God of our fathers.

AS-071b6f8379d0.t: From the East shone the ray of the holy Cross; all together, in sun-like rays, your sign was seen at the third hour, Lord, God of our fathers.

AS-f1b03417ac1b.t: The holy saving Cross was shown to us as a refuge, that by it we may conquer the lawless enemy; having received on ourselves, as a seal of confirmation, your sign, Lord, God of our fathers.

AS-c6769812eefd.t: Today the sign of the holy Cross appeared from the heavens; come, new peoples, in unity, bless the Lord, exalt him forever.

AS-5204db2cb6d1.t: Today on holy Golgotha a fearful vision shone forth and appeared to the assembly; the priests with song: Bless the Lord, exalt him forever.

AS-220697bd9917.t: Mother of light, Mary, holy Virgin, you who bore in the flesh the Light from the Father, and became the east of the Sun of righteousness: with spiritual song we magnify you, holy one.

AS-9641299c13ee.t: You were a throne higher than the cherubim, and the tree of life of immortal fruit, the ark of the covenant of the Word, and the golden jar of the heavenly manna: with spiritual [song we magnify you]: [cut off].

AS-1bd2add707b7.t: By you the seraph-guarded gate of paradise was opened, and by you was given to us the tree of immortality, on which the immortal one who was slain today shone from the heavens: spiritual [song we magnify you]: [cut off].

AS-8c40c2f780d9.t: The sign of victory appeared from heaven; today the light of mercy dawned upon the Gentiles.

AS-a0f367e37143.t: And the multitude of the assembly saw the holy cross today adorned with rays of light.

AS-02651c19395d.t: At the appearing of your holy cross, Christ, Jerusalem today greatly exulted.

AS-bbc6f749d307.t: And the multitude of the assembly beheld the dawning of the divine light of your sign with its rays.

AS-89b99113b564.t: All-conquering is the power of your cross, Christ, which was shown as a help, fighting against the enemy by your might.

AS-f3358075f2ca.t: You gave us your Cross, Christ, as a rod of power, and by it may we conquer the lawless enemy.

AS-b95afbb3e579.t: This is the weapon of victory, sharpened by the blood of the Son of God, and [cut off]

AS-0931619a3a70.t: This is the Lord's throne, and on it is seated Christ, the Son of God, and [cut off]

AS-d1411bd02736.t: This is the altar of holiness, and on it Christ, the Lamb of God, is offered, and [cut off]

AS-be899d003616.t: This is the forerunner of the day of the Savior's coming, and the crown of the boast of believers, and [cut off]

AS-6337511fad01.t: Blessing. The life-giving Cross, which became our salvation: by it we all bless you.

AS-3a2fb2b693d3.t: You who, Light from the Father of light, shone forth on earth, and a scepter of power for the faithful: by it all ...

AS-7990b553ac5b.t: You who, with a light-shining dawning, were wondrously and gloriously shown to us as a help against the enemy: by it all

AS-fd4c569d3945.t: You who sit on the throne of glory, Word, God, you came down from the Father's bosom and took a body from the Virgin, raising our earthen nature again to the place of the fallen [?] light.

AS-1620175e1413.t: You who raised your cross in the midst of the earth, and by it opened the paradise door guarded by the seraph to the first-created, giving life from the taste of the death-bearing fruit. And by the power of your cross, Christ, you established the catholic Church, a dwelling of your holy Trinity, enlightening the Gentiles in her through a twofold birth.

AS-6eaf28220192.t: You granted to the Church, as a holy of holies, your holy Cross, Lord; for by the outpouring and stretching out of your spotless hands upon it you gathered to yourself the whole rational race of living beings. We entreat you, Lord, keep us under the shadow of your holy Cross.

AS-09ab624a0c5c.t: The ineffable vision of the mystery, which the light-born holy sign showed beforehand; for the fiery seraph, flaming in nature, encircled the midst of the glorious and delightful paradise; we beseech you, Lord, keep us under the shadow of your holy Cross.

AS-a1f1cb700f50.t: A heaven-measured ladder was shown, making a noetic way for the sons of men; they entered through the gate of life; for it was shown mystically to the wondrous Jacob: the heavenly hosts made descents and ascents; we beseech you, Lord, keep us under the shadow of your holy Cross.

AS-fab036abd772.t: The most wondrous wise one proclaimed this wood, by the Spirit, as the tree of life; for the Creator of creatures was lifted up on it, and the side-flowing streams of incorrupt blood blotted out the sin of the one born from the side; we beseech you, Lord, keep us under the shadow of your holy Cross.

AS-cebcb589d180.t: A guide appeared, with pillar-like radiance, to the people of Israel; by the cleaving commanded by the rod, the mountain-risen heap of the waters was changed into the hardness of rock [?]; we beseech [cut off]

AS-3d276164c9ba.t: Working wonders by the cross-shaped raising of Moses' hands against Amalek, he overcame Belial in battle, and the cast image [?], set beneath it by castings [?], he drew away [?]; we entreat [cut off]

AS-c31a12727e2b.t: By the sign of your cross, Lord, the world-ruling darkness trembled and was driven away; for the man who had sinned by the transgressions of the tree, by making him a fellow-sharer of the cross of the tree of life, you crowned him with this all-conquering holy sign; we beseech you, Lord, keep us under the shadow of your holy Cross.

AS-5a59258b1c07.t: To you, Christ, the bestower upon the Catholic Church, we offer the victorious, honored, God-receiving holy sign, a hymn of praise always on high.

AS-b3cc0ed67e6b.t: By your will, Christ, and on the wings of the almighty Holy Spirit and with the choirs of angels, it flew and came to dwell upon Mount Varak.

AS-2cd193eae936.t: Come, peoples, let us worship this divine holy sign; raise your hands together in holiness, and let us always glorify the One who dwells in it.

AS-b60ce1b6377a.t: The tree called the tree of knowledge drove us out, removed from life, by which Mother Eve transgressed and deceived the first father.

AS-5968cafda2f1.t: Indeed the wood of your life-giving cross, the staff of power for human life and hope of assurance, became a guide for us into eternal life.

AS-4848f7e74910.t: You gave us your holy cross as a victorious sign, that by it we may enter the narrow gate of the anguished way which the earthborn sons of men desired.

AS-b1d3820c4d62.t: Christ, Sun of righteousness, having dawned on the world, you drove away the darkness of ignorance, and after death and resurrection ascended to the Father from whom you dawned; you who are worshiped by heavenly and earthly beings with the Father and the Holy Spirit, therefore we too worship the Father in Spirit and truth.

AS-fd942e0f3d9b.t: Who, in place of the Word born of the bosom, who went up into heaven, was sent from on high as the good tidings of the Father, the Spirit of truth, to comfort those of Adam who were grieved, and to invite the chosen ranks of the apostles, for [cut off]

AS-e5fc48247ab7.t: Today the sorrowful and nocturnal birth-pangs of the first mother are loosed, for those born in the flesh unto death and corruption, the Spirit gives birth again as sons of the light of the heavenly Father; wherefore [cut off]

AS-7d067784aeb3.t: Creator God, who from nothing brought heaven and earth into being, we bless you who give rest to the departed, almighty Father.

AS-76e841f8c5ef.t: O Word, God and co-essential, glo- [cut off]

AS-830a533937f5.t: [cut off] of the Father, image; we praise you, who are the resurrection of those who have fallen asleep, only-begotten Son.

AS-c4c1b8408a81.t: Unfailing spring, from which grace is distributed to the universe, we bless you, who are the renewer of the departed, true Spirit.

AS-0bc80be097bd.t: The heavenly door, Mother of God: the angel announced the good news with a divine voice, saying, Rejoice, O joyful one, the Lord is with you.

AS-f428be6465a7.t: You who are enthroned upon the cherubim with the Father were pleased to dwell incorruptibly in your womb; rejoice [cut off]

AS-baf9bc87902c.t: He who was guarded, surrounded by flaming seraphim, was revealed this day among men, in the arms of one made of earth: rejoice [cut off].

AS-b215a91f7753.t: He who on the last day will briefly dissolve his gathered, expected radiance, and the most wondrous sign will shine in the heavens with awesome, wonderful rays, and all the companies of unbelievers will mourn and lament: we beseech you, Lord, protect us under the shelter of your holy cross.

AS-358a6a7110c3.t: By the intercession of the holy Mother of God, receive, Lord, our petitions, when you shall shine forth from the east with ineffable wonders, making the victorious holy sign your forerunner: we entreat [cut off]

AS-f978b959726b.t: Rejoice today, holy Church, and celebrate your feast, daughter of Zion, for the Lord God was pleased to dwell in you, [God] of our fathers.

AS-ef181967094a.t: Rejoice, princess, daughter of Zion, and exult, upper Jerusalem, for Christ the King of heaven comes to you, Lord God of our fathers.

AS-51feadf0a805.t: Rejoice, Zion, mother Church, for in you the divine ray from the Father of light has dawned, Lord God of our fathers.

AS-aa7fdc4c1e6c.t: Bless the Lord, exalt him forever.

AS-94a3b6ba1701.t: He who today crowned the holy Church with the sign of his cross: bless the Lord [cut off]

AS-f823f85c887b.t: You who, by the second birth of the holy font, enlightened the race of the children of men: with song, bless the Lord, exalt him forever.

AS-af4d4658ba7f.t: [cut off] you became the east; we magnify you.

AS-9e05e9ede838.t: You became the foundation of the Church, the sanctuary of the Holy Spirit; served by angels, Gabriel announced the good news to you; race and na-
