AS-6ce0eb3b913d.t: You who established your Church by the word, Christ, upon the apostolic rock, to sing in it spiritual songs.

AS-0a21e63b0121.t: Established in it is a table of holiness; he distributes his body and blood, and gives us from it renewal for the forgiveness of our sins.

AS-c4309b84d78e.t: The Holy Spirit having descended in the appearance of a dove upon the body and blood of the Lord, for the healing of our souls.

AS-f0332472d88a.t: Be illumined, Jerusalem, adorn your strongholds, for the heavenly Bridegroom has drawn near to you; granting you salvation, he crowned you with his marvellous glory.

AS-b1e4e3119f7a.t: Today there has dawned for you, O queen, daughter of Zion, the Sun of righteousness, Christ; and the graces of the Holy Spirit were spread over you with great gifts.

AS-ac123281c4bf.t: Today rejoice, holy Zion, mother Church; make your children shine like the sun, for Christ the King has filled you with ineffable joy.

AS-eac171502a2f.t: The Only-begotten descended from the Father, and the light of glory with him; voices resounded, the nether depths of the abyss [?].

AS-80b0f27e6066.t: Having seen the great light, the patriarch Gregory told it with rejoicing to the believing king.

AS-4787ca36b9c3.t: Come, let us build the holy tabernacle of light, for in it the light dawned for us in the land of Armenia. At the Meal: You who established by the Word [cut]

AS-76bd6337be86.t: Blessing. Rejoice, holy Church, for Christ, the King of heaven, today crowned you with His Cross and adorned your ramparts with His wondrous glories.

AS-72b33066e566.t: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion, for today the earth has become heaven by your renewal anew, and the heavenly King was pleased to dwell in you.

AS-c9ce60ddc601.t: Taken up on high with the ranks of the heavenly hosts, we keep for you today unceasing praises; rejoice, spotless bride, in your unsearchable mystery.

AS-5ab88454910d.t: The holy Church was raised up as a tabernacle of holiness, and Christ the King was offered in sacrifice in her; come, believers, let us sing to Christ a new song.

AS-fb1f9107a606.t: Today the multitudes of angels become fellow-celebrants with us, for the heavenly King comes into the holy Church.

AS-c29eb7e07f24.t: Rejoice and be glad, Church betrothed to God, for the Lord of lords has chosen you and been pleased to dwell in you.

AS-be1aed7f0707.t: Shine, shine, O Catholic Church, for in you a divine ray from the Father of light has dawned and has enlightened your children.

AS-999c44b1a5a4.t: You who have been made worthy of the calling to glorify Christ our God, come, O peoples, sing to the Lord a new song; sing his name with a voice of rejoicing, in a blessing anew.

AS-350a828a472b.t: Strengthened in you, O Christ, the peoples of the faithful bless, with true confession, the mystery of your divine, life-giving dispensation, glorifying your awesome and wonderful name: O Lord, Lord, great over all the earth.

AS-5aa4691aac2f.t: Rejoice, holy Church, bride of the heavenly mystery, to the glory of the all-holy Trinity, who in consubstantial authority adorns you and crowns you with the dawning of light, in honour, with all his saints.

AS-8e69a7eedef3.t: Be illumined, Jerusalem, for your light has come; adorn your strongholds, and may the glory of the Lord rise over you.

AS-aeb48cf7c43a.t: Praise with hymns and psalms befits you, O God; a blessing from Zion, and prayers shall be offered to you in Jerusalem.

AS-0448f5b2de1d.t: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem, and bless your God, chosen people, queen, daughter of Zion.

AS-829368263bc9.t: Today the Godhead rejoices, newly establishing the earth; the holy choirs of the angels give glory, and we with a voice of blessing adorn the holy feasts.

AS-c8c7d66d3c2f.t: Today we too rejoice in this feast; with universal sound and great brilliance it appeared in the world; thanksgivings run to God, they recount without ceasing the living Word.

AS-19912da2a3d1.t: Rejoice and be glad, Church, holy virgin and bride of the heavenly Bridegroom; behold, we see the Anointed, Christ, being with you, the light of the Gentiles.

AS-eb2a1bec02f7.t: A wondrous-glorious vision is seen in the catholic church: an instrument of death, by death, being the cause of life; and for the one who slew the first-created, by death being the giver of resurrection.

AS-56e7bafa5097.t: A supreme gift of gifts today to the faithful: the one who is dying takes his lifted powers from life and, flown up, returns to dwell in the place of holiness.

AS-add030932e8b.t: Come, people, let us serve with the spirit-begotten, let us worship this holy divine sign, let us glorify the giver of wondrous gifts.

AS-e90e9e30cad0.t: Christ, Sun of Righteousness, risen upon the world, drove away the darkness of ignorance; and after death and resurrection he ascended to the Father from whom he arose, to whom heavenly and earthly beings bow down with the Father and the Holy Spirit; therefore we too worship the Father in spirit and truth.

AS-c8627450eb68.t: Who, in place of the Word born of the bosom who ascended to heaven, was sent as the Father's good tidings from on high, the Spirit of truth, to comfort those grieving from Adam, and to arm with fire the chosen ranks of the apostles; therefore:

AS-6018db5a92d1.t: You who are long-suffering, Lord, sweet and without resentment, give rest to the souls of your servants, that none may turn back destitute and ashamed on the day of the fearful judgment.

AS-a0a1b24e4ab4.t: May you accept, as pleasing to you, the memorial of the departed, and receive our covenant as that of Abel, of Noah and of Abraham, that not [cut off]

AS-c91628cb75a3.t: Mother of the ineffable light and dwelling-place of the beginningless, co-dwelling Son, we magnify you with blessing.

AS-8350d39ec7a9.t: Mother of the incomprehensible dispensation and the self-subsisting temple of God the Word: we bles[s you]:

AS-f0bde1f40a4b.t: The choirs of angels, having come down from heaven, sing, saying in a wonderful voice, chanting songs of blessing with a threefold holy voice.

AS-772ec7fe0eef.t: Rejoice, be glad, betrothed holy Church; make your children shine in praise of the one who made the ray of light dawn in you, Mother Church.

AS-525ad9af25f9.t: Today, radiant and as a pillar of light, you filled the holy Church with divine grace; in her we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-5a30de952927.t: Bridal chamber of righteous men, and in it a divine ray shining forth from the Father of light: in it we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-074a605ec8ae.t: Giver of mercy, Lord, give to it your unshaken peace: in it we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-68377ffd881a.t: Bless the Lord and exalt him above all forever.

AS-1fd70528a585.t: With the bodily [?] multitudes, Christ the King who comes today into the holy Church: all nations, praise him and exalt him forever.

AS-347fe86c1ba8.t: Come, faithful ones, into the churches of the Holy Trinity; bless God, keep festivals of joy as far as the corners of the altar, and exalt him above all forever.

AS-1aa6893334cf.t: Rejoice, Mother of God, hope and mother of salvation; we magnify you, who received the Light.

AS-311011a3eb44.t: You, mother of light and virgin, you, treasure of life: with divine voice and rejoicing we magnify you.

AS-2004dec3e616.t: Holy, spotless Mother of the light, honoured with angelic blessing, we magnify you.

AS-67275b445d82.t: Those whom you created in your image, renewing them, you made into a temple for yourself; receive for yourself, as a dwelling, the temples renewed by us.

AS-95197945772a.t: You who grant us, O Life-giver, to bear the living image of your servant's form, bringing the one who carries all up to the glory of your holy Trinity.

AS-2166b4af4459.t: Save the son of your servant, whom you exalted from the Roman thrones, where they laid the rock of faith, the foundation of the holy Church.

AS-d71a7c17b7f4.t: You who adorned this last house wonderfully, founded it radiantly with the measure of [your] dwelling [?], the glorious and shining glory of this house, the latter greater than the former.

AS-3ec4a09da70d.t: You who adorned the holy Church with great radiant glory and established a luminous dwelling, a sanctuary for the choirs of angels: all creatures, bless him.

AS-0f3d3c2fa2da.t: Who, self-existent, by wonders founded it upon the foundation of the holy apostles, and granted atonement in it, that the sons of men be ranked with the watchers above; all creatures, bless it.

AS-0be0311e6a17.t: Who by his almighty power, by his ineffable dawning, divinely was bountiful to the race of men, and bestowed incorrupt grace, bright garments, adornments, and rounded crowns from the unapproachable light; all creatures, bless him.

AS-94cf8ee739c7.t: Today the heavenly multitudes rejoice and exult at the dedication of the holy Church, for there has been granted to us the eternal High Priest, to enlighten the holy catholic Church: glory to your coming, Lord.

AS-2d761ab8e4be.t: Today a pillar of light became a shelter for us from on high, for the heavenly King comes into the holy Church, and the hosts of angels, spreading out, keep festival with men, glo- [cut off]

AS-a477b135c029.t: Today the true High Priest, honoured with divine laws, sets up the four-cornered altar of the Cross; having offered worthily, he distributes the body and blood of the Lord. Draw near purely, you redeemed, new people, and ask of Christ that he grant him to us for many days.

AS-2adb3f638b71.t: Blessing. Ineffable chariot, receptacle of the unsearchable mystery, O holy four-winged one, honoured with awe, invisibly, by the swift-winged flying seraphim: we worship you; come to our aid at sunrise and at sunset.

AS-05d7f8036676.t: O holy four-armed one, invincible sign, receptacle of unconquerable power, you appeared as a terror to the rebels, who tremble in dread of you and perish, plunged into the abyss: we worship you; come to our help at our going out and our coming in.

AS-81d251456e19.t: The prophet Zechariah saw you beforehand, O holy four-armed one, as a golden lampstand made radiant on earth with the light of seven lamps; and upon you the immaterial Being was stretched out, having become embodied in our nature, and with his fountain-flowing side cleansed the defilement of the human race: we worship you; come to our help at our going out and our coming in.

AS-89b778b38f83.t: At your appearing from the burial, O holy four-armed one, the ranks of the devil's hosts perished at the terror of you; and at the rising of the young man the faithful rejoiced: we worship you; come to our help at our going out and our coming in.

AS-881de2b58ef9.t: You who are of one essence with the Father and the Holy Spirit, an inseparable being of unity, humbled Yourself from on high and took flesh from the Virgin, for the sake of the one fallen through the deceit of the devil, from indissoluble life.

AS-a538b05df2f8.t: You, the Judge who know hidden things, today were condemned from the earth, were lifted upon the cross and fed with gall, for the sake of the one fallen through tasting the death-bearing fruit.

AS-290fdd9acc24.t: You, the Life of all, today accepted the death of the cross, were laid in the heart of the earth, and on the third day rose; grant us to be raised with You into ineffable life.

AS-311a79716f91.t: On the rock of faith you built your holy Church; keep it in peace.

AS-17768f86cf10.t: You who granted mercy in the dwelling of angels and men, give this place your unshaken peace as an atonement.

AS-4e179c25e002.t: In the temple of your holy glory the children sing to you; give them your abundant mercy.

AS-e46de6fe8047.t: Come, you peoples, to the temple of the glory of Christ; all of you, give blessing in the highest.

AS-e7b5f8472fbd.t: For Christ the King crowned her with his wondrous glory: all of you, give blessing on high.

AS-da299093f330.t: In it the hosts of angels also, drawn up in order, keep the feast of the Lord; all of you, give blessing in the highest.

AS-0012b5eb5d34.t: You who came down from heaven, God the Word, and for our sake were incarnate of the holy Virgin, have mercy on me, my God, have mercy.

AS-cd4222d115cc.t: You who stretched out your spotless arms on the cross and shed your holy blood for our sake: have mercy on me, my God, have mercy.

AS-a1f2e12f4cda.t: You who were laid in the tomb uncorrupted and, having risen, renewed this world: have mercy on me, my God, have mercy.

AS-f1452115d241.t: You who, almighty, ascended into the heavens and sat at the right hand of the Father on the throne of glory: have mercy on me, my God, have mercy.

AS-ecbd4f60b68d.t: You descended, Lord, and became flesh from the Virgin, and freed our earthly nature from sin.

AS-3cb2883b2f47.t: You ascended, Lord, and were nailed to the Cross; you accepted death, O Life-giver of the dead.

AS-da7f28e12914.t: You were laid, Lord, in a newly hewn rock and sealed with a ring, you treasure of life for the world.

AS-6a15ff36ce0a.t: [cut off] and you were sealed with a ring, treasure of the life of the world.

AS-937669644b1b.t: You rose, Lord, you laid waste hell, you ascended into the heavens and sat at the right hand of the Father.

AS-b8905f371852.t: Seeing the Uncreated become man, the prophet marvelled, and the body pierced with nails on the Cross, working in the midst of two living creatures.

AS-9df8a181f7e9.t: Let the heavens declare the splendor of the glory of Christ, and the light-pacing elements, having received the color of the blood of the Uncreated, and the universe was filled with blessing of the Crucified.

AS-cf2761ffd597.t: Mounted not only upon the root that bears growth, but descending below in cherubic chariots into hell, you mightily gave life to the flocks of the righteous.

AS-0003a67e4f47.t: You descended, Lord, in your mercy into the world, and transformed our dead nature into life.

AS-ccbbdaededb5.t: You ascended, Lord, to the Father in glory into the heavens, and sent the holy Spirit, the Comforter, to the apostles.

AS-db1942230ab3.t: You opened, Lord, today the heavenly treasure, and distributed gifts abundantly to our poor nature.

AS-a08aefebeebc.t: The Only-begotten will come with trumpet and with the glory of the Father, and renew our earthly nature with fire.

AS-b64934435c0f.t: Bright are the paths of the righteous, and among the myriad hosts of angels they go forth on the clouds.

AS-418e2bf60129.t: They fly on the clouds to the Jerusalem above to meet the Lord in the air, and thus they will be with the Lord at all times.

AS-eecb7ad8a91d.t: You who had mercy on humankind born in sin, heavenly Father, according to the prophet, and gave to our nature today as a gift the holy Virgin, the mother of Your only-begotten Son: by her prayers, Lord, have mercy on us.

AS-2727f42b7316.t: You who sprinkled us from the cloud of the Law, Son, today the Virgin Mary, from whom you were born in the flesh and by whom you took away the sin of the first-created Adam: by her intercessions, Lord, have mercy on us.

AS-5c356a56f0e3.t: You, Holy Spirit, who purified the heart and womb of your co-glorious mother, today gave to her barren parents the mother of the Word, the blesser of Eve; by her intercessions, Lord, have mercy on us.

AS-63f996f4db27.t: Heaven on earth, and in the heavens a wordless intercessor for us, O holy four-armed one, who are the forerunner in awesome and fiery-blazing radiance and the foreteller of the coming of the Son of God, to you [cut off]. Glory to the Father and [cut off]. Now and always.

AS-e09fc619abd3.t: When you shine from the east with ineffable light, you illumine the faithful and condemn the nation of the unbelieving Jews, O holy four-armed one; illumine me also, darkened by sins, and rank me in the ranks of the register of your ineffable kingdom of heaven, that you may be blessed unceasingly; and yours is the glory forever, amen.

AS-6a14e687490b.t: Today the choirs of angels rejoice at the consecration of the holy Church of Christ, blessing the Lord, the God of our fathers.

AS-c06409f12711.t: Today the ranks of the holy apostles celebrate the feast of the upper Jerusalem; in the spiritual temple they offer spiritual songs in song: Lord God of our fathers.

AS-c659b7ad258a.t: Today the choirs of the faithful take up the song and cry out in unity: make us worthy, in your temple of holiness, to glorify the all-holy Trinity, the Lord God of our fathers.

AS-54d1e99c9f4b.t: He who illumined the Catholic mother, the holy Church, with divine light: all nations, praise him and exalt him still more forever.

AS-ca4adb3541a6.t: The heavenly door, Mother of God: the angel announced the good news with a divine voice, saying, Rejoice, O joyful one, the Lord is with you.

AS-8b52e1773c3c.t: You who are enthroned upon the cherubim with the Father were pleased to dwell incorruptibly in your womb; rejoice [cut off]

AS-ca242f5cddc7.t: He who was guarded, surrounded by flaming seraphim, was revealed this day among men, in the arms of one made of earth: rejoice [cut off].

AS-667fa91919af.t: Shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come; adorn the fortresses [cut off]

AS-4c49de81d45d.t: ...your [?], and may the glory of the Lord dawn upon you. With hymn-singing and psalms praise befits you, God, in Zion, and prayers will be offered to you in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord, Jerusalem, and bless your God, new people, princess, daughter of Zion.

AS-309a794b7ac0.t: Today the Godhead rejoices, newly establishing the earth; the holy choirs of the angels give glory, and we with a voice of blessing adorn the holy feasts.

AS-67bf6811b3a3.t: Today we too rejoice in this feast; with universal sound and great brilliance it appeared in the world; thanksgivings run- [cut off] to God, they recount without ceasing the living Word.

AS-26800b44fc4a.t: Rejoice and be glad, Church, holy virgin and bride of the heavenly Bridegroom; behold, we see the Anointed, Christ, being with you, the light of the Gentiles.

AS-8aa06487d40a.t: You who from the beginning established the Church in wisdom, the Wisdom of the Father, which Moses foreshadowed by a prefiguring vision through the tabernacle, the heavenly dwelling on Mount Sinai, illumined by the glory of God.

AS-d410367ed54b.t: You who, imprinting the incorrupt mystery of your dispensation from the holy Virgin, [as] the ark of the divine covenant of the testaments of the Word of God, a place of rest for the glory of the uncreated One.

AS-5b9f2df809cb.t: You who prefigured the return of our nature to life by the turning back of the Jordan, and the seizure of death and hell by the overthrow of Jericho, wondrously worked by the ark of the Cross for the new Israel: let the children sing a blessing to you, Lord.

AS-3afd69053f92.t: Today the choirs of angels rejoice at your establishment on earth, O luminous sanctuary like heaven, holy Church; rejoice, precious rock, our shelter and hope.

AS-384e3aa4143a.t: Rejoice, spotless bride, veiled; adorn yourself becomingly with robes of glory and go out to meet the heavenly Bridegroom. Be glad, barren one of many children: behold, the Bridegroom comes to you.

AS-81e648b7526c.t: Here the font of baptism was renewed for us; conceived by the Spirit in the mother's womb, she gives birth again to us who believe in Christ. Be glad, motherless one, as at the first: behold, the Son comes to you.

AS-d7cb312515f1.t: Let us bless the incorruptible holy Cross, which became the guide of the thief and fashioned for us a road; which showed us by it how to enter through the unbuilt gate of the Lord's paradise.

AS-73437681f65e.t: The key of the kingdom was given to earth-born man, who, by the first tasting, had fallen away from eternal life; he who showed us by this to enter through the door of the Lord's uncreated paradise.

AS-072698ddb2c1.t: Appearing in the form of a staff to the Egyptian nation, showing the power of the holy Cross by seizing the staffs of the magicians; he who showed us by this to enter through the door of the Lord's uncreated paradise.

AS-3a49d4de2345.t: A mark of perception [?] was traced upon the lintels of their doors, keeping the people unafraid of sudden destruction; he who showed us by this to enter through the door of the Lord's uncreated paradise.

AS-6d5eb890caca.t: A precious stone like a brick appeared in the form of the Cross, cleaving the Red Sea, leading the people with the inseparable light by the shadow of a cloud; he who showed us by this to enter through the door of the Lord's uncreated paradise.

AS-6e89fff70417.t: You who by the sign of your all-conquering Cross, Christ, took away the condemnation of the human race.

AS-bfe5328c97a9.t: Today the precious wood of the Cross, deposited at Golgotha, is sought through the God-loving queen; come, O faithful, let us worship this divine holy sign.

AS-21d177b4a339.t: Today Golgotha gives up what was hidden in the earth, brought forth with fragrant incense by the hand of him who came up from Judah. Come, O faithful, let us worship this divine holy sign.

AS-f1fab75e2814.t: Today the youth is put to death by the life-giving one; and Satan laments his own destruction. But we, who believe in Christ, let us worship this divine holy sign.

AS-ea46731d68da.t: We have taken refuge in your Cross, Creator of the ages, who gave it to us as a victorious guardian against the enemy; we entreat you, Savior, by it guard our souls.

AS-bf35687e4295.t: Exalted King, who for our sake went up on the cross and through it took away the transgression of the first-created Adam: we entr-.

AS-2015423ccae9.t: The head of holy faith and the wood of life was revealed to people; when the unclean one saw it, he was cast down, unable to rise: we entreat.

AS-df98ca36656a.t: The enemy trembled at the revealing of the holy Cross, and from fear of its glory he was cast down into the depths of the earth: we entreat.

AS-f15b1a44c78d.t: Heaven rejoiced and the earth was glad, for the holy Cross was shown to be the Savior and the light-giver of the universe: we entreat.

AS-a7dff6c42458.t: You came down from heaven, Son of God, you freed your creatures; I fall before you, have mercy on me, God.

AS-972e8e98d514.t: On the cross you were nailed, God, and loosed man from the bonds of death; do not overlook me, who am dead in my sins.

AS-87616d5d4e23.t: Radiance of the Father's unapproachable light, who descended into the tomb and gave life to your creatures: do not overlook me, for against you alone have I sinned.

AS-af2423f97f38.t: You who by your voluntary crucifixion, Lord, took away sin: we bless you, the resurrection of all.

AS-5d5e36d8885e.t: You who by your three-day burial, Lord, put death to death: we bless you, the resurrection of all.

AS-5b99d43f1b91.t: You who by your radiant resurrection, Lord, gave life to the world: we bless you, the resurrection of all.

AS-685e29decd52.t: We have known you, Christ, who were nailed on the cross and by the pouring out of your blood saved the universe; we have known no other God apart from you.

AS-d468d4a70ded.t: You who stretched out your spotless arms upon the Cross to gather those who were far off, by your almighty power: be my strength, Lord, by your resurrection.

AS-c706b70a18e5.t: Christ, giver of peace, who on the holy cross loosed the sentence of death and reconciled the Father with creation, you made peace in heaven and on earth.

AS-8e5f52eb446c.t: Same and like to the Father and the Son, uncreated and co-essential Spirit, proceeding from the Father inscrutably, receiving from the Son ineffably: today you descended into the upper room; you gave the Spirit of your graces to drink; give us also to drink, in mercy, from the cup of wisdom.

AS-93200c08e26f.t: Creator of beings and of creatures, who moved over the waters, the same also in the waters of the font, granting us your own being, you cherish with love, in dove-like form, and beget men in the likeness of God [cut off]

AS-7d61a809f0e5.t: Teacher [?] of the heavenly intelligible ones and of the earthly sensible ones, who make prophets of shepherds and apostles of fishermen, heralds of tax collectors, preachers of your word of persecutors [cut off]

AS-43b642190272.t: At the sound of the trumpet of your coming, Lord, all souls shall awake to stand at your judgment, Christ our God.

AS-2fbcac3f5668.t: When the dreadful voice resounds and the trumpet of our resurrection is struck, and we cry out, saying: Glory to your coming, Lord.

AS-940fb1854deb.t: When you render recompense, Lord, and your saints boast in you, grant us, Savior, to stand at your right hand.

AS-3caa2335fb4b.t: Father, before the ages the ranks of bodiless angels bless You; with voice and song they cry out and proclaim: God of gods and Lord of lords, being Savior.

AS-d7ee3af36842.t: You sent your Only-begotten to be made flesh of the holy Virgin and to be born immaculate from an incorrupt womb, taking away our afflictions: God of gods, [cut off]

AS-9dbf08e3cfad.t: Good grace appeared in Jerusalem to the Gentiles, for the Creator of the ages, having become a child, calls us to the adoption of life, God [cut off]

AS-2d697095da0d.t: You who granted us victory in the contest, to drive off the power of the enemy.

AS-e62151979218.t: By it make our lives peaceful, O only merciful one, and save us from every temptation.

AS-4416b6e8e4f9.t: Today you were slain, Lamb of God, for the transgressions of the first-created; offered upon the cross, you poured out your blood for salvation; blessed is the Lord, God of our fathers.

AS-2098e0f77a25.t: Today, in exchange for the knowledge of the tree of death, by which the forefather died, you gave us your saving sign, exchanged for the tree of life; blessed is the Lord, God of our fathers.

AS-7db26fc242df.t: Bless the Lord, exalt [cut off] forever.

AS-3904daae5ef2.t: Christ, who, being nailed to the Cross, loosed those who were bound, and bound the enemy unloosably by his life-giving Cross: exalt him forever.

AS-fb11a733665e.t: Who, in place of the fruit of the death-bearing tree, fed the race of the sons of men with the fruit of life upon the four-armed one: exalt him forever.

AS-91c9e8a77da2.t: Who washed away the record of the debts of the one born from the rib with fire-flowing streams gushing from his lance-pierced side, which he gave the universe to drink: exalt him forever.

AS-97a4a523db73.t: Mother of light, Mary, holy Virgin, you who bore in the flesh the Light from the Father, and became the east of the Sun of righteousness: with spiritual song we magnify you, holy one.

AS-acd03731b816.t: You were a throne higher than the cherubim, and the tree of life of immortal fruit, the ark of the covenant of the Word, and the jar [?] of gold of the heavenly manna: spiritual [song we magnify you]: [cut off].

AS-090c8a105975.t: By you the seraph-guarded gate of paradise was opened, and by you was given to us the tree of immortality, on which [...]

AS-4c8dd5d75200.t: [...] the immortal one who was slain on it today shone from the heavens: spiritual [song we magnify you]: [cut off].

AS-72f2485952ad.t: O four-winged, light-born, supremely glorious sign, builder of the life of all, always with arms outstretched toward you [cut off].

AS-31d0b5b2ec06.t: Shelter of the four-sided nations [?] and guardian, salvation at sunrise and sunset from those things, and a wall of strength.

AS-7a63717396f6.t: You are the imprint of the senses and the seal on the face of all, and you accomplish the divine mystery, from which the rays of the sun shine forth.

AS-24d862ab8790.t: O guardian who dawned from Eden, sign of victory against the invisible enemy.

AS-18453c10cfe7.t: You who caused a great light to dawn for us, the sign of the victory of your Cross, King of the ages, and gave a rampart of strength to your faithful, a mighty tower before the face of the enemy: we beseech you, Lord, keep us under the shelter of your holy Cross.

AS-acf836706f7b.t: -seech you, Lord, keep us under the shadow of your holy Cross.

AS-d9ffdbb280ef.t: This is a crown adorned with the graces of the noetic light, set upon the head of the sinner, dyed in fitting hues with the blood and water from your spear-pierced side, which you received from the soldier: we beseech you, Lord, keep us under the shelter of your holy Cross.

AS-8a03822efcbd.t: You who by it divided the abysses of the sea of sin, and covered the tyrant in the depths with everlasting fire, brought out your people to the dwellings of heaven, of the fallen hosts: we beseech you, Lord, keep us under the shelter of your holy Cross.

AS-248ceff3addb.t: Tree of life, who in place of the deadly fruit bore Christ as fruit, fence in and guard the covenants of the faithful.

AS-5f98c53bce5c.t: Through you the way to the tree of life was opened to us from the guard of the seraph-barred gate; keep the covenant of the faithful fenced about.

AS-5519c0e13896.t: Through you the forefather was freed from the tasting of the fruit, and all the faithful worship you; walled about, keep safe the covenant of the faithful.

AS-0f32f2c54d4a.t: The tree called the tree of knowledge drove us out, removed from life, by which Mother Eve transgressed and deceived the first father.

AS-efabaa0dae61.t: But the wood of your Cross, the life-giving staff of power, the life of humankind and the hope of assurance, became for us a guide to eternal life.

AS-07ce97768178.t: You gave us your holy Cross as a victorious sign, that by it we may enter with

AS-f59ff643dd1a.t: [cut off] the narrow gate of the constricted way, which the earth-born sons of men longed for.

AS-68ed953005c8.t: Of one being with the Father, You came to the passion of Your own will; You accepted the sufferings, endured the cross, and went down into the tomb.

AS-251940ab255b.t: The myrrh-bearers came to the tomb of the Saviour and brought sweet ointments to anoint Your incorruptible body.

AS-edfb1830fe59.t: Having heard the good news from the angel who said, The Lord is risen from the dead, he has granted you life.

AS-28c702554723.t: In all things, God of abundant mercy, look upon me with compassion and spare me, for you alone are the lover of mankind.

AS-a912d058d89d.t: And by your life-giving Cross keep me, and by your Resurrection save me and give me life; for you alone are the lover of mankind.

AS-5340e0bfe990.t: And at your second coming, Lord, renew me once again and give me life; for you alone are the lover of mankind.

AS-52249af431f9.t: Christ God, who stretched out your hands on the cross and broke the seal of our condemnation, have mercy.

AS-3ad77fb90087.t: You were nailed to the cross, and by the shedding of your blood you saved the universe from sin; have mer[cy] [cut off]

AS-797e103e3db4.t: You were buried in the midst of the earth and on the third day rose; you destroyed hell by [your] word. Have mer[cy] [cut off]

AS-ff6483c517bd.t: From the wood marked with the cross hell trembled; by the power of the Holy Spirit the earth was renewed. Who is this who has abolished death?

AS-cf9b9bb0d555.t: The angel announced to the Virgin Mary: This is the Word [cut off]

AS-b3b79f62310b.t: Who before the ages is the Son: this is the King who abolished death.

AS-1d33704a26a9.t: He rose on the third day; the rocks were split, the earth shook, hell was shaken: this is the Living One of the ages, Christ.

AS-87424df6cc60.t: Christ, Sun of righteousness, having dawned upon the world, you drove away the darkness of ignorance, and after death and resurrection you ascended to the Father from whom you dawned, you who are worshiped by those in heaven and on earth together with the Father and the Holy Spirit; therefore we too worship the Father in Spirit and truth.

AS-1075eb6be5be.t: Who, in place of the Word born of the bosom, who went up into heaven, was sent as the good tidings of the Father from on high, the Spirit of truth, to comfort those who were grieved because of Adam, and to arm with fire the chosen ranks of the apostles; wherefore we too worship the Father in spirit and in truth.

AS-e0c7d619100b.t: Today the sorrowful and nocturnal birth-pangs of the first mother are loosed; for those born in the flesh unto death and corruption, the Spirit gives birth again as sons of the light of the heavenly Father; wherefore we too worship the Father in spirit and in truth.

AS-0975c76b7690.t: Creator God, who brought heaven and earth into being out of nothing, we bless you, who are the repose of the departed, almighty Father.

AS-9861cba06254.t: Word of God, co-essential image of the Father's glory, we praise you, who are the resurrection of the departed, only-begotten Son.

AS-f63f08d1619f.t: Unfailing spring, from which grace is distributed to the universe, we bless you, who are the renewer of the departed, true Spirit.

AS-d20231c79ed7.t: Mother of the ineffable light and dwelling-place of the beginningless, co-dwelling Son, we magnify you with blessing.

AS-a007453efd31.t: Mother of the incomprehensible dispensation and the self-subsisting temple of God the Word: we bles[s you]:

AS-53489523766d.t: Mother of the salvation of all, who held in the womb the One who cannot be contained: all of us, with blessing, magnify him.

AS-79001d84d587.t: The prefigured goal of lifting up [the pole]: Moses showed the Israelite camp the bronze serpent as a type of the holy four-armed cross, to save those wounded by the venom of biting reptiles. We beseech you, Lord, protect us under the shadow of your holy cross.

AS-8c374d1e44fa.t: We set before your unresentful lordship the living image of your immaculate parent, when you come in the glory of the Father to judge the enemy of your Cross: forgive our transgressions by the intercession of your Mother and Virgin, we beseech you.

AS-a83b00b1f123.t: Christ God, who showed your victorious, fire-formed sign, brighter than the sun, high above holy Golgotha: for this reason we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-4c15eb78e03c.t: For your radiant and holy saving Cross, O Lord, adorned [cut off]

AS-60c762bc71a6.t: For your bright and holy saving cross, Lord, adorned with light from the heavens, appeared shining in Jerusalem; wherefore we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-e3adfe8e2939.t: Bless the Lord and exalt him forever.

AS-36a0f631d831.t: Christ, who today imprinted the awesome mystery of his second coming by the shining of the holy Cross, through which this earth was made glorious: and exalt him forever.

AS-01762ed70c98.t: He who appeared in an awesome form: Jerusalem rejoiced, and the ranks of the netherworld trembled in terror; and exalt him forever.

AS-66e925d6e830.t: Mother of God, we bless the one who enlightened you, and [cut off]

AS-58f8cd0c506c.t: Light and radiant cloud, upon whom the rain of life was poured out from the heavenly sea, which you shed upon the thirsty earth: with a seraphic voice we [bless] you.

AS-2562469b9ee2.t: Enclosed garden, God-planted Eden, who are also the tree of life in the midst of your paradise, planted by the Spirit: with its immortal fruit you filled the universe; [seraphic ...]

AS-813bd7a6525b.t: Today the victorious sign, appearing on earth, made the universe radiant; you gave your Cross, Lord, as a weapon of victory, to save us from the deceits of the enemy.

AS-ebc75278742e.t: The tree of life set up in the midst of the universe, hope and refuge of the human race: may it keep us from all our dangers, to save us from the deceits of the enemy.

AS-a7242590b7ee.t: All creation worships Your Cross, O Christ, which was raised for our salvation; let it be a victorious guardian for us, to deliver us from the deceptions of the Slanderer.

AS-9dcf949a18e9.t: On this day you were lifted up, you who remove the curses, who are glorified with the Father, to gather those who had gone far away and to save them by the life-bearing wood.

AS-80cf57d8fcc0.t: By this all creatures were enlightened; for this those held in the sin-loving prison waited, you who freed us from deceptions.

AS-70638617ff99.t: The cherubic hosts, enclosed with fiery seraphim, guarded the way to the tree of life in the paradise not made by hands. Today the God-adorned wood of life and salvation has appeared shining on the earth; the children of the holy Church bless you.

AS-ac2cce4b23ba.t: A ram was caught up in the tree of Sabek [?] as a burnt offering in place of Isaac; but upon you the spotless Lamb was slain for reconciliation with the Father and to take away our sins: the children of the holy Church bless you.

AS-f9f8d7fb90e0.t: ... of the Father, and for the taking away of our sins: we bless you ...

AS-e8306578e718.t: Boast of Paul, who confessed you to be the place and altar of the divine Word, for through you we were saved from the biting one and from the bodiless beast; and the drops of incorruptible blood poured out upon you from the one born of the side blotted out sin: the children of the holy Church bless you.

AS-d4a03a5ce3a5.t: You granted Your holy Cross as a weapon to Your holy Church, by which the enemy was condemned and defeated.

AS-1e1e0f5bc8c5.t: By it protect Your people, Christ, by which we worship You with the Father and the Spirit.

AS-3a33c87837b7.t: In you we take refuge, Christ, who are to come by the Cross, that you may save us on that day of the dreadful judgment.

AS-ad6538923481.t: Today the appearance of the great radiant sign of the Lord our God, shining at the dedication in Jerusalem; peoples, blessing Christ, celebrate with joy.

AS-96a43948ad72.t: For the rays of the life-giving holy Cross, with sun-like radiance, in transparent light, appeared from the east; O peoples, blessing Christ, celebrate with joy.

AS-9d5137a1105e.t: Flashing from heaven with awesome and newly wondrous marvels, the Lord's sign was shown at holy Golgotha; O peoples, blessing Christ, celebrate with joy.

AS-7c60f4f40ecd.t: By your all-victorious sign of the Cross, O Christ, guard us, lover of mankind, from the invisible enemy, for you alone are the King of glory, blessed forever.

AS-bd8554be3b6b.t: You who stretched out your spotless arms upon it and poured out your blood for the salvation of the universe; for you alone are the King of glory, blessed forever.

AS-a55269e481ae.t: At your second coming, when this holy sign appears, make your servants worthy of renewal again; for you alone are the King of glory, blessed forever.

AS-9cd2e41417ef.t: Let your Cross be our refuge; by its fiery-signed radiance it shattered the enemy and dissolved the bond of condemnation [?], the wood called the tree of life, for the salvation of the world.

AS-c3876b63182b.t: Your altar, Lord of hosts, was set up in faith in your tabernacle; come, peoples, let us worship.

AS-8e5aa7dd70a5.t: A precious cornerstone was founded today in your tabernacle; come, peoples, let us worship.

AS-783a1ba0d872.t: In it a true sacrifice and an incorruptible offering was presented. Come, peoples, worship [cut off].

AS-1b6f32f014a2.t: You came down from heaven, Son of God, and became flesh of the holy Virgin, You who are inseparable from the Father; have mercy.

AS-27c42fa6fe35.t: You came willingly to the passion, God, and were crucified for the human race, and descended incorruptible into the tomb: have mercy.

AS-4a0b73453660.t: You destroyed death and set the world free with power, Lord, and rose from the dead with authority; have mercy.

AS-eef26ba19c55.t: You who came down from heaven, from the Father's bosom, only-begotten Son of God, and took flesh from the holy Virgin for our salvation: have mercy.

AS-162ab36b94b1.t: God, you walked among us sinners and trampled the head of the dragon, and the stings of the death-bringer were extinguished, and you saved the world: have mercy.

AS-ea0649c74117.t: You nailed our sins upon the Cross, and enduring death, you descended into the tomb; you granted life to those sitting in darkness, and you rose by power: have mercy.

AS-01de783fa7ed.t: God reigned over the nations and made the holy Church radiant and bright; O people, bless Christ.

AS-cb7b603cc5bf.t: The Lord put on strength and drew it about his waist, for by his holy Cross he quenched the sting of death. Peo[cut off]

AS-b934fc7fa774.t: God is risen, and the whole universe is adorned anew, and the children have partaken of the body and blood of the Life-giver. Peo[cut off]

AS-07fbdc2e9dd9.t: You who from the beginning established the Church with wisdom, the wisdom of the Father [cut off]

AS-4ea89b638ec7.t: which Moses prefigured by a vision, marking out the tabernacle that came down from heaven on Mount Sinai, illumined by the glory of God.

AS-12cf9a85f9fb.t: You who imprinted the mystery of your incorruptible dispensation in the holy Virgin, the ark of the divine covenant of the testaments, the resting place of the Word of God, the uncreated of glory.

AS-91cc04e221c8.t: You who prefigured the return of our nature to life by the crossing of the Jordan, and the seizure of death and hell by the fall of Jericho, with the ark of the Cross working wonders for the new Israel: let the children sing a blessing to you, O Lord.

AS-7d86b7e3494e.t: Bless the Lord and exalt him forever.

AS-3a1be8948919.t: Come now, believers, called into the adoption of St Gregory, bless and exalt the God of all.

AS-2f45c312eddf.t: With rejoicing let us celebrate the memory of our patriarch, and with him praise and exalt Christ our King.

AS-c555d1621b0b.t: Priests and ministers, praise with spiritual sound together with the holy patriarch; and exalt the holy Spirit of truth.

AS-f40fb7c5b936.t: Your virginity, Mother of God, unstained, which the fire of the Godhead did not burn, we magnify.

AS-3861987422b1.t: Christ our God and Savior, who dwelt incorruptibly in your womb, we greatly magnify.

AS-8eebc20f28d3.t: The unattainable manifestation of the Lord dawned on the world; let us worship the unapproachable light.

AS-342ac22d78ad.t: [cut off] my [?]. By the intercession of your high priest and witness, save us, O abundantly merciful.

AS-014f5fd857ef.t: By the supplications of holy Gregory, hear us, you who alone are abundantly merciful.

AS-18a692d1b1f6.t: By his prayers, through which we learned the way of life, atone, Lord, for our transgressions.

AS-7231df6e7936.t: Leader of faith and illuminator of our souls, Lord, holy Gregory: come, believers, by his hand let us offer thanksgiving to God.

AS-6492f2830cc1.t: Great confessor of Christ, who accepted sufferings for us, Lord holy Gregory, come, enlightened ones, through [cut off]

AS-33ed700f8b8d.t: High priest of God and expounder of the divine laws, Lord, holy Gregory: come, disciples with him, let us sing: Glory in the highest to God.

AS-c34243aca230.t: Wondrously glorious God and ever provident, who by foreknowledge began the salvation of the Armenians and granted us an illuminator from the sinful Parthian nation: for which reason, through his intercession, Savior, save us now and at your awesome coming.

AS-6bf2d15897bb.t: With wondrous amazement the blessed holy Gregory took upon himself the unbearable torments, and for three times five years [fifteen years] he dwelt among the venomous creatures in the torments of the abyss, in the pit; therefore, through his intercession, Savior, save us now and at your awesome coming.

AS-ded29f313933.t: By your wonder-working word and great mercy he went forth and healed those struck by demonic assaults, making all of them worshipers of your Holy Trinity; therefore, through his intercession, Savior, save us now and at your awesome coming.

AS-0e8192a2d4cb.t: O blessed lord, holy Gregory, and

AS-f4d54f7636d9.t: [...] your [...] ask of the Lord forgiveness.

AS-c4a467347e43.t: You who by your patience obtained for yourself a people of your own and chosen, and adorned it, newly clothed, with the birth of the holy font: [...].

AS-360f175173bf.t: You who opened to me, lost in darkness, the door of the light of true knowledge of God, and made us worthy to become heirs of eternal life: [...].

AS-bc99251bf57f.t: Good shepherd and guide of eternal life, Lord, holy Gregory, establish our souls in the faith of truth upon the foundation of the holy Church.

AS-6ee1181cb66d.t: You found an incorruptible treasure, holy Mother of God; intercede with Christ our God to save our souls.

AS-605a13b654bb.t: You who, like the great Elijah and John the Baptist, dwelt in the wilderness, struggling with angelic conduct; from the thorn-bearing branches you breathed forth the fragrance of the rose blossom of Christ, for the life of the saved: O blessed holy Ephrem, intercede with Christ for us who celebrate you.

AS-9c82af6ac3ef.t: You who drank from the heavenly streams of the Spirit the flowing of grace, as the ranks of the apostles did in the upper room from the fiery tongues, which you generously poured out as cupbearer throughout the universe for the drinking of thirsty souls: O blessed holy Ephrem, intercede with Christ for us who celebrate your feast.

AS-abebc5628080.t: From you, the God-planted tree of life of the mind, the cluster bore fruit, with which you fed, and ever feed, the children of the Church; scribe of the kingdom of heaven and teacher of the Old and New Testaments: O blessed holy Ephrem, intercede with Christ for us who celebrate your feast.

AS-51aed22ba526.t: Today the Church joyfully celebrates the memory of Saint Gregory, by whom she was enlightened and shone splendidly, adorned and crowned in garments embroidered with gold; bless Christ the King, children.

AS-c09a8b5c4c82.t: Today the newly born children of light rejoice in the memory of the holy Illuminator, by whom they were invited to enter the incorruptible wedding with the heavenly Bridegroom, into the bridal chamber of light: [bless ...]

AS-a4953b626db7.t: Today the priests, ministers of the spiritual sacrifice, honor the holy high priest, through whom they have become partakers of the heavenly priesthoods, and into the holy of holies, translated today, he enters, to intercede always with the Lord for us: bless [cut off]

AS-d0d989aabc8e.t: Today, of the saints, to the Lord for us [cut off].

AS-e44f7387c169.t: Today the heavenly ones, rejoicing, keep the feast together with humankind, having become partakers of our salvation; for there has been revealed to us the spiritual treasure of light, the ray of the Sun of the East, holy Nerses; by his intercession, Lord, grant peace to the Armenian world.

AS-6bdb4126820d.t: Today the priestly rod is renewed once more, beautifully blossoming with splendor, for a valiant shepherd was granted to the rational flock: a shoot sprung up from the root of the Illuminator, holy Nerses; by his intercession, Lord, establish the authority of the patriarchal throne.

AS-60c466170f77.t: Today the royal staff greatly rejoices in glory at the reconciling love of the holy Patriarch, for the lawgiver of kings, comrade-in-arms of the soldiers' ranks, the holy Nerses, came to help; through his intercession, Lord, exalt the authority of the royal throne.

AS-39141ddd6328.t: Holy and spotless patriarch, chosen from the womb, wonder-working witness and boast of the human race, intercede with Christ for us who celebrate your feast.

AS-8a246d6839e1.t: Spiritual shepherd of the rational flock, illuminator of the universe, pillar of light set up in the midst of the Church: intercede [cut off]

AS-520f15a6c212.t: radiant herald of the universe [cut off]

AS-14eb7e9854b6.t: In the temple of your holiness we worship your relics; we glorify the day of the memorial of the completion of your repose; intercede with Christ for us who celebrate your feast.

AS-900fbda6ea2f.t: You who were made worthy to be called into the discipleship of the Apostle Thaddeus, and, tried like gold by the divine fire of purity, were found in the dwellings of the angels: O blessed holy Voskians, intercede with the Lord to cleanse us of our sins.

AS-e6ca8c43db9d.t: You who with unwavering confession preached Christ at the gates of the queen, baptizing the valiant champions at the sources of the Euphrates in flowering splendor; O bles[sed] [cut off]

AS-0f1773b3ae03.t: You who remained undefeated by the enticements of the king's son, tormented for the sake of Christ, were quickly slaughtered as an acceptable sacrifice; O bles[sed] [?]

AS-7fb9d8eec89e.t: Christ, the Sun of righteousness, dawning upon the world, drove away the darkness of ignorance, and after death and resurrection ascended to the Father, from whom he dawned; he is worshiped by heavenly and earthly beings together with the Father and the Holy Spirit; wherefore we too worship the Father in spirit and in truth.

AS-c0031c68e912.t: And we worship the Father in spirit and in truth. He who, in place of the Word born of the bosom who ascended into heaven, was sent as the glad tidings of the Father from on high, the Spirit of truth, to comfort those saddened since Adam, and to arm with fire [?] the chosen ranks of the apostle; wherefore [cut off]

AS-9b4438be0888.t: Today the sorrowful and nocturnal birth-pangs of the first mother are loosed, for those born in the flesh unto death and corruption, the Spirit gives birth again as sons of the light of the heavenly Father; wherefore we too [cut off]

AS-340d6fa035b4.t: Creator God, who brought heaven and earth into being out of nothing, we bless you, who are the repose of the departed, almighty Father.

AS-603aab2b0928.t: Word, God, and co-essential image of the Father's glory; we praise you, who are the resurrection of the departed, only-begotten Son.

AS-7373bb5a97cd.t: Unfailing spring, from which grace is distributed to the universe, we bless you, who are the renewer of the departed, true Spirit.

AS-671bcc74d67a.t: We magnify the holy Mother of God with blessing. The announcing angel proclaimed the good news of the Saviour born of the holy Virgin.

AS-edef04f7165e.t: He says: Rejoice, you who are glad, for the Lord of lords is with you.

AS-22ac16eb2ea0.t: Today the heavenly multitudes rejoice and exult at the dedication of the holy Church, for there has been granted to us the eternal High Priest, to enlighten the holy catholic Church: glory to your coming, Lord.

AS-8adf86abca30.t: Today a pillar of light became a shelter for us from on high, for the heavenly King comes into the holy Church, and the hosts of angels, spread abroad, celebrate with humankind the glory of your coming, Lord.

AS-ad350f7e8377.t: Today the true High Priest, honoured with divine laws, sets up the four-cornered altar of the Cross; having offered worthily, he distributes the body and blood of the Lord. Draw near purely, you redeemed, new people, and ask of Christ that he grant him to us for many days.

AS-7c4611250de2.t: Come, enlightened children of the bridal chamber, taught by the truth of the Word, let us celebrate with joy the memory of the teacher of the Church, who today completed his course and passed to the God-built tabernacles, to the ranks of the souls in the bosom of the fathers, to intercede for us ever with the Lord to grant forgiveness of transgressions.

AS-dd9646435686.t: With thanksgiving let us glorify you, Christ, King of glory, who chose holy Ephrem as herald of your divine laws; who cast the faithful silver of the word from you among the money-changers, into the souls of the sons of men; by his supplications make us worthy to glorify the holy Trinity forever. Amen.

AS-3137ae2d9c34.t: Wonder-working God, who showed your wonders to the human race, we bless you, Lord God of our fathers.

AS-ba5b20694a16.t: Who through the blessed doctor showed mercy to the human race; we bles-

AS-d7243a827234.t: You who enlightened the universe by him, preserve us by his intercession; we bl- [cut off].

AS-58e5a152d199.t: The Lord: all you works of God and all creatures, bless Him; holy ones, praise Him with humble hearts, and exalt Him above all forever.

AS-c94d44400c8b.t: You appeared as an angel on earth and led a life pleasing to God; remember us always, blessed holy teacher, who with the angels bless God forever.

AS-e6b6fca1bf2c.t: You became a keeper of the commandments of the Holy Spirit and were delivered from the snares of the seducer; you completed virtue and passed over to the rest of the ages.

AS-d3a5b9486564.t: Come now, all together, let us take the example of the blessed one's striving, that we may imitate his ways and pass over into the eternal life.

AS-6b8258cba912.t: King of glory, God, life-giving Spirit, on the grace-bestowing great day of the birth of Mary, daughter of David the King, renew the life of us, your king [?], that we may bless you, Lord, now and forever.

AS-87393fd91415.t: Fountain of our life and salvation, Spirit of the Father and the Son, at the time of the budding rod from the root of Jesse, adorn with grace and make radiant the staff of authority of our Patriarch, that we may bless...

AS-b30e27e66133.t: Fullness of the world and spiritual ray, Holy Spirit of God, on the joyful day of the fulfillment of the joy of Joachim and Anna: by their prayers fill the needs of the Armenian Church, that you may bless [?]

AS-d1151819b205.t: You who, coming down from above out of heaven, bestowed divine grace upon us of the north through the hand of the holy teacher: by his intercessions, God, have mercy on us.

AS-f74e22369476.t: You who granted to the sons of Torgom the written wisdom of the Spirit that contains the bodiless Word, revealed in a vision by the hand of the holy Vardapet: by his entre[cut off]

AS-a95cd4abe418.t: You who abundantly spread your heavenly knowledge and spiritual wisdom over the Church of the Armenians through the holy Translators: by their entreaties.

AS-89d4ce92b91a.t: Filled with ineffable grace at the memorial of the holy Vardapet, we ask of you, Lord: save our souls.

AS-c283187a9e21.t: And let us receive into our hearts with faith the zeal of the holy teacher; by his intercession, Lord, li[ve] [cut off]

AS-dfa6d3f5a40a.t: Ranked among the bodiless multitudes and crowned by the Holy Spirit: by the hand of [his holy intercession, Lord, save our souls].

AS-ef9f9aa9f6dd.t: [...] holy intercession, Lord, save our souls.

AS-943524062571.t: With radiant wisdom, a light for the world, being all-illuminating [?], the blessed Basil enlightened the Church by the divine word; by his prayers let us seek forgiveness of sins.

AS-e6808ed49797.t: Gatherer of the soldiers empowered by Christ in the spiritual war, pillar of the firmness of faith, and guide of men into life, the blessed Basil; by his entreaties let us ask for the forgiveness of sins.

AS-f6011551e38a.t: You who lived as a citizen in the body, like the bodiless ones, in virtue from childhood, today the blessed Basil is translated to the heavenly tabernacles; by his entreaties let us ask for the forgiveness of sins.

AS-0f0070a9c12e.t: You who adorned the Church with the light of the divine Word and drove the darkness of ignorance from human souls, O intercessor, be for us before the only-begotten Word of the Father.

AS-e650cc468cc3.t: You who revealed to the Church the consubstantial nature of the united Trinity, confessing its unity, O holy Lord.

AS-6f2679dd848a.t: You who taught the saving dispensation of the One made man for our sake: one from two, a new, wondrous mingling: O Lord, holy Lord, holy Gre-

AS-a07e2584bdc7.t: To you, O God of our fathers, we make supplication with humbled souls; do not overlook us, Lord, you who are glorified forever.

AS-917ba40c4209.t: Remember the covenant of Abraham, of Isaac and of Jacob, and do not disregard the supplications of afflicted souls, O Lord, who are glori (ending cut off).

AS-5dce5127af05.t: Grant, O Lord, to us who ask of you the forgiveness of sins, in the temple of your holiness, through the intercession of your saints; you who are glori (ending cut off).

AS-33289e5f134b.t: The Lord: Bless the Lord, heavens and heavenly powers, seraphim and cherubim, the God of gods; exalt him forever.

AS-d6873815b6a3.t: Bless the Lord. Bless the Lord, O earth, and the living creatures that are in it, lifting up your voices on high with spiritual songs, exalt [cut off]

AS-33c4c54131fa.t: Bless the Lord. Bless the Lord, O ranks of angels and of men, Creator of creatures, with one accord in song exalt [cut off]

AS-77686684cf96.t: The Virgin Mary, their daughter, was bestowed by God upon the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; today the tribe and the nations [?] call blessed her who was born of Anna.

AS-7e83e4ab6bc2.t: Handmaid and mother of life, who bore the Only-begotten of the Father at his right hand [?], who from you in the body cast down the proud from the throne. Era- [cut off]

AS-efea1e8eae3b.t: You, through whose childbearing the Son raised our fallen nature to heaven: he filled the needy with bread and sent the rich away empty. Bles (ending cut off).

AS-0d7afa03fd11.t: You who at your coming with glad tidings sent the holy prophets into the world; and having come in humility with a new law, you filled up what was lacking in the writings of the law and of the prophets: by their intercession, Christ, have mercy on us.

AS-1473b726e884.t: You who beforehand, through the prophets, called the Gentiles to be your new people, and the daughter of Zion, the Church of the Gentiles, as the beloved bride of the immortal Bridegroom: through their intercession.

AS-e5c664f53c39.t: You who built the glory of this temple, which you, the builder of beings, set upon the rock, higher than the first and with surpassing adornment; the seers made it known by the wisdom of the Spirit: through their intercession.

AS-5d597d3071c2.t: Today the heavenly ones, celebrating with us the memory of the holy doctors who enlightened the children of faith, were ranked with the choirs of angels.

AS-f0899d3271b4.t: Today the choirs of apostles and prophets, rejoicing together, daughters of the upper Zion, in memory of the holy doctors, who revealed the mystery of the depths of their wisdom.

AS-9f5d8b13e326.t: of the holy Church greatly honor the memory of the holy Doctors, by whom they were adorned with heavenly graces; with them they sing glory forever.

AS-f8a028c721e2.t: The memory of the holy martyrs of Christ: come, believers, let us proclaim their struggles and glorify God with blessing.

AS-dc915be80cf6.t: Rejoice, Hripsime, with your holy companions, for in the place where your blood was shed the choirs of angels celebrate with us. Come, ha- [cut off]

AS-7b3ec538def8.t: We who have come to honor the memory of the holy witnesses, let us take up the beginning of vigilance, crying out to Christ the Lord: Glory to you, glory to you, Lord God, God.

AS-3dc6b4a505dc.t: You are fearsome to the angels, unseen by the seraphim; you came and appeared in a body, and taught us to say: Lord, glory to you, glory to you, Lord God.

AS-89ea448cae1d.t: Among the bodiless you are blessed on high, and worshipped by humankind; glory and honour befit you at every hour, as we say: Lord, glory to you, glory to you, Lord God.

AS-c673caae0523.t: Boast of the Church and joy of the angels, O holy father Anthony, offer our supplications continually to the Holy Trinity.

AS-8299a1f7cf25.t: You who, built up in the body and bringing to yourself the manner of life of the bodiless ones, O holy one.

AS-d9e2ca6ef985.t: A spiritual cup filled with divine joy; O- [cut off] Our God and Savior, hear us who call upon you, through the intercession of the holy king, who in piety established the holy Church and ordered your people in orthodoxy. Now, fallen down, we beseech you, Lord, lover of mankind: at his memorial grant us your heavenly peace.

AS-bbcef49c6a1e.t: Newly wondrous crowned one and captain of the virtuous, you armed yourself with the weapon of the Spirit, bravely against death, Vartan, valiant champion, who defeated the enemy; with your rose-colored blood you crowned the Church.

AS-dd56db259d14.t: Victorious in the war with the weapon of the heavenly King, prudent with wise understanding, ineffably deep in counsel, and having made known the good name of the Crucified, he became a witness and by the shedding of blood was crowned.

AS-ecbf23a62db6.t: Filled with rational [?] light, the valiant and courageous Artak, dipped in the crimson redness of the gushing spring, having drunk the saving cup and been baptized with his own blood, joined with the bodiless ones to sing glory to the Trinity.

AS-ab62e031c850.t: Adorned with radiant garments by the heavenly arranger of the contest, strengthened by the Trinity, having routed the fortresses of the slanderer; Hmayeak, offered to the Father as a pledge, being a fellow sufferer with the Son, victorious by the Spirit in the war against the king who loves evil.

AS-19e05ab7f83c.t: With an eye on the essential good, he armed himself against sin; going on a journey he ascended to heaven, joined with the bodiless ones, becoming a wondrous temple of the Trinity, found worthy to be the house and dwelling of the Lord's holy mystery.

AS-055d31830754.t: Having acquired the shield of faith, covered with the breastplate of hope, having set on his head the helmet of salvation, the sign of the Cross, Vahan appeared as a lofty shield, who contended as a martyr in his youth; a witness of the Crucified, he was crowned with his own blood.

AS-f4520aa3fc44.t: As a sweet fragrance, burnt offering, he offered himself as a rational gift in sacrifice, presenting himself to the Father in heaven, a desirable [?] man, enriched with righteousness, made radiant with wisdom, by the gifts of the sevenfold grace of the Spirit.

AS-c805d2e822d1.t: With his two kinsmen, the most choice champions, advanced before all as head and end of the martyrs, a forerunner of good things, the foremost Karekin received the prize of victory of the champions.

AS-01451a412b7d.t: Ineffable Word, God, who for our sake went up on the Cross, were lifted up in the midst of the earth, took away the transgressions of the first-created, conquered death by wondrously marvelous power, and, risen on the third day, dawned as light upon the whole world.

AS-50aa0729c1f8.t: We earthen ones, ranked with the fiery beings of immaterial existence, were perfected by the lawless with blessed courage, that they might receive from you, Christ, the crown of incorrupt glory, appearing clothed in light on the great day of your coming.

AS-476bc82d5397.t: They proclaimed the Word of life universally throughout the world; shaking off the sleep of death, they followed the watchful ones of heaven; enduring bravely, they shattered the fangs of death; appearing as the wise, they entered the bridal chamber with the Bridegroom.

AS-7aeec0a0eb7b.t: The holy Vardapet Ghevond, enlightener of all, instructing with great and prudent counsel, filled his disciples, spreading the light of knowledge in the souls of perfect men; willingly and readily they were perfected out of love for the Savior.

AS-a04b26d87aac.t: The fire of the Life-giver's love was kindled in the souls of the saints; giving voice, they encouraged one another, hastening toward death readily; as spiritual pilots they shattered the waves of sin and poured out a way for us [?] into the heavenly harbor.

AS-88fcfdf4780f.t: Baptized in their own blood, they drank the cup of the Savior's death, going ahead of all the chosen disciples of Hovsep [?]; filled with newly wondrous love and shown to be a good champion, he was built up as a temple of the glory of holiness of the immortal Word.

AS-8d6bda9bdb00.t: ...was shown; was built a temple of the glory of the holiness of the immortal Word.

AS-da8ad239241b.t: They taught all to worship your lordship; they suffered bravely against death, the evil prince; prepared for battle, they thwarted the deceits of the evil one; they gave us the water of life to drink and quenched the fire of our sins.

AS-42e1681b09f2.t: Guide of light, who dispelled the darkness of ignorance, made known to us [?]; holy Sahak, shepherd, sharer in seraphic goodness, bearer-up of good conduct, driver away of the evil one's servants: yearning for the ineffable light, he soared up into immortal life.

AS-37fe8e52683f.t: Come, let us also follow the true Rabbis with rejoicing, let us celebrate the memory of the Patriarchs, let us be [?] fittingly into the unity of the Savior's body, let us shine with good works in the heavenly bridal chamber.

AS-8079e9e1ad8d.t: Let us sing the hymns of blessing to Christ the King with a seraphic resounding voice, redeemed by his holy blood, that he may graciously bow down and receive our supplications and grant forgiveness of our many transgressions.

AS-6799272ca507.t: At the ascending of the Word into heaven and his sitting at the right hand of the Father, the apostles, rejoicing, worshiped, blessing the Father who sent the Word.

AS-7017611767cf.t: The gathered companies of the saints in the upper room of the mystery awaited the Spirit with eyes lifted up; bless [cut off]

AS-ea4e8ccfef79.t: Poured out with a sudden-coming sound [cut off]

AS-c8f1b7f94071.t: Life-giving fountain of light, adorned with the light of immortal life: those who were blessing the Father, the sender of the Spirit.

AS-3f3906cf253d.t: Christ, giver of mercies, at Your second coming grant that our departed also stand at Your right hand, You who are merciful in all things.

AS-158fe10f00b9.t: When you grant the immortality of life and invite us to life, set our departed among those who do the will of your name; you who are merc[cut off]

AS-43a67a1238a2.t: Number our departed with your saints and crown them with the righteous; in the place of the fallen angels set them in order; you who are merc[cut off]

AS-aafbaa4990a9.t: Mother and virgin, who gave rise to the Sun of righteousness, we glorify with a spiritual song your only-begotten Son.

AS-06ea82a002b2.t: Your wondrous-glorious birth dissolved the law of human nature, and kept the essence of the nature whole [?]; and the seals of your virginity were not broken; with spiritual song.

AS-9c140e61e8d9.t: You, the unburnt bush, the mountain born of rock, the closed door and the sealed fountain, foretold by the foreseers, mother and virgin, with spiritual song [cut off]

AS-231468106f3a.t: All creation worships Your Cross, O Christ, which was raised for our salvation; let it be a victorious guardian for us, to deliver us from the deceptions of the Slanderer.

AS-5dd7e19adee9.t: On it you were lifted up, you who take away the curses, who are glorified with the Father, to gather the far-scattered ones by the life-bearing wood, to save them.

AS-4b1b2a3805ad.t: By it all creatures were enlightened; for it those held in the sin-loving prison were waiting; it freed us from the deceptions of the slanderer.

AS-4b0119acf614.t: The host of the common people, a company of thousands and thirty-six in number [?], who were martyred valiantly with them in battle, and shed their blood for the renewal of the Church, being crowned together with them by the heavenly Judge of the contest.

AS-0ce22d3466db.t: With thanksgiving we sing the glorification of your Trinity; adorned with the virtues of those crowned for our sake, the churches of Armenia were brilliantly adorned, having always as intercessor the labor of their struggle in battle.

AS-771413c54778.t: You who are ceaselessly glorified by the bodiless ones, we holy priests, with light-born offspring, bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-cd597b631f50.t: You who showed the land of Armenia crowned from the offshoot of your holy preachers: we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-9b034b03b8bf.t: Those who drank the living fire together with those invited to the upper room became, by an overflowing word of grace, givers of light to the children, being baptized with you in blood: God of our fathers.

AS-1e9a731592db.t: The Lord: all nations and peoples [?], all works, the King of all, the heavenly Father [cut off]

AS-c6686c5e688f.t: He who drove away the darkness of sin from the house of Torgom: praise the presider over all, the Son of God, and exalt him forever.

AS-f1bda260bdb7.t: He who crowned Armenia with newly-wondrous illuminators: bless the Holy Spirit, O children of light, new Israel, and exalt him forever.

AS-7a777292497d.t: Of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac and Jacob: you were given by God, virgin Mary, their daughter. The race and the tribes [?] call blessed today her who was born of Anna.

AS-ab3fdabb76a4.t: Handmaid and mother of life, who bore the Only-begotten of the Father at his right hand [?], who from you in the body cast down the proud from the throne. Era- [cut off]

AS-898f92925c8a.t: Who [?] raised our fallen nature to heaven through your childbearing, the Son: he filled the needy with bread and sent the rich away empty. Bles (ending cut off).

AS-34d0fe18a3d0.t: The Sun of righteousness, dawning in Armenia by the pouring out of the blood of the saints: by their petitions spare us, giver of good things, and have mercy on your creatures.

AS-e81aef7497e1.t: The glorious holy ones with their children, the shepherds, the angels [?], by the fire of the Spirit quenched the flame of the fire-worshipping Persians ... interces (ending cut off).

AS-62b3cc733f6b.t: Through the earlier inspiration of the Parthian seer, seeing the sons of the faith of holy Gregory adorned with crowns ... interces (ending cut off).

AS-d7a18b117088.t: Called from the beginning by heavenly summoners, narrators of the saving Word and the pride of the Armenians, ranked together with the hosts of the bodiless ones.

AS-c28c515bc73a.t: The abyssal dragon, likened to Pharaoh, and the king grown savage, sunk with the accomplices of the evil one; the victorious sing the blessings of the Lord.

AS-9490c7df0d11.t: Kindled with the weapons of faith, the Mamikonian general, champion of the Church in the worldwide war, became heir of ineffable good things.

AS-ef221eae8711.t: In sympathy let us weep for those who deny the faith, singing glory on high with the holy patriarchs, through their intercessions, to the one who saves us.

AS-5c3776520db9.t: Courageous against the adversaries, valiantly to take vengeance for the deceit, wise in repaying the plots of the impious, by a just measure, warriors, victors, crowned by Christ.

AS-ec23d42b573d.t: Having exchanged vanity for the true hope of immortality, you received the fulfilment of your longings, to be cleansed by blood from the mire of the filth of sin: soldiers, victors crowned by Christ.

AS-467a02e71057.t: Ask for true peace, witnesses of the holy Trinity, for us who are oppressed by the violence of the lawless, that we may rejoice in the victory of your battle: excellent champions crowned by Christ.

AS-f36895c086f1.t: Sun of righteousness, having dawned in Armenia, you made the holy Church radiant by the pouring out of the holy one's blood; by their entreaties, Giver of good things, spare us, and have mercy on your creatures.

AS-adc4a2d074e9.t: The glorious holy ones with their children, the shepherds, the angels [?], by the fire of the Spirit quenched the flame of the fire-worshipping Persians ... interces (ending cut off).

AS-fedaaef35171.t: Through the earlier inspiration of the Parthian seer, seeing the sons of the faith of holy Gregory adorned with crowns ... interces (ending cut off).

AS-ad2c164b6847.t: You who foreordained the salvation of the Armenians, granting us the blessed holy Gregory as herald, we bless you with the hosts of the bodiless ones, almighty Father.

AS-254ea65bb9bc.t: You who, through his confession, chose the order of priests as sharers of your cross, appointing shepherds and teachers by grace-bestowing anointing, we praise you with the hosts of the bodiless ones, only-begotten Son.

AS-a8f3b256166b.t: You who by the purity of the font and the saving communion crowned in victorious battle those enlisted in your name, made radiant by their own blood: we bless you, true Spirit, together with the hosts of the bodiless.

AS-ba931b474eb5.t: ...we bless you with the hosts of the bodiless ones, true Spirit.

AS-de5abfb40570.t: We bless you, giver of good graces, who chose from the womb those invited, to be sharers of your glory from the beginning: spare us through their petitions.

AS-3fe00836f632.t: Today the angels rejoice in the heavens at the remembrance of the angel of earthly substance, who, ranked together with the voice of the one crying out, sing the blessings of the Father on high.

AS-0cebffb937f6.t: Today the souls of the righteous, of the patriarchs and prophets, rejoice to be of one voice with the one great among those born of women; they sing blessings to the only-begotten Son.

AS-11c43b55c2a9.t: Today the choirs of the apostles rejoice, celebrating the remembrance of the great Baptist, who is the beginning of the apostles and the fulfilment of the prophets with them; and we, sprung from the one who issued from the Father, sing glory on high.

AS-244192b36e07.t: Wondrously glorious God and ever provident, who by foreknowledge, having begun the salvation of the Armenians, granted us an illuminator from the sinful Parthian nation; therefore, through his intercession, Savior, save us now and at your awesome coming.

AS-ff42b2cf9039.t: With wondrous amazement the blessed holy Gregory took upon himself unspeakable torments, and for twice five [?] years he dwelt among the venomous creatures, in abyss-like torments, in the pit; therefore, by his intercession, Sav.

AS-371326dc9da1.t: By your wonder-working word and great mercy, going forth, he healed those struck by the demon-smiting rebukes, causing all to worship your holy Trinity; therefore by his intercession, Sav- [cut off]

AS-89c316a5a97e.t: You who invited those chosen beforehand from the foundation of the world to the incorrupt wedding, calling them to joy with those reclining in the bridal chamber of the God-begotten; by his prayers save us, King of glory, King.

AS-95cbf569ab94.t: You who were seated upon the cherubic thrones, Son of God, rested, and were pleased in humility to be taken into the arms of the sons of Adam: by his entreaties save us, King of glory.

AS-45516a9d0ed0.t: The blessed Ignatius, having drunk the cup of the immortality of your love, ground fine like wheat by the teeth of savage beasts, was found to be holy bread of God. By his entreaties save us, King of glory.

AS-31383e7a2ce8.t: Today the peoples who are of the Gentiles, invited beforehand by the prophets to come to the God of Abraham in worship: bless the Lord in the heavens with the heavenly ones.

AS-6546c11be661.t: Today, sons of the daughter of Zion on high, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, you who drink the abundantly flowing stream of the Spirit from the springs of Israel in the churches of the saints: bless the Lord with a new blessing.

AS-e1a614271daf.t: Today the ranks of the patriarchs, in harmony with the powers above, and the proph[ets] [cut off]

AS-b8d9241dc8aa.t: [...] of the prophets, they sing spiritual songs to God; in their memory let us also sing glory on high.

AS-1234081f64ec.t: The sent dove descending from on high with a loud sound, in the likeness of the shining of fiery light, unburning, upon the disciples as they sat in the holy upper room.

AS-346ad416c1c8.t: Immaterial dove, unsearchable, who searches the depths of God, who, receiving from the Father, tells of the awesome thing and of the second coming, which they preached as of one essence.

AS-cdf1c0f4cf63.t: Blessing to the Holy Spirit who ascended on high from the Father, by whom the apostles were made drunk with the immortal cup and invited the earth into the heavens.

AS-56ca38d82464.t: The time of my turning has come upon the land; now, Lord, receive your servant, and may your good Spirit lead me into the straight land.

AS-cba01a2e26ae.t: My confessing soul, which has completed the course of the vanity of the world: now, Lord, receive the [cut off]

AS-fabaef1c0a00.t: On the last great day, when you make your visitation to those who love you, then spare your servants, and may your good Spirit lead me into the right land.

AS-a041640bfd08.t: You, spotless holy one, who bore the Word, God, in your womb and ineffably gave birth to him who stretches out the heavens: we [cut off]

AS-746b7b480f9d.t: You who were worthy of the light [cut off]

AS-e72e33e74e07.t: You who became worthy of the Light of beings [?], to bear him in your arms, and the Sun of righteousness [cut off]

AS-c97e9c2bf1e6.t: You who established your Church by the word, Christ, upon the apostolic rock, to sing in it spiritual songs.

AS-2a94cd3c5f89.t: An altar of blood was set up in it, and from it he gives us renewal for the forgiveness of our sins.

AS-25213754ffc8.t: The Holy Spirit having descended in the appearance of a dove upon the body and blood of the Lord, for the healing of our souls.

AS-a43f9694f756.t: Of the holy patriarchs Sahak and Hovsep; by command of the holy teacher Ghevond, to enlighten the valiant Aryan men-at-arms: spare us through their petitions.

AS-fbbc52291467.t: You who gathered your chosen ones, stripped of the ineffable light, blackened to the colour of goats, separating them from the holy flock: spare us by their intercessions.

AS-106ab38c0ee3.t: You who are ceaselessly glorified by the bodiless ones, we holy priests, with light-born offspring, bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-a846641207c3.t: You who, from the shoot of your holy stone-throwers [?], showed this land of Armenia crowned; you, B.

AS-a9bf1b3fc522.t: Those who drank the living water with those invited into the upper room, with the overflowing word of grace, lu-

AS-2692daee322a.t: ...they became enlightened [?] by the blood of the children, being baptized with you; God of our fathers.

AS-d8fc1985f3e3.t: Bless the Lord. All nations and peoples, all the works of God, bless the King of all, the heavenly Father, and exalt him for ever.

AS-ae690b0c2a93.t: You who drove the darkness of sins from the house of Torgom, all of you, praise the Ordainer of all, the Son of God, and exalt [cut off]

AS-ecf5f9b9cb1a.t: You who crowned Armenia with new, wondrous illuminators; bless the Holy Spirit, children of light, new Israel, and exalt [cut off]

AS-f26c4c362dc0.t: The Virgin Mary, their daughter, was bestowed by God upon the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; today the tribe and the nations [?] call blessed her who was born of Anna.

AS-6975ba2cc05a.t: Handmaid and mother of life, who bore the Only-begotten of the Father at his right hand [?], who from you in the body cast down the proud from the throne. Era- [cut off]

AS-e0b48abfda39.t: He who raised our fallen nature from you, by the birth of the Son, into heaven; he filled the needy with bread and sent the wealthy away empty; blessed [cut off]

AS-e6fb071bb96a.t: Sun of Righteousness, having dawned upon Armenia, you made the holy Church radiant by the shedding of holy blood; by their entreaties spare us, giver of good things, and have mercy on your creatures.

AS-1b83a836fd70.t: Glorious holy children, the shepherds, the vigilant ones, by the fire of the Spirit quenched the flame of the fire-worshiping Persians: sieve [?].

AS-3369c3c5b2b1.t: Through the earlier inspiration of the Parthian seer, seeing the sons of the faith of holy Gregory adorned with crowns ... interces (ending cut off).

AS-4705af64155d.t: Called from the beginning by heavenly summoners, proclaimers of the saving Word and the pride of the Armenians, ranked with the hosts of the bodiless ones.

AS-2819825913e4.t: The abyssal dragon, likened to Pharaoh, and the king grown savage, sunk with the accomplices of the evil one; the victorious sing the blessings of the Lord.

AS-87619c3816b8.t: Kindled with the weapons of faith, the Mamikonian general, champion of the Church in the worldwide war, became heir of ineffable good things.
