AS-c7142c3c3ab2.t: Let us weep in sympathy for those who denied the faith, singing with the holy Patriarchs glory in the highest to the Savior of us, through their petitions.

AS-1811ce5b1474.t: Ineffable Word, God, who for our sake went up on the Cross, were lifted up in the midst of the earth, took away the transgressions of the first-created, conquered death by wondrously marvelous power, and, risen on the third day, dawned as light upon the whole world.

AS-b42870a84242.t: Numbered with us who are of earth among the fiery incorporeal beings, they were blessedly and valiantly martyred by the lawless, so that they might receive from you, Christ, the crown of incorruptible glory, appearing clothed in light on the day of your great coming.

AS-75144f6a80a9.t: They proclaimed together the word of life throughout the universe; shaking off the sleep of death, they followed the watchers of heaven; self-controlled, they valiantly shattered the fangs of death; wise, appearing, they entered with the Bridegroom into the bridal chamber.

AS-c233b4e266c0.t: the sleep of death, they followed the watchers of heaven; bravely self-controlled, they crushed the fang of death; appearing wise, they entered the bridal chamber with the Bridegroom.

AS-f716458450cd.t: Illuminator of all, Ghevont, holy teacher, with great prudent counsel he instructed and filled his disciples, spreading the light of knowledge in the souls of perfect men; with willing readiness they were martyred out of love for the Savior.

AS-95c72599562e.t: The fire of the Life-giver's love was kindled in the souls of the saints; giving voice, they encouraged one another, hastening toward death readily; as spiritual pilots they shattered the waves of sin and poured out a way for us [?] into the heavenly harbor.

AS-56aaf28b9f74.t: Baptized in their own blood, they drank the Savior's cup of death, led before all by Hovsep, the chosen of the disciples. Filled with newly wondrous love, he showed himself a good champion and was built as a temple of the glory and holiness of the immortal Word.

AS-c391cf345f3a.t: They taught all to worship your lordship; suffering bravely against the death of the evil ruler, prepared for battle they thwarted the deceptions of the evil one, gave us the water of life to drink, and quenched the fire of sins.

AS-ad9bfa1eea5a.t: The path [?] of light, made known to us, the darkness of ignorance dispelled: Sahag, holy chief shepherd, partaker of the seraphic goods, bearer-up of good conduct, driver away of evil, devoted to the ministers of the ineffable light, soared up into immortal life.

AS-26d00658096f.t: may they afflict [?] the leaders [cut off] of the Astanean [?] the holy Ghevontians.

AS-6ac5f5900602.t: Those who had set out and gone to the palace of the lawless king, to bear witness to the true holy Trinity: the holy Ghevontians.

AS-d2b49bebd336.t: The blessed, having entered into battle, that they might wound Belial to death and trample the powers of the enemy: the holy Ghevontians.

AS-dd7e8856f4f3.t: He who dared was defeated by captivity [?] in the great struggle of the holy ascetics, with the holy Ghevontians.

AS-33df6ee593a8.t: But from the shedding of your blood a sweet fragrance rose to the heavens, and the Lord smelled the fragrance of sweet scents together with your voluntary sacrifices, O holy Ghevontians.

AS-3122cc22222d.t: You who were lifted up to the courts of the Seraphim and the ranks of the Cherubim, intercede with the Lord for our souls, O holy Ghevontians.

AS-d43e3df88c06.t: You who invited those chosen beforehand from the foundation of the world to the incorrupt wedding, calling them to joy with those reclining in the bridal chamber of the God-begotten; by his prayers save us, King of glory.

AS-4ee09380bb27.t: You who rested enthroned upon this cherubic throne, Son of God, were pleased in humility to be carried in the arms of the sons of Adam; by entreaties ... [entreat].

AS-1b411c317603.t: The blessed Ignatius, having drunk the cup of the immortality of your love, ground fine by the teeth of beasts like the wheat of God, was found to be holy bread of God; by his entreaties ...

AS-da3386f14c07.t: You who from the beginning received from the Father the spirit of knowledge, O blessed lord, holy John, and enlightened the holy Church with the divine word: entreat the Savior for the forgiveness of our sins.

AS-1dcc639a57e5.t: You who were called a herald of the incorruptible Word, Golden Mouth, from whom a spring of life flowed, giving the whole universe to drink in a four-streamed outpouring: entreat the Savior for the forgiveness of our sins.

AS-68ef02493029.t: You who drew near to the Ineffable, to the light close to the Trinity, O blessed lord and doctor: today the Church celebrates the holy memory of your repose; entreat the Savior for the forgiveness of our sins.

AS-cfbb5e18592c.t: You who adorned the Church with the light of the divine Word, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance from the souls of men, O Lord.

AS-fcd805c4b1ff.t: Holy Gregory, intercede for us with the only-begotten Word of the Father.

AS-9c78fa4a4868.t: You who revealed to the Church the consubstantial nature of the united Trinity, to confess the unity: O Lord, holy Lord, holy Gre-

AS-7a46dd15aa9c.t: You who taught the saving dispensation of the One made man for our sake: one from two, a new, wondrous mingling: O Lord, holy Lord, holy Gre-

AS-5bd5bba0228b.t: The bodiless ones were amazed seeing the blessed Nicholas, who in the body acquired a manner of life incomparable among the embodied; by his prayers ask for forgiveness of sins.

AS-b5a42377738f.t: Rejoice, mother Zion, and adorn your bridal chamber ineffably, for the blessed Nicholas, in a body, conquered Belial, who is without a body. By his prayers ask forgiveness of sins.

AS-41ae74668183.t: With entreaties we sinners ask of you, all-holy Trinity, that you forgive our sins through the supplications of Nicholas. By his prayers ask forgiveness of sins.

AS-953eaffd92df.t: Holy Mary, golden jar and ark of the covenants, who bestowed from above the bread of life on our hungry nature: intercede always with Him for the atonement of our sins.

AS-feed7f74aeb0.t: You who, Christ, kindled the fire of Your love in the souls of the righteous, by which the blessed Eustratius, inflamed with wisdom, willingly offered himself to You as a whole burnt offering, by his intercession grant us who celebrate forgiveness.

AS-c88c541caf5a.t: You, Christ, who spread the light of your kingdom over the world, for which the blessed Auxentius longed and yearned in spirit, drinking the cup of blood with joy, being baptized with you, intercedes [cut off]

AS-84394f52cac4.t: You, Christ, who spread the light of your glory throughout the universe, by which the blessed Eugenius, having lit the lamp of faith, followed you on a path of light into the heavens through the blood of death, he intercedes ...

AS-81f1d956e0a0.t: You, Christ, who gave us the sign of your Cross as a weapon of victory, armed with which against death the blessed holy Orestes was crucified with you as a burnt offering, intercedes [cut off]

AS-628da95910d7.t: You, Christ, who sowed the word of life in the rational earth, which the blessed Mardarius received and bore fruit in himself; suffering in the body as if without a body, he was crowned; he intercedes ...

AS-c446c32d82b9.t: Today the Church, joined with the bodiless ones, dances in celebration of the memory of the countless martyrs who ran to the Jerusalem above, glorifying Christ the King.

AS-47830e314e28.t: Today the rational whole burnt offerings, the myriads of lambs, while the flame blazed over the embers, sang the blessings of the three children, glorifying Christ the King.

AS-fe3a3ba79340.t: ...the kindled flame of the three children, they sang the blessings: glory [cut off]

AS-01192839ab0c.t: Today they offered themselves to you as a willing sacrifice upon the holy altar, and received the incorruptible crowns, glorifying Christ the King.

AS-9213781aba07.t: Today the Church presents the children to the heavenly Bridegroom of the bridal chamber, who sing together with the angels in rejoicing, glorifying Christ the King.

AS-2a8fccd08fc0.t: Today we believers in the holy Trinity, gathered in the temple of the struggle of the witnesses, seeking forgiveness of transgressions, glorifying Christ the King.

AS-68291dac346b.t: Today the holy Church rejoices in the remembrance of the holy witnesses who fought bravely against the violence of the evil one, perfected in blood for the sake of the name of the Lord.

AS-7cdc407639c8.t: Today, likened to holy Stephen, the great champion, the first witness, bearing in himself the same name and the contest of the battle, he was crowned, made like him.

AS-d08eec80fd9c.t: The thirty and four chosen in the Lord, contending in the trial of torments, received from Christ the victory of the battle, who granted them endless life.

AS-eba8c57876c1.t: By the entreaty and petition of the holy ones of Stephen's company [?], receive, Lord, our supplications, granting forgiveness of our offences, kindly Savior, giver of gifts.

AS-8867e3f5873e.t: Martyr and witness of Christ, holy Stephen, who accepted the sufferings and became a companion of the heavenly choirs, entreat God to grant us endless life.

AS-46e41f5ab785.t: According to your name you became the crown of the Church, a follower of the light-adorned way, and you were found an exhorter of the holy ones chosen with you; entreat God to grant us endless life.

AS-99cff5034b28.t: You were chosen by the Spirit as the joy of the Church and you illumined the sons of Torgom; today the faithful rejoice and celebrate the feast of your struggle; entreat God to grant us endless life.

AS-82d91dc0fad9.t: In the last days of time the merciful heavenly Father built the Church as his house; the Wisdom, the Word and Son, gave his body to be slain and his blood as wine to be mingled. To him who works wonders, give blessing in all things.

AS-0227371a5a4c.t: He also sent His servants to the mixed [cup?] and invited the hungry to the bread of the body, called them to the wine of the blood, gave drink to the thirsty; at this calling the northern people rebelled, the people of Armenia, who worked these wonders for us and established a new hope.

AS-691b183e2af3.t: Faithful and wise, named Gregory, wakeful, like the Cross, through the death of the Son and by the sufferings of his holy body, he called the Armenian nation to the same blows and dealt out the harshest strokes. Give blessing to the Father's Word alone, wise one, you fiery hosts.

AS-8ca46cbd6017.t: Of our anointed patriarch Gregory the Illuminator, of Ghevont the patriarch, the Armenians first brought us from Caesarea a priceless pearl, the relic of the holy Forerunner. To him who works wonders, give blessing, earth-born nation.

AS-683df86da7eb.t: Like that day of salvation when the Savior came to the Jordan, the same morning star of the sun rose on the land of Armenia; the gates of hell were shattered, the crowds of demons who fell into the nine-eyed places were driven out, and the angels joined ranks with us.

AS-61c9310fb1a0.t: The Illuminator took in his hand the relic of the holy Forerunner and fenced around the regions of the land; by the grace of the right hand, by the word of the Anointer, here let enemies not gain strength, let no sects of schisms spring up. A divine voice came from heaven: may your petitions be fulfilled.

AS-a8b9568db8b8.t: Holy, blessed Anthony, striving toward heaven's feast, and Kronides, born of earthly stock, surpassing nature: holy Ghevont granted you to us as heavenly angels on earth. Deliver us from the passions of the sorrowful body, from the wound.

AS-f4da24018392.t: From the midst of the land of the Greeks, gifts of glory given to the Armenians: trainers of the orders of monastics, fathers of solitary ascetics, flowers of the growth of the rational ones, healing remedies for the sick. From these demonic evils, save us from trials.

AS-1e0dfcf434ff.t: They were the light of the Father, the Only-begotten, of the truth; you were given to Gregory, the Parthian-born preacher, as a living treasure, and also the spiritual relics of the holy witness Athenagenes, by which the wounds of our body may be healed and the transgressions of our souls atoned.

AS-374b41f2b504.t: Seven-starred vaults of heaven, builders of the vault of the Godhead, ascetics in body, grass-eaters, pure in spirit, temples of light; high towers of the Church, strong ramparts of the house of Armenia: we beseech you, ascetic holy fathers, to be benefactors of our souls.

AS-1331bd700a66.t: When the Persian forces made war against the armies of Armenia, you pleaded with entreaty, beseeching God the Word, through the crying voice of John, the holy Forerunner, to keep this land unshaken, the place of the shedding of your blood.

AS-b6ba20a8a0aa.t: We cry out to you, holy champions, angels in bodies of earthly matter, holy martyrs and witnesses, who were perfected by death by the sword. The memorial of your feast urges us on, a stream of the shedding of your holy blood. May it be a holy offering before the Lord, to keep us ever unharmed.

AS-f483a4009b5c.t: Having learned with certainty, asking the prophet: Who shall go up the mountain of the Lord, or who shall stand in his holy place?

AS-478fba40ae98.t: Behold, we have seen the fruitful mountain, the watchpost [?] and dwelling of the martyrs, who received mercy from God their Savior.

AS-36dd617893c2.t: Who took up their crosses and were crucified together with the Crucified One, going eagerly toward their executioners like lambs among wolves.

AS-c2a37184233f.t: Likewise we see him at the pool of Bethesda, where multitudes of the sick lay, waiting for the stirring of the waters once again.

AS-d77533dd4b7d.t: Here the pool of Siloam was renewed for us, to open the eyes of our hearts, to drive away the sicknesses of souls and bodies.

AS-ce2399fcd579.t: More wondrous to me than the songs of musicians is the sound of your laments, O blessed lord Vahan, chosen of God.

AS-b6c203d22e28.t: This urges the parts of my soul all the more to compose for you songs, not mournful but spiritual and joyful, exhortations and eulogies, O blessed lord Vahan, servant of Christ.

AS-76c73812e6f0.t: Your asceticism terrifies the nature of my body, yet you found even more, O blessed lord Vahan, lover of Christ.

AS-e3cb548da824.t: The sober ones of the outsiders, the creating words of the vain, into deception indeed your loving [?], divinely made and soul-profiting [?], O blessed lord Vahan, chosen from the nobles.

AS-db2a4419fbe2.t: Like a valiant champion prepared for battle, you completed your course bravely among the nations of the south, arrayed with the incorporeal ones, O blessed lord Vahan, ruler of the people of Goghtn.

AS-9f098755dae1.t: Filled with divine grace, blessed holy ascetic, your lordship David, your name of bravery went up to heaven for the joy of the angels, and throughout the whole world for the rejoicing of men.

AS-b27bca578bd5.t: You acquired for yourself a name of bravery in the arena of struggle, O lord David; you conquered the enemy with the Cross of Christ, you filled the whole universe with joy, and by prayers to God you became our supporter.

AS-7b61ea0e8efe.t: You gave your body along with your spirit as a ransom, and by the cross and by blood you purchased the kingdom; you received the authority of intercession; entreat God to save us from the southern destruction [?].

AS-47d84de626d8.t: Sweet shoot from the root of good things, flower of faith sprouting again, beauty of comeliness, adornment of the Church, you bore fruit, O holy Geeragos, for the one who planted you. Intercede for our souls with Christ.

AS-cb53a0be1d76.t: Here, son of a devout mother and martyr of the heavenly Contest-giver; valiantly armed, soldiering in spirit though a child in body; having set battle against the lawless, you were crowned, O holy Kirakos; intercede with Christ, who planted you, for our souls.

AS-fe01c0bf96e1.t: The dew of sweetness spread over your fields when your precious blood was shed on the earth; the heavenly ones rejoiced, receiving you into themselves, mother rejoicing with her son, O holy Hoogheeda. Intercede for our souls with Christ the Creator.

AS-b15284f35863.t: Rose-colored blazing flower in a newly planted garden, you appeared adorned with light, O blessed holy Geeragos. Intercede for us with Christ our Savior.

AS-353e9698aea0.t: Sweet-voiced dove, gently speaking of the Lord Jesus; stained with flowing blood, golden-budded, newly sprung; intercede for us with Christ our Saviour.

AS-822515333b14.t: Sweet cluster of the Rabbi, the teacher, crushed with blood; you were crowned by Christ with the blessed martyrs; intercede for us with Christ our Saviour.

AS-17b4898cccdc.t: You are the pride of holy faith, crown of light of the Church, mother rejoicing with her son today, O blessed holy Hoogheeda: on our behalf inter[cede] [cut off] with Christ our Savior.

AS-c8917d5123b6.t: With hope, come, let us celebrate the memory of the martyrs, the great saint Minas, Hermogenes and Krapos.

AS-64ff06bc1d22.t: O holy witness of Christ, sweet-voiced Minas, swift helper, to us who seek you with hope.

AS-648795e8d69e.t: In the shrine of rest of the great saint Minas, come, believers, let us worship with hope.

AS-25e898d107ec.t: You who were made worthy to be called into the discipleship of the Apostle Thaddeus, and were found tried like gold by the divine fire of purity in the dwellings of the angels: O blessed holy Voskians, intercede with the Lord to cleanse us of our sins.

AS-76e079868def.t: You who with unwavering confession preached Christ at the gates of the queen, baptizing the valiant champions at the sources of the Euphrates in flowering splendor; O bles[sed] [cut off]

AS-696d94e4ff79.t: You who remained undefeated by the enticements of the king's son, tormented for the sake of Christ, were quickly slaughtered as an acceptable sacrifice; O bles[sed] [?]

AS-debd25a86f78.t: We beseech you, Lord, through the intercession of the holy Adovmank, who contended in the battle of war and were found victorious against the enemy: through their intercession, Christ, have mercy on us.

AS-7edd68759751.t: They who took up the breastplates of the armor of faith from their hearts, and received on their heads the helmet of salvation, the sign of the Cross, girding the sword, the true Holy Spirit, about the waist: by their intercession, Christ, spare us.

AS-51ca24d127ca.t: Who cleansed themselves as a temple of your holy name, and made their prayers give off a fragrance of sweetness in the place where their holy blood was shed: by their intercession, Christ, have mercy on us.

AS-8bac720d9805.t: You who beforehand in the Law, as a type of your Only-begotten, Heavenly Father, gave power to the oil of holiness for the anointing of the anointed: pour out also upon this oil your heavenly grace.

AS-ff700f80262e.t: You who humbled yourself to us, poured-out oil, the name of the Anointed of God, mingling the divinity, you took on anointed human nature: pour out also upon this oil your heavenly grace.

AS-c289fa99ae53.t: You who, descending into the holy upper room upon the apostles, gave the anointing of the anointed, and by this anointing recreated through them earthly beings as children of God: pour out also upon this oil your heavenly grace.

AS-328bb51ea7be.t: You who adorn with this your holy betrothed Church in radiant and most bright garments: her children, together with the angels, bless the holy Trinity.

AS-6a5a77399780.t: Almighty Father, who sent your only-begotten Son for the salvation of mankind and also poured out your Spirit, pour out gifts, gentle one, the grace of your adoption, upon this oil dedicated to you.

AS-77abe5fdbc1b.t: Son of God, name of poured-out oil, anointed above your companions with the oil of gladness, which you poured out upon the ranks of the apostles; pour out the graces of your adoption into this oil, consecrated to you.

AS-3a503f12c934.t: True Spirit, anointing of the anointed, who by this anointing also give birth to us by the grace of God; pour out the graces of your adoption into this oil, consecrated to you.

AS-36f6130471d8.t: Threefold unity, one Godhead, we cry out to you with the seraphim: Holy, holy, holy. Sanctify the offerings of the mystery, so that those reborn by it may sing glory to you forever.

AS-c02cb53f2ebd.t: Deep, unfathomable, beginningless mystery, you who adorned the heavenly powers in the inaccessible bridal chamber of light, with exceeding glory, the ranks of the fiery ones.

AS-8418cd5f993b.t: By ineffably wondrous power you created Adam, the lordly image, and clothed him with graceful glory in the garden of Eden, the place of delight.

AS-c39da998f9fb.t: By the sufferings of your holy Only-begotten all creation was renewed, and man once again became immortal, adorned in a garment that cannot be stripped away.

AS-f9bbec237f85.t: Rain-born, to the apostles, in the holy fire-flowing cup, which was poured out upon the apostles in the holy upper room: pour out upon us also, Holy Spirit, God, your wisdom together with the vestment.

AS-3b2ffe9a19a6.t: Holiness befits your house; you who put on comeliness and the holiness of glory, bring it around your waist and gird our waists with truth.

AS-218679c559cc.t: You who stretched out your creating arms against the stars, strengthen our arms with power, with the raising of hands to mediate to you.

AS-fb21285727c3.t: By weaving [?] may you encircle the head with a crown, the mind and the senses, with the cross-marked stole, after the manner of Aaron, flowering with gold thread, for the adornment of the tabernacle.

AS-6b1539f1068a.t: Lordly God, ruler over all the common people [?], with ephod-bound [?] love you clothed us, to be ministers of your holy mysteries.

AS-8f0b3f8225ab.t: Into this dwelling of the dedicated covenant, the temple of the Lord, we who are gathered here for the mystery of the service of supplication before this holy sacrifice that is at hand, with sweet incense, taking our place as a company, we circle to the upper court of the sanctuary. In uprightness receive our prayers like the fragrant scent of incense, of storax and cinnamon; and keep us who offer in holiness, always and continually to serve you. Through the intercession of your Mother and Virgin, receive the entreaties of your ministers.

AS-fe34e922ac46.t: You who made the holy Church shine higher than the heavens with your blood, O Christ, and set in it, after the pattern of the heavenly ones, the ranks of apostles, prophets and holy teachers: today the gathered ranks of priests, deacons, cantors and clerics offer incense before you, Lord, after the old pattern of Zechariah; receive from us our incense-offered supplication, like the sacrifice of Abel, of Noah and of Abraham; by the intercession of your supreme powers, keep ever unshaken the throne of the Armenians.

AS-7f7b93dd4e16.t: Rejoice greatly, daughter of light, holy catholic mother, with your children, Zion; adorn yourself, glorious bride, heaven-like, light-filled tabernacle; for the Anointed God, who is of the Being, is ever offered in you without being spent; for reconciliation with the Father and for our cleansing he distributes his holy body and blood, for the completion of his holy dispensation; grant forgiveness to the builder of this temple.

AS-016cae3a673e.t: always the sacrifice to the Father for reconciliation, for us for atonement, he distributes his holy body and blood, for the completion of his holy dispensation, to grant forgiveness to the builder of this temple.

AS-0d4f48f27c7e.t: The holy Church confesses the incorrupt Virgin Mary, Mother of God, from whom the bread of immortality and the cup that gladdens us were given; give praise to Him with a spiritual song.

AS-3dfd82526697.t: The Word, newly creating out of nothing the heaven of heavens and the heavenly hosts of the bodiless, intelligible angels and the perceptible four elements of opposing union, by whom the ineffable Trinity is glorified for ever.

AS-dafc807abf69.t: Thrice-holy, one lordship, one Godhead in one nature: the uncreated, creating Light said that created light should be, which he caused to dawn on the first day, the first of the week, Sunday; by which the ineffable Trinity is glorified for ever.

AS-1ace7d3c4e0e.t: Like rabbis, let us expound the hidden mystery and understand that the unseen light, intelligible to pure souls and visible, has dawned on us on this first day of the week, the holy ray of the Resurrection. Come, you who are saved, with the angel give blessing to the Risen One.

AS-f90993263433.t: Beloved, in love you humbled yourself and took flesh for our salvation; in that same flesh you were crucified, you were laid in the tomb of death; today you rose as God and were proclaimed by the angels. Come, redeemed, with the watcher give blessing to the Risen One.

AS-b2765ba89009.t: You appeared to the myrrh-bearers with the joyful greeting of life, and on the mountain of Galilee to the eleven apostles: make us worthy together with them to see you on the last day. Come, redeemed, with the watcher give blessing to the Risen One.

AS-3101e3828e9e.t: Children of Zion, awake, give good news to the bride of light: your Bridegroom is risen and has conquered death by his authority; he comes to crown you with glory; go out to meet him, adorned with ornaments; sing a new song to the Risen One, the fruit of life of those who have fallen asleep.

AS-e785a9e2ff96.t: By the command of the Creator Word, on the second day of the beginning he separated the waters from the waters, enclosing them with a firmament, by which he divided the earthly world from the fiery beings. With them, you sons of light, give blessing to the threefold Light.

AS-e696c0dac33d.t: Many-eyed hosts of the cherubim, thrice-holy seraphim, thrones of the uncreated Godhead, of the co-essential Trinity: be intercessors with the Lord for the children of the Church; with them, sons of light, give blessing to the threefold Light.

AS-b27ee0819172.t: Supreme authorities and ever-unchanging dominions, un- [cut off]

AS-ead3e9b5fc20.t: Supreme authorities and ever-unchanging dominions, unconquerable holy powers, praises of the Creator: entreat the merciful Lord not to disregard the works of his hands; with them, sons of light, give blessing to the threefold Light.

AS-2a13d773a6da.t: Ranks of the bodiless principalities, archangels of the heights, fiery spirits and the hosts of ministering angels: pray to the Lord of lords for earthly mankind; with them, sons of light, give blessing to the threefold Light.

AS-d95b35542d99.t: Of the heavenly ranks on high, your praising watchers, may the voice of supplication for us be sweet to you, compassionate one; whom also give us as guardians from now until the end; with them, sons of light, give blessing to the threefold Light.

AS-9a8eb2e9bcc6.t: To the Powers and Dominions, the Authorities and Principalities, and all who are named in the heavens, with supplications receive us, O Christ, with joy, on the day of your death and resurrection, to bless you with them in the Spirit, glorifying you with the Father.

AS-448214c7942e.t: The essential Word, co-creator and equal in power with the Father, on the third day separated the waters and caused plants and shrubs to spring forth. And in the third age he again dried up the flood of waters, saving Noah with his ark and making the kinds of living creatures to increase. Give blessing to the ineffable Light, the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

AS-3a3b2d7da304.t: Among the trees of the earth he planted sensible plants and also noetic plants; having abated the flood of sins, he multiplied the ranks of the righteous, from whom came the greatest among those born of women, mediator of grace and of the law: give blessing to the ineffable Light, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

AS-309afb425d80.t: Soldier of the King of heaven, herald of the kingdom, ask that a way out be set in our heart, away from the valley of sorrow, to the dedicated place of the Lord, promised to the sons of men: give blessing to the ineffable Light, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

AS-a7a61dd5d637.t: Servant of the Father's Heir and worshiper from the womb, forerunner and baptizer of him who is the atoner of our sins: be an intercessor with that same compassionate one to wipe out the record of our transgressions: give blessing to the ineffable Light, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

AS-f31c45f95afe.t: From the Father you dawned as light, life-giver to our dead nature; you sent holy John as forerunner, herald of life; at his petition, Almighty, receive our supplications: give blessing to the ineffable Light, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

AS-7b71b1ce0a59.t: The holy angel of earthly substance went up to heaven on the path of light. Make us worthy of that same narrow and strait way, so that, following it to the upper dwelling of your Father, we may sing to you with the blessed sons of light a hymn of glory.

AS-fde32de1465f.t: The non-existent and first-born darkness was driven out on the first day; that bright light on the fourth day, matter gathered into the sun; the moon created in the likeness of light and the choirs of the stars arranged, by which the Creator of beings is blessed by rational ministers.

AS-786ef1262c9a.t: having arranged the choirs of stars, by which the Creator of beings is blessed by rational servants:

AS-76af105d34b0.t: The hidden mystery was made known in the fourth age through Isaac. On the fourth day again the angel gave the virgin the good news that the Light, who is not contained by you, is encompassed in a body. In whom you were blessed, earthborn race, give blessing to the fruit of the Virgin.

AS-a0358207bce1.t: From the virgin, the first mother Eve, through whom old Adam is condemned, the sorrowful curse was lifted by your holy birth-giving, Virgin Mary; entreat your Only-begotten to forgive the sins of her children; in whom you, earth-born race, were blessed: give blessing to the fruit of the Virgin.

AS-c15b2550a7d6.t: Bride, offered from earth to heaven, to whom we lift up our souls: on the day of your hearing the good tidings, ask that we too may hear the voice of the glad tidings of your Only-begotten, 'Come, you blessed of my Father'; in whom you, earth-born race, were blessed: give blessing to the fruit of the Virgin.

AS-61da6509b841.t: With voice we entreat you, Lord, and fall down before you; by the entreaties of the Mother of God quench from us the flame of the furnace; grant that with tears our sins be wiped out and that we be renewed again; in whom you, earth-born race, were blessed: give blessing to the fruit of the Virgin.

AS-87b161610782.t: Skilful helmsman, you passed through the sea of this life without a trace. Carry us with Peter from the waves of sin in this sea, by the supplications to your most high, incorruptible Parent, in whom you were blessed, earthborn race. Give blessing to the fruit of the Virgin.

AS-ad7f5f80681a.t: The Word, radiant from the Father, on the fifth day commands the kinds of lively creatures to spring from the waters, and winged creatures of the air. And in the fifth age, the old Israel was baptized in the cloud and in the sea. Let us give honour and glory to the unbegotten Word, the worker of wonders.

AS-e7f4aea4ab30.t: Purely, after the pattern of the apostles of Christ, who from the Sea of Tiberias were called to the heavenly things; they passed through the worldly sea and were baptized in the Spirit: let us give honor and glory to the worker of wonders, the uncreated Word.

AS-c482478d1aea.t: To the boundless joys, to the incorrupt wedding, the Father of glory sent you, inviters of the sorrowful; ask that we may be partakers with you of that holy wedding: let us give honor and glory to the worker of wonders, the uncreated Word.

AS-dd514ea26352.t: Renewers of the universe from the transgression of the forefather, newly feathered, you adorned the churches of the Gentiles; entreat that same compassionate one to renew us from old sin: let us give honor and glory to the worker of wonders, the uncreated Word.

AS-658303653ee0.t: Builder of all creatures out of non-being, you yourself built the Church, the Rock, upon the rock of the Word; having laid foundations in the new Zion, join us by building into the same: let us give honor and glory to the worker of wonders, the uncreated Word.

AS-0572161351e9.t: Rejoiced [?] with the courses of the rivers, the city built by you, Jesus, from whom streams of grace flow upon souls [cut off]

AS-8f75825e1cb5.t: The city built by you, Jesus, rejoiced in the courses of the rivers, from which streams of grace flow and water the souls of men; give us also to drink of the water of life, at the petition of the Spirit, of those who draw near [?], that your rational earth may bear fruit to your glory.

AS-5db54500fb66.t: Not enduring, by the nature of goodness, to hold the ineffable good alone, he created man in his own image on the sixth morning; and at the third hour he gave the one born of the rib as help to the one born of the earth, whom he set to enjoy paradise, but forbade the fruit of death.

AS-1ce7fa97fde4.t: Struck dumb before the Judge after the transgressions, the old Adam made the woman the cause of the deception, and the woman the treacherous serpent, through which this earth was cursed and thorn and thistle sprang up in it; the sentence of death was given to man, to return to the dust from which he was created.

AS-67e7b0d19394.t: The Father of glory hastened to blot out the record of our debts and transgressions, whereby the compassionate Son, in the sixth age, put on the body of sins; by the Father's good pleasure he came willingly to death on the Cross; on the Friday the Lamb was slain, in place of the lambs of the old Passover, which were the type.

AS-98fefef1a429.t: By the ray [?] of the light of the commandment, the way of righteousness, being lifted up on your Cross you raised us to heaven; by your ineffable humility and willing crucifixion, he reconciled with us, Lord, in compassion, and forgive sins in mercy [?].

AS-3c61a97da08c.t: You, the dread of the awesome seraphim and the awesome one of the cherubim, humbled yourself to sufferings in the passible nature of men; on the cross you slew sin and loosed the sentence of death; Lord, be reconciled with us in compassion, and forgive sins in mercy.

AS-830f5b2b5253.t: Most exalted of the natures of beings and Maker of all, when at your second coming you cause the sign of your Cross to shine, enlighten now with faith, with that same light, those who worship it, that in concord those clothed with the Cross may bless you for ever.

AS-a30eebe86e9a.t: The Lord, after the creation of creatures, rested on the seventh day from his works, he who is the rest of the labouring, and whose will is the deed of what has come to be; hence he also gave us a firm hope through the rest of the Sabbath: that here we do the works of God, there we rest with God.

AS-b0e2c1327ad1.t: Like teachers (Rabbis) we are taught, we are instructed by the example of the Lord: in the second creation, after the fulfilment of the economy, on the seventh day of rest, descending in the body into the tomb, he raised up the bound souls and prepared the rest that does not pass away.

AS-1c6355258bb6.t: May that dew of yours, dewed from your side, heal the departed; may it descend

AS-669c5fec8b94.t: May your dew, sprinkled from your side, heal the departed, descend upon the dust of their death and make it sprout on the last day; with your life-giving voice call them into your life, and number them with the righteous, to sing glory to you with the bright ones.

AS-1ce3d4f08a9b.t: You who hold life, having loosened the bonds of nature, turned the offences back from death; to the dust you granted deathlessness for mortality, again immortality, to those who are buried with you by the death of the font in baptism: rise with them in your glory, like the sun with light.

AS-9cf0b11d3bf4.t: The righteous shine in the kingdom and the ascetics in rest; the martyrs are crowned and the lamps of the virgins are lit. Number, Lord, with them those who confess you as God; let them not be judged by justice, but be cleansed by your mercy.

AS-dcadec9a983f.t: By your ineffable humility, you who were buried in death and rose, raise up the sons of men who fell with faith in you, and us in righteousness and the departed in mercy, so that with the mouth of the living they may give you glory with the Father and the Spirit.

AS-4ff9fb1d71fc.t: From the east to the west, from the north and from the south, every people and nation, in a new blessing bless the Creator of creatures, who today has caused the light of the sun to dawn upon the world.

AS-4b1f447e04f3.t: Churches of the righteous, glorifiers of the all-holy Trinity, in this morning of light praise Christ, the morning of peace, together with the Father and the Spirit, who has caused the light of his knowledge to dawn in us.

AS-12636dfd81dd.t: Ascetics of God and heirs of the kingdom of heaven, who in exchange for passing things received the things that do not pass away, intercede with the Lord for the children of the Church.

AS-605581f94dbc.t: Glorious fighters, beloved of the heavenly Father, who were baptized with Christ in your blood into the death of the Cross: intercede with the Lord for the children of the Church.

AS-9ffde293ad4e.t: Desirable martyrs and dwelling place of the Spirit of truth, who conquered the passions and desires by the Spirit: intercede with the Lord for the children of the Church.

AS-50126bc11f1e.t: Praised of the world and longed for by the powers above, who attained a portion of blessedness beyond all the sons of men: intercede with the Lord for the children of the Church.

AS-158a4bb5632e.t: Willing offerings, children in years and perfect in wisdom, who in place of milk drank the wine that astounds: intercede with the Lord for the children of the Church.

AS-9b38f52e6e4f.t: Light, Creator of light, first Light, dwelling in unapproachable light, heavenly Father, blessed by the ranks of the beings of light: as the light of this morning dawns, cause your spiritual light to dawn in our souls.

AS-020e43199386.t: Light from light, dawning, righteous sun, ineffable birth of the Father, Son, before the sun your name is praised with the Father, in [cut off]

AS-5bcc7bc2ad9c.t: Light from the Father, springing forth, fountain of goodness, Holy Spirit of God, the children of the Church bless you with the angels, at the dawning [cut off]

AS-f0c44f1b37df.t: Threefold and one indivisible light, holy Trinity, we earth-born ones always glorify you with the heavenly ones, in [cut off]

AS-d5bcca3c02f5.t: Christ, the way and the truth and the life, lead our souls up from earth to heaven.

AS-6f1df6fb0ee6.t: Jesus, the door of life, bring us in as well to your Father and the Spirit, to sing glory always.

AS-53b64e25b66a.t: We bless you, Father without beginning, Being of beings; from non-being you took matter from the dust with your hands and created man in your image; the head bowed down to the feet, for he forgot your commandment; again we say, like the prodigal: Father, I have sinned against you in heaven.

AS-dce2d15aca7b.t: Unsearchable to the heavenly ones, you became visible to humankind, and put on the likeness of the earthly image; you, the unchanging image of the Father, went up at the third hour on the Cross for Adam, the first-created; with the thief crucified beside you, make us worthy of paradise.

AS-95e742edc859.t: King of kings, abundant fountain, Spirit of grace: you appeared in tongues of fire to the twelve apostles gathered in the upper room, and rested on their souls; hear us, gathered in your name, and descend to us also at this third hour.

AS-3178ae75eb8a.t: The light of the sun grew dark at the sixth hour on Friday, showing that the creative Light had dimmed the created light. They covered you, hanging naked on the cross, with a veil of shadow. Drive away from us the heaviness of the demon who roams at midday.

AS-c08519f208f6.t: May the weariness of the battle of this evil one, in this hour of warfare, be driven from our souls by the sign of your holy cross, the radiance of your truth. May the lightning cast down from heaven be driven away from us and pursue it, and may it kindle us with your light.

AS-59041ba3701f.t: In this midday hour of the day, may we not be wounded by the hidden arrows of the darkness against the pleasing eyes of the body, which secretly encamp around us. May the hosts of angels encamp around us, joining us in the dance, glorifying you with the Father.

AS-8409b824a2de.t: Sharing in your passion, the day of light was darkened for three hours, and shone forth again at the ninth, in the likeness of the fulfilment of the shadow of death. You, the greatly radiant lamp of light, gave up your spirit to the Father by [?], partner with you in the heavens; direct us by your Spirit.

AS-d3f6ec252770.t: The powers of the underworld trembled and released the bound souls; rocks were split from rock; the dead rose from the tombs; the elements of the earth shook and the pillars of the world trembled. We who [?] beseech you, that you would number us with the righteous.

AS-c749c50e67f0.t: Then you showed wonders; now also have mercy on us. Our nature, dissolved, was made whole in you; grant also that we may become free from suffering in exchange for your life-giving death. Save us, benevolent Lord. We entreat you: as with the thief, remember us on the dreadful day.

AS-3dfc3fba4d29.t: At the petition of the patriarch Abraham, receive, Lord, our entreaties.

AS-e3d7e7eda8ab.t: Merciful Father, look with love upon the works of your hands that you created, and give us weak ones the hosts of angels as guardians. Save our souls from trials and from the demons that roam in the darkness, that by day and by night we may give you unceasing glory.

AS-15a84681f1f3.t: Being uncreated and without beginning, ineffable offspring, Son and Word, who made the day for work and the night for the rest of sleep: grant that while the eyes of the body sleep, we may be wakeful in spirit; that by day and by night we may give you unceasing glory.

AS-b0bbc6e9ff82.t: Teacher of rational souls, fountain of light, bestower of graces: when the doors of our bodily natures are closed, give light to the eyes of our hearts, to rise before you in the nights and bless you with the fiery ones; that by day and by night we may give you unceasing glory.

AS-ef6dd11c1d11.t: Holy of holies, Trinity, cleanse us to be your dwelling; grant that we may rest with you in the bed, with the children of the bridal chamber; grant the petition of the friend for the loan of three loaves; that by day and by night we may give you unceasing glory.

AS-19b64a92263c.t: You created visible light and divided the day from the night; cause to dawn on us, Lord, in the night, your intelligible rays; grant at all times your protecting right hand as a shelter; that by day and by night we may give you unceasing glory.

AS-568c55141a84.t: May the fire of your love, cast upon the earth, be kindled in our souls; may it purify the thoughts of our hearts and may the light of your knowledge shine; may it awaken us from the sleep of death and set our minds ablaze with your flame; that by day and by night we may give you unceasing glory.

AS-fdbe1ef586c2.t: To you we look, unapproachable Light, hidden in perceptible light, who for our sake were laid in a pit [?] and slept in the tomb: awaken us from sleep, watchful nature, and drive away the working of the evil one; that by day and by night we may give you unceasing glory.

AS-aaac26d68852.t: Of the unshadowed light, with supplications we stand before you, who appeared in the evening, with the doors shut, to the eleven with Thomas. We cry out to you, Lord and God; we confess you. Come down to us also this evening, and give your peace to our souls.

AS-28c8c7fa2d8d.t: Being strengthened, Lord, we beseech you: look upon us for help. We implore you, Guardian of Israel, be a shelter for our souls. Dwell with us, peacemaker, that we may sleep undisturbed, so that we may rise early in the morning to bless you with the Father and the Spirit.

AS-22381c091a58.t: Make us worthy to hear the call of Gabriel's trumpet in the last of the night, and to stand at the right of the ranks of the air, with the light of our lamps kindled unquenchably like the five wise virgins, that as brides we may enter in spirit with the Bridegroom into the bridal chamber, into glory.

AS-85391fb49ccc.t: Drive away from us, Lord, by the sign of your cross, the adversary and invisible beast, and do not give your inheritance over to corruption.

AS-8fabdc4def73.t: Intercede for us, Mary, Mother of God, who bore the Lord God, who shepherds Israel, almighty and wondrous in his glory.

AS-b5249aa4b139.t: We ask of you, Father of mercies and God of consolations, at this sorrowful hour of night drawing near: console us in the sorrows of sins, and grant joy through works of righteousness; by the intercession of the holy Mother of God and of all the righteous.

AS-df61a87d3c0e.t: by the intercession of the holy Mother of God and of all the righteous.

AS-e1ed707a166c.t: According to your most sweet divine command of calling, Son of God, we have come before you this evening, laboring and heavy-laden: lighten our souls of the weight of sins, and strengthen us to take up willingly the sweet yoke of your commandments; by the intercession of the holy Mother of God and of all the righteous.

AS-caceb97467c7.t: We entreat you in spirit, at this hour come to rest, man-loving Spirit of God: when you renew the face of the earth and take back again the souls of men, adorn anew those of us who have fallen asleep, those born of you through the holy font; by the intercession of the holy Mother of God and of all the righteous.

AS-3fc8e3a603c6.t: We set before your unresentful lordship the living image of your spotless parent, when you come in the glory of the Father to judge the enemy of your cross; forgive our transgressions through the intercession of your mother and virgin; we beseech you, Lord, protect us under the shelter of your holy cross.

AS-4d3c29b176ec.t: Make us also partakers, Lord, with your holy apostles, who were worthy to see you at your resurrection. Make us worthy, Lord, to see you at your second coming. Blessing to the one who sent forth on high.

AS-493e55e0e75b.t: When You sit in judgment as the awesome Judge, through the intercessions of the holy Mother of God remember our departed when You come in ineffable glory, for Yours is the glory for ever. Amen.

AS-6fca2c3de8e3.t: We who are gathered in memory of the holy martyrs, singing in unity, give blessing on high to the heavenly King.

AS-cad44482d992.t: For by the shedding of their blood the enemy was defeated, and, honored, Zion boasts, singing: Blessing to the heavenly King on high.

AS-23c3c9c2e9e6.t: Rejoicing in the memory of those ranked with the upper hosts of the watchers, let us sing in their holiness: Blessing to the heavenly King on high.

AS-09bee335944a.t: Who showed the feat of struggle before the tyrants and conquered by faith, they became for us a cause of the threefold Light. By their entreaties save us.

AS-8282d15e9716.t: They who drove away and cast down the darkness of idolatries, and set up for us a victorious sign against the enemy; by their intercession, save us.

AS-7a6d0bed183a.t: And having fought on earth with a glorious striving, lifted on high, they became fellow-singers of the heavenly choirs; by their intercession, save us.

AS-73ef56b37004.t: Who offered themselves to you, Father, and became co-sufferers on the cross with your Son Christ, by their entreaties save us.

AS-910ed84bcec1.t: When the trumpet of your coming sounds, Lord, then the trembling earth gives up the departed, those from Adam onward. On that dread day, adorned with light, make radiant the souls of our departed in the heavenly Jerusalem, in the company at the right hand.

AS-ab2796a7c25d.t: I have drawn near to the door of the grave, and the time has come for me to enter the womb of the earth from which we all were formed. Wise physician and skilled architect, heal the sickness of my soul, O maker and hope of our salvation.

AS-d61d0ae7a00b.t: May your hand be a guardian of my soul, and your right hand a good guide [cut off]

AS-c8592c9c0194.t: ... for me to righteousness, physician [cut off]

AS-0d1e2fdf3084.t: May you cause the compassion of your love of mankind to gush forth for me, and in the spring of life wash the sins of my soul, physician [cut off]

AS-1ece08411fcf.t: May my soul live and bless you all the days of my life; and I take refuge in you, rational shepherd of the flock. Turn the strayed back to your flock, Christ, wise physician and master builder; heal the sickness of my soul, creator and hope of our salvation.

AS-18ad88fdf125.t: Beginningless God, at the beginning of creation you formed the first man from the earth to work and to keep, ineffably in life itself; at the transgression of your command, Lord, you laid the sentence of death upon him: you were earth, and to earth you shall return. And now we beseech you, Creator of all, receive and give rest to the departed soul in the seven-starred luminous tabernacles, where the assemblies of the saints are in peace, with a spirit of meekness, in the goods of heaven.

AS-72c20280b683.t: Having become gold, I became worthless; of the beautifully fashioned building I am the ruin; I, the wise, have become foolish; into the waves of sin I have sunk, and now entreat [cut off]

AS-ab7fa72b5c8e.t: The Caller has come to the Caller above, the awesome Host of the banquet, the awesome Caller; the impartial Judge, the just judgment; merciless angels judge sinners, and now we entreat [cut off]

AS-879427197a85.t: Great and dread is the day of judgment, and trembling before the tribunal at hearing the sound of the trumpet and the roar of the dread fire.

AS-5fc15f672b3a.t: With trembling the earth is shaken, and [cut off]

AS-30528984b216.t: With dread the earth is shaken and the creatures tremble; and Gabriel sounds the world-resounding voice of the trumpet, and the souls put on incorruptible bodies.

AS-e029b5346e2f.t: The Cross shines from the east, sevenfold brighter than the sun; the righteous shine forth, and sinners are hidden from the shadowless light; and the ray of the holy Cross comes before you, cleansing a place for you to lodge. On that dread day, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-b64ce677d875.t: Eternal God and Creator of all, who are life and immortality to us mortals, we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-038c67e877ff.t: You who are served by the seraphim put on the form of a servant, and promised life in your name to the faithful departed: we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-208625c429eb.t: Now we ask of you, Christ, co-creator with the Father and the Holy Spirit, who are judge of the living and the dead: number the souls of the departed among your saints; we bless you, God of our fathers.

AS-c8d160b675ce.t: Bless the Lord; exalt him still more forever.

AS-0a548b015f0d.t: He who is to come with the clouds of heaven to renew the face of the earth, and will awaken the departed together with all the saints: exalt him all the more forever.

AS-42500383ff07.t: Together let us entreat Christ our King, that he may deem worthy [cut off]

AS-f79890201324.t: Together let us entreat our King Christ to make our departed worthy to enter the bridal chamber with the wise virgins: exalt him all the more forever.

AS-a29ab13127e0.t: Mother of God, mother and virgin of the rising Sun of righteousness, who enlightened us: with a spiritual song we bless you and glorify your Only-begotten Son.

AS-66e9d2611412.t: Your wondrous and glorious birth dissolved the law of human nature, and the being of the whole nature was kept, and the seals of your virginity were not broken; spirit[ual] [cut off]

AS-9c365296f7e7.t: The unburnt bush, the mountain cut without hands, the closed door and the sealed fountain, foretold by the seers: you, Mother and spiritual Virgin [cut off]

AS-472a77a6ec03.t: You who are King of the ages, Christ God, receive Your servants in goodness and grant that they be set at Your right hand.

AS-b48135c66c44.t: You who hold authority over death and life, give rest to the souls of your servants, and grant that they be set at your right hand.

AS-292211228ed8.t: When the throne of your lordship is set up and the court of judgment is established, then spare your servants, and grant that we be placed at your right hand.

AS-841e5a620dd8.t: Christ, giver of mercies, at Your second coming grant that our departed also stand at Your right hand, You who are merciful in all things.

AS-38481a68c2a5.t: When you grant the immortality of life and invite us into life, number our departed with those who do the will of your name, you who are merciful in all things.

AS-b02e3cc6f825.t: your [...] arrange our departed, you who are merciful [cut off]

AS-55d503cc442d.t: Number them with your saints and crown them with the righteous; set our departed in order in the place of the fallen angels, you who are merciful in all things.

AS-0a6cc60d12bb.t: Beginningless Father, provident and lover of mankind, who are the Creator of souls and bodies, remember our departed and grant them rest with your saints.

AS-1c868da3720a.t: Only-begotten Son, who are compassionate toward all and purchased your people with the cross and with blood, remember the price of your blood, Lord, and give rest [cut off] with your saints.

AS-210b30791062.t: True Spirit, you who are the unfailing fountain and the fulfiller of all good things, remember the [cut off]

AS-d38f9552215e.t: We beseech You, King of glory, glorified by the angels: receive our departed, O loving Lord, and give them rest with Your saints.

AS-40b367c10a8c.t: When you come in the glory of the Father to judge the earth, Sun of righteousness, [cut off]

AS-8c39f8c0df49.t: When you sit in judgment, dread Judge, Christ our Savior and hope, receive our departed, O Lord who love mankind, and give them rest with your saints.

AS-d97a5617dca9.t: You who are the Creator of creatures, who rest upon the fiery chariot: remember the souls of our departed, and grant them rest with your saints.

AS-b95985228f18.t: You who are long-suffering toward all and forgiving of our offences, re- [cut off]

AS-c99719ed73d7.t: You who are to come a second time in the Father's glory to renew the birth of the first-formed, in- [cut off]

AS-141c67eaef63.t: King of glory, Christ, Giver of immortality, at Your glorious coming make our departed worthy to be companions of Your saints, in Your love for mankind, You who are ever on the throne of glory.

AS-55d4b7bff46f.t: Those whom you made equal with your saints, to partake of your body and blood, Lord: receive them today and give rest to their souls, bringing them to life in your eternal life, in your love for mankind; you who are ever on the throne of glory.

AS-17fd9b8c3371.t: When you make the recompense, Lord, and your saints glory in you, then spare those who confess you, ranking them in the company on the right hand, in your love for mankind; you who are ever on the throne of glory.

AS-3a71521e973d.t: King of glory, Christ, hope of the human race, by your unapproachable power you descended from the heavens, giving life to the creatures of your spotless hands; receive without sorrow into that life the souls of our departed who trusted in you, you who are blessed by the song of the fiery watchers.

AS-de4f6f4a6468.t: At the appearing of the wonders, with sun-wondrous brightness, in your four-formed sign, Lord, when the hosts of heaven spread out over the earth: receive without sorrow into your life the souls of our departed who took refuge in you; you who are blessed with the song of the fiery angels.

AS-6822e811a0b7.t: At the sounding of the trumpet of the great archangel, at the opening of the graves, the dead shall rise; adorned with an incorrupt body, they go to meet you, Lord: receive without sorrow into your life the souls of our departed who took refuge in you; you who are blessed with the song of the fiery angels.

AS-6c7557e22d6d.t: You who were sent from the Father, loving and mighty Savior, and healed sinful man: have mercy, Lord, on the one departing [?], whom you invited and called to yourself.

AS-2f0b4a590e47.t: You who were nailed to the cross, lover of mankind,

AS-946b6048c189.t: [?] mighty Savior, and you sprinkled the dew of your incorruptible blood upon the whole world as mercy [?].

AS-20db1bf001be.t: You who laid waste hell and saved the captives, and raised those held back to the hope of eternal life: have mercy, Lord, on the departed, whom you invited and called to yourself.

AS-dbb8a9d7bdfe.t: I said: Lord, have mercy on my much-sinning soul; you who dwell in the heavens and are glorified by the bodiless ones, be merciful to me, long-suffering lover of humankind, Savior, and dispel the pains of my soul.

AS-607c99e27f9b.t: I have failed from my kindred, forsaken; I have left the life of the world, and the body of vanity has turned to the dust from which it was made; have mercy on me, lover of mankind, abundantly compassionate Savior, and scatter the pains of my soul.

AS-d4020bc29a1a.t: On that day I was delivered into the hands of the dread public square, and I take refuge in you, creator of all things, Lord of all; have mercy on me, lover of mankind, abundantly compassionate Savior, and scatter the pains of my soul.

AS-7ab294bc201d.t: I looked on high to you, who are mighty in all things: receive me into the dwellings of the righteous with your right hand that hides securely; have mercy on me, lover of mankind, abundantly compassionate Savior, and scatter the pains of my soul.

AS-e1445df1513a.t: Behold, I have returned in peace to the dust from which I was made, O renewing architect, giver of mercy; have mercy on me, lover of mankind, abundantly compassionate Savior, and scatter the pains of my soul.

AS-61b3c22dedc0.t: We the living, on the other hand, bless you, Christ, king of the ages, who are glorified with glory among the heavenly and the earthly; have mercy on me, lover of mankind, abundantly compassionate Savior, and scatter the pains of my soul.

AS-20ee793c2bfb.t: We offer you glorification, heavenly Father: remember our departed and grant them rest with your saints.

AS-027e84264b98.t: You who are of the same being as the Father and the Spirit, only-begotten Son: remem[ber]:

AS-ec6b2882bb8e.t: You who are co-glorious with the Father and the Son, true Spirit: remem[ber]:

AS-ccd1b729cff7.t: You who, without beginning in being, came into the world and became flesh of the Virgin for the sake of our debts, grant rest to our departed.

AS-0ddc308fa582.t: You who from the Father of light dawned upon us as light and life, only-begotten Son, co-essential with the Father: grant rest to our departed.

AS-43906c7634d9.t: You who are above mind and thoughts, and, enduring the Cross, saved the universe: grant rest to our departed.

AS-0dce660d3cbd.t: You who created beings from nothing, Word of the Father and co-Creator, God, grant forgiveness to your departed servants when you come to judge those whom you formed with spotless hands.

AS-53543da7cea5.t: You who were sent from the Father and became flesh of the holy Virgin: forgive [cut off]

AS-a4391f4513ba.t: You who on the Cross were deprived of breath and loosed the dominion of death: forgive [cut off]

AS-d3d6c2bdff17.t: You who are the crowner of your saints and the giver of endless good things: forgive [cut off]

AS-e36b4c9a73c4.t: God uncreated and timeless, beginningless and measureless Father, cause of the Son by an ineffable birth and of the Spirit by an unsearchable procession, we beseech you, compassionate, long-suffering and merciful, have mercy on your creature who has hope in you, who has fallen asleep.

AS-d05cc5e6d097.t: O Word, only-begotten in the bosom of the Father and image of the primal archetype, through whom the heavens came to be and the world was fully established: we ask of you, all-merciful Lord and Savior and life-giver, have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-e6b7fa603f76.t: Supreme bestower of graces upon heavenly and earthly beings, life and life-giving Spirit, co-creator with the Father and the Son: we ask of you, fountain of good things who give drink to the thirsty, have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-e70e33d99fb0.t: With the seraphim we confess the life-giver of all, the one thrice-holy Lordship: Father and Son and Holy Spirit, in whom this one, baptized and confessing in faith, has fallen asleep: have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-85b6c4dc8129.t: Perfect threefold number, divided into three persons, united in Godhead, equal in one nature, by whom we are bound and released and again bound indissolubly: have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-aee585e90bb5.t: The Son, co-eternal with the Father, we glorify without ceasing: you who descended into the womb of the Virgin and took the body of Adam; by the entreaties of the Mother of God, your incorrupt parent: have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-871807aa7f3a.t: You appeared in the body on earth, you who are inseparable from the Father; you dwelt among those made of earth, you who are worshiped by the fiery ones; by the entreaties of the heavenly ones, your glorifying angels: have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-7ac0a43cdc3d.t: According to the law of Moses you were presented in the temple, in order to present human nature to the Father in heaven, at the petitions of the holy old man who was released from bonds through you: have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-e3825352f41b.t: King of the fiery ones, you who went about among earthly men by the dispensation and bore human sufferings as a man, you who for our sake took all this upon yourself in humility: have mercy on this your creature, who has fallen asleep in hope in you.

AS-17c6c0926cb9.t: Gathered at the departure of your servant from the world, we ask of you with tears and implore, saying this: be a companion on the way for the one who has gone out, give rest to him in the lodgings of your Father of light, and give rest also to our departed.

AS-49294f9e51f6.t: At the beginning of our salvation you were baptized in the Jordan, and you granted a new font for the cleansing of the sins of men, at the petition of the twice-great Forerunner, at the birth of the Baptist: give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-d26a8f10a596.t: The coeternal Father confessed you with a luminous voice from heaven; the Spirit in the form of a dove descended and rested upon you, his co-essential One. Those baptized by that same Spirit into adoption by the Father through faith: give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-7bc0ae5d0451.t: The darkness of sin was driven away, the light of knowledge dawned through you; the sting of the serpent was healed, our sickness was made well, O life-giver of the dead and light-giver of those in darkness: give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-c1a572111a95.t: Origin of the name from the Father, you who chose out of the world the enlightener of the universe, the ranks of the chosen disciples: by the entreaties of the apostles, be the trumpet of our resurrection when we have passed away; give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-babe51d84aaf.t: Life from life, light from light, you who created us from the dust and renewed us again by the second birth of the holy font; you who by your grace gave life to us from that first death: give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-b0d1a08df59f.t: by your grace, from that first death: in the [cut off]

AS-e797bf9ed67a.t: You filled the first man with the Spirit, whom he lost through the deceit of the evil one; that same Spirit by your word you poured out again upon our souls: by that same holy and good Spirit lead the soul of this one; give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-fcd2a36502c2.t: You called out to Lazarus, by which you gave hope to the dead; by that life the one four days dead was brought to life, as were all who are from Adam: by the voice of life at the last trumpet call this one from this earth; give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-f7c715e5f120.t: The guardian of death shook and trembled at the sound of the life-giving voice; swiftly, together with the word, he gave up the dead man at your command. May the rulers of this air tremble and not hold back the soul of this one; give rest to our departed in the dwelling of the Father of your light.

AS-6fc109258e90.t: Way of the lost and ray of those in darkness, you invited the sons of light to your heavenly wedding; make this one worthy of the joyful assemblies there, and bring him with lamps full into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-9f64cd6f5631.t: In our nature, which you put on, you were nailed to the wood of the Cross, releasing us from sin and from the bonds of our first father; release this one also from transgressions, for the sake of your holy sufferings: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-632cf224b598.t: After your voluntary death on the Cross you were laid in a new tomb; by a burial of three days in the earth you created us anew, living; call again by the voice of the trumpet those who went down with you into the dust of death: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-7100c26991a2.t: The myrrh-bearing women sat mourning and weeping in tears, as for one dead and beyond hope, though you are the Living One of the ages: for the sake of those same holy tears, cleanse this one of transgressions: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-8081f38effb6.t: The foundations of Hades were shaken when they saw you within; you brought out the souls bound in the prison, having bound the prince, the author of death: together with the souls of the saints at rest, give rest to the soul of this one who has fallen asleep: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-215c8e0da131.t: With joy the heavenly hosts descended from heaven to earth when you rose from the dead and dawned as light upon creation: by your holy, life-giving resurrection raise this one to immortal life: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-a59f814ade0a.t: The guards could not endure it, for fear of the heavenly ones who brought good news to the women that death was loosed for mortals: may this one, who is planted together with your death, be a sharer in your life: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-b26a85ddf3ec.t: The bodiless ones, circling the life-giving holy tomb, bring the good news to the human race of everlasting life: set the departed among their choirs on the last day: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-58dcb9dae853.t: The torch-like sign of the Cross dawns shining from the east; the faithful rejoice in you and the deniers will lament: make radiant with its light those who worship the holy Cross: bring him in with lamps full, into the bridal chamber with the wise holy virgins.

AS-a84c40302d26.t: The heavenly ones, having made a path, come before you, gathering your chosen ones to meet you; they bring them on a cloud. Mingle this one with the holy flocks of air-flying doves; rank this one among those above, to sing glory with the angels.

AS-5689ab15678f.t: The elements of the earth tremble when you come in the Father's glory; the light of the sun is darkened, the moon and the stars fade: on the day without evening enlighten this one with your light; set this one among the ranks above to sing glory with the angels.

AS-74ec7fb4aeef.t: The chief of the heavenly hosts sounds the trumpet, a voice bringing good news: Arise, you dead from Adam, for behold, the Bridegroom has come; with the bride, the pure souls, number this one among the saints; set this one among the ranks above to sing glory with the angels.

AS-5fa3ec2d0eb6.t: You sit on the lordly throne, worshiped by creation; you judge the world in righteousness and repay wages according to deeds: then grant mercy and forgiveness to our departed one; set this one among the ranks above to sing glory with the angels.

AS-b8e74f3ef40a.t: The human race, all those born of Adam, is gathered together, and the fiery heavenly ranks come down all at once to that dread public square: remember this one on the terrible day; set this one among the ranks above to sing glory with the angels.

AS-a10f84983fd5.t: The secrets of men, whatever each has done, are shown; the doers of good are crowned, the doers of evil are handed over to the unquenchable fire: then remember this one's good, and let the works of sin be wiped out; set this one among the ranks above to sing glory with the angels.

AS-a533b6462cc3.t: Crowns of various kinds and light-shining robes, woven, are placed on the heads of the holy martyrs and adorn the righteous: by their entreaty make this one a sharer in their light and glory; set this one among the ranks above to sing glory with the angels.

AS-a768889e059e.t: From glory to glory those on the right hand are lifted up and ascend, when they hear the blessed voice of blessing in your calling: let our departed one hear this your divine voice; set this one among the ranks above to sing glory with the angels.

AS-ef84a4394320.t: Priests and people, we ask of you, compassionate Lord, with faith for the departed: receive us with the same hope into the city of Jerusalem above, where the righteous are gathered, always to sing glory with them to you, the Trinity of three persons.

AS-eb365935c0e9.t: Creator and lover of humankind, forgiving and kind, who are praised by the seraphim, Lord, righteous judge, with the holy apostles crown our departed, merciful Lord; have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-ea9548e60823.t: When the writings are fulfilled which told us of that day, the words of the prophets are honored and those of the apostles are completed: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-8b7b1ddac7d6.t: In the upper Jerusalem, in the dwellings of the angels, where Enoch and Elijah are, aged, dove-like, made radiant worthily [?] in the paradise of Eden: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-43be1775a120.t: Christ, King of glory, who come from heaven upon the wings of your winds in the Father's likeness, and by fiery trial make examination of the sons of men: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-6e2e5e1e6f9d.t: When the tribunal is set up, the Bridegroom is seated and the bridal chamber is adorned; the trumpet of Gabriel cries out; all the saints are gathered together; the ranks of the righteous rejoice, but the lovers of sin plead urgently: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-4aaf2d66ac84.t: all gather there; the ranks of the righteous rejoice, while the lovers of sin plead: mer[cut off]

AS-a99e815023b3.t: When the sound of the trumpet comes and the writing of the Levite is revealed, the ray of the holy Cross dawns in glory from the east, the hosts of angels spread out, the archangels encircle: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-3ce7d87daba3.t: The dread mystery: the priest stands with outstretched arms at the sanctuary before the holy altar; the fire is quenched, darkness is driven away, the sorrowful souls rejoice, for forgiveness of sins is granted: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-cdc2dc8e983e.t: Moses, who spoke with God, and Aaron the Levite, the prophets of Israel and the priests of the old law, announced to us beforehand the coming of the holy Only-begotten; they made known our salvation, and in the wilderness they were fed: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-d5957c3d3195.t: With sorrow-sharing sufferings you took upon yourself the death of the Cross, and became the bearer of the wood for the sake of Adam, the first-created: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-83e93ff28f0b.t: The heavenly hosts were struck with dread when they saw you, Lord, on the Cross; the light of the sun was veiled and the light of the moon failed; at the dread glory of you, the Son of God, darkness came over the universe: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-1c9e27af9a05.t: The races of men rejoiced when they heard of your resurrection; they were adorned with new plumage by the resurrection of you, the holy Only-begotten: merciful Lord, have mercy on the souls of our departed.

AS-49fef7da44c0.t: By the supplications of the holy Cross and of the voiceless intercessor, and of the holy [cut off]

AS-721db745f8ed.t: and of the Mother of God, and of John the Forerunner, and of the holy Stephen, the first martyr, and of the holy Illuminator, Patriarch of the Armenians, and of the holy apostles and all the martyrs: have mer- [cut off]

AS-efdb9b530071.t: I said, as my days depart from me: to what [?] shall I go today? To the first lodging, which I did not know. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-2f6b9b81f87c.t: The day of my departure has come; weeping, lamentation and mourning. My heart is troubled within me, and my bones have dried up. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-82a241195b25.t: On my bed those who demand my soul awakened me; they led me on a far road which I did not know: help [cut off]

AS-86adc76d63e3.t: I looked, and there was no one to help me; I took refuge in the God of my salvation; let my soul rejoice in your kingdom. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-00c2f6af0227.t: I was written in the writing of life, and I set out to go to the Creator of heaven and earth. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-8a9f96190db8.t: I departed from the shadowless and unapproachable light through the deceit of the darkness; I tasted the death-bringing fruit; I, the earthen image of you, the benevolent Creator: help [cut off]

AS-26b055a1e199.t: At the separation of my soul from my body, at the dissolving of my beautiful structure, I shudder at the threats of the King, lest he demand from me the talent of the commandment. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-fafa05b16c3f.t: O virgin-born, incarnate God, my Jesus, on that day of the dread tribunal do not condemn the price of your blood. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-0aa14bbf8a45.t: Dreadful is the day of death and terrible the day of judgment; on that day of the dread tribunal do not disregard the price of your blood, for I am the image of you, the benevolent Creator. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-1587f7cdb862.t: I saw the dread judgment of you, the Judge, and I trembled, for it found me unprepared for your commands, O King of the ages. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

AS-eeb3ed1731c0.t: O Mother of God, spotless Mother of the Lord and holy Virgin, intercede with your Only-begotten Son, that he may save us from the threats of Gehenna, and grant us the kingdom of heaven, and give rest to the souls of our departed. Help me also, Christ, today on the first road, and at your second coming help me.

T-01a24151de.t: Saturday: It is the feast of St. John, Patriarch of Jerusalem

T-0215c6c622.t: CANON / OF ANTHONY OF THE DESERT

T-04b27c0987.t: Hymn for the seventh day of creation, and for the seventh age, and in the mystery of the rest.

T-052f8065e1.t: Verses of Repentance: for the fifth week of the Bread-and-Salt fast [?] / Fourth Mode.
